# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Otherwise, treat a URL or open browser tab as context, not browser intent. Earlier Browser use does not make later semantic work browser-first. Before each semantic operation on a linked resource, you MUST query available and deferred tools for an applicable connector, API, or CLI. Reading this skill or scanning visible tools does not count. Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

## Setup Documentation
Use `await agent.documentation.get("<name>")` when one of these setup topics applies:
- `bootstrap-troubleshooting`: read when browser setup succeeds but discovery or selection fails
- `chrome-troubleshooting`: read when Chromium browser extension setup, installation, or communication fails

## Bootstrap
These setup details are internal. User-facing progress updates should be less technical in nature. Never mention `Node REPL`, `node_repl`, `REPL`, JavaScript sessions, module exports, reading documentation, or loading instructions unless a user is asking for that exact information. If setup or recovery is needed, describe it naturally as connecting to the browser or retrying the browser connection.

The `browser-client` module is the core entry point for browser use, and is available under `scripts/browser-client.mjs` in this plugin's root directory. ALWAYS import it using an absolute path. IMPORTANT: If this path cannot be found, stop and report that this plugin is missing `scripts/browser-client.mjs`. NEVER use the built in `browser-client` library.

Run browser setup code through the Node REPL `js` tool. In this environment the callable tool id typically appears as `mcp__node_repl__js`. If it is not already available, use tool discovery for `node_repl js` without setting a result limit. You need the `js` execution tool: `js_reset` only clears state, and `js_add_node_module_dir` only changes package resolution. Do not call either helper while trying to expose `js`. If `js` is still not available, search again for `node_repl js` with `limit: 10`.

CODE MODE REQUIREMENT: When you call the Node REPL `js` tool from the code-mode `exec` tool, the outer `exec` script containing the initial `documentation()` call MUST begin with `// @exec: {"max_output_tokens": 20000}`. This is a first-line pragma for the outer `exec` call, not an argument to the nested `js` tool. Once a browser connection is established, reuse its existing browser binding across later turns and do not reread this skill. Once you have read a browser's complete documentation, do not read it again unless you select a different browser.

A tab binding is separate from its browser binding. ## Browser selection
The scenarios below are for the initial browser selection only. Before calling any `agent.browsers.get*` method, reuse an existing `globalThis.browser`, `globalThis.iab`, `globalThis.chrome`, or `globalThis.edge` binding that already serves the task. A new user turn does not invalidate a browser binding or require another selection or documentation call.

Select the initial browser with exactly one of these scenarios, in the order
shown. An explicit request for the in-app browser, Chrome, or Edge always wins
over URL selection. Never call `getForUrl()` when the user names a browser.
An explicit browser request is a hard constraint: use only that browser and
never fall back to another browser surface. If its exact selector is
unavailable, report that browser as unavailable instead of calling
`getDefault()`, `getForUrl()`, or `get("extension")`.

App-provided in-app-browser context is ambient UI state, not a user instruction to select or switch browsers. Only the text of the user's request can explicitly choose a browser.

Do not inspect browser cookies, local storage, profiles, passwords, or session stores. Browser discovery must remain read-only.

When authentication blocks requested browser navigation, do not replace it with web search, a search engine, another site, or another source merely to bypass sign-in.

### The user explicitly requests a browser
A plugin mention in the user's request explicitly names its browser.
`[@Browser](plugin://browser@openai-bundled)` names the in-app browser.
Browser plugin mentions whose URL contains `browserFamily=chrome` or
`browserFamily=edge` name Chrome or Edge respectively.
`[@Chrome](plugin://chrome@openai-bundled)`,
`[@chrome-internal](plugin://chrome-internal@openai-bundled)`, and
`[@chrome-dev](plugin://chrome-dev@openai-bundled)` name Chrome. Follow the
corresponding explicit-browser scenario below.

The in-app browser is available only when the Browser skill is listed for the session. If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser and that skill is available, use a distinct persistent binding and immediately read its complete documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.iab == null) {
  globalThis.iab = await agent.browsers.get("iab");
  nodeRepl.write(await iab.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser but the Browser skill is not available, report that the in-app browser is unavailable instead of substituting another browser.

Chrome or Edge is available only when a Browser or Chrome skill is listed for
the session and `agent.browsers.get("chrome")` or
`agent.browsers.get("edge")` succeeds. The browser family is a stable selector;
do not list browsers first or pass an opaque browser ID for an explicit family.

For Chrome, use a separate persistent binding and immediately read its complete
documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.chrome == null) {
  globalThis.chrome = await agent.browsers.get("chrome");
  nodeRepl.write(await chrome.documentation());
}
```

For Edge, use its own persistent binding and immediately read its complete
documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.edge == null) {
  globalThis.edge = await agent.browsers.get("edge");
  nodeRepl.write(await edge.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests Chrome or Edge but that family is unavailable,
tell them that browser needs the ChatGPT browser extension and direct them to
**Settings → Computer use** to install it. Do not substitute another browser.

An explicit browser choice remains in force for the task. If authentication blocks the task in an explicitly selected browser, your next response must explicitly ask the user to sign in in that browser and tell you when it is ready, unless that browser's documentation provides a supported authentication flow to try first. Merely reporting that sign-in is required is not sufficient. Do not switch to another browser unless the user asks or approves the switch.

### The user explicitly requests an external browser without naming a family
When the user says to use their external browser, browser extension, or a
similar external-browser surface without naming Chrome or Edge, select the
first connected extension instance directly. Do not call
`agent.browsers.list()` first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.get("extension");

```

If no extension instance is available, tell the user that their external
browser needs the ChatGPT browser extension and direct them to
**Settings → Computer use** to install it. Do not substitute the in-app
browser.

### The task requires browser interaction, the user does not specify a browser, and the task has a target URL
When the user supplies a URL or the intended URL can be reasonably inferred from the request, replace the example below with that URL and let browser-client choose the browser best suited to it. Do not call `agent.browsers.list()` first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getForUrl("https://example.com/");
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

### The user specifies neither a browser nor a target URL
Use the runtime default, which prefers the in-app browser when it is available and otherwise uses Chrome. Do not list browsers first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getDefault();
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

## After setup
If setup succeeds but browser discovery or selection fails, read `await agent.documentation.get("bootstrap-troubleshooting")` before resetting the JavaScript session or trying another browser-control mechanism.

If the failure is specific to Chrome extension setup, installation, or communication, read `await agent.documentation.get("chrome-troubleshooting")` before retrying or taking another recovery action.

When the user did not explicitly choose a browser, a browser selected by the runtime is not a user constraint. Do not switch browsers based only on an assumption about authentication. If navigation shows that the selected browser lacks the required authentication, select another available browser before asking the user to sign in. You may select it without resetting the Node session. Preserve existing `iab`, `chrome`, `edge`, and `browser` bindings when they are still useful. Existing tabs remain bound to the browser that created them. After selecting a different browser, obtain a tab from that browser before continuing and read its complete documentation.

The ability to interact directly with browsers is exposed through the `browser-client` runtime via the `agent.browsers.*` API. Before trying to interact with a selected browser for the first time, you MUST emit and read the complete documentation returned by its `documentation()` call in one go. For the initial documentation read, run the exact direct `nodeRepl.write(await <browser>.documentation());` call shown in the applicable scenario above. Do not assign the documentation to a variable, inspect its length, slice it, truncate it, summarize it, or emit only an excerpt. Do not proactively split the documentation into pages or chunks. Only if the tool output itself explicitly reports that it was truncated may you emit and read smaller chunks until you have read the documentation in its entirety.

Only the Node REPL `js` tool (`mcp__node_repl__js`) can be used to control the selected browser. Do not use external MCP browser-control tools, separate browser automation servers, or other browser skills for this surface. References to Playwright mean the in-skill `tab.playwright` API after browser-client setup.

   229	  function update(dt) {
   230	    if (state.phase === 'over') { updateParticles(dt); return; }
   231	    dt = Math.min(0.032, dt);
   232	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 22); state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt); state.comboTimer -= dt;
   233	    if (state.comboTimer <= 0) state.combo = 0;
   234	    const p = state.paddle;
   235	    if (state.paddle.stun > 0) state.paddle.stun -= dt;
   236	    if (p.sticky > 0) p.sticky -= dt;
   237	    if (p.laser > 0) p.laser -= dt;
   238	    const keyboard = (keyRight ? 1 : 0) - (keyLeft ? 1 : 0);
   239	    if (keyboard) p.targetX += keyboard * 430 * dt;
   240	    p.targetX = clamp(p.targetX, p.w / 2 + 8, W - p.w / 2 - 8);
   241	    const follow = p.stun > 0 ? 0.12 : 0.28;
   242	    p.x += (p.targetX - p.x) * Math.min(1, follow * 60 * dt);
   243	    if (state.boss) { state.boss.t += dt; state.boss.x = W / 2 + Math.sin(state.boss.t * 1.4) * (W * 0.33); }
   244	    for (const ball of [...state.balls]) updateBall(ball, dt);
   245	    updateDebris(dt); updatePowerups(dt); updateLasers(dt); updateParticles(dt);
   246	    if (state.phase === 'play' && state.boss && state.boss.hp <= 0) {
   247	      state.boss = null; addScore(500); burst(W / 2, 74, '#fff2a5', 35);
   248	      if (state.wallRemaining <= 0) completeWall();
   249	    }
   250	  }
   251	  function updateBall(ball, dt) {
   252	    if (ball.stuck || !ball.launched) { ball.x = state.paddle.x; ball.y = state.paddle.y - ball.r - 3; return; }
   253	    ball.trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y }); if (ball.trail.length > 6) ball.trail.shift();
   254	    ball.x += ball.vx * dt; ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
   255	    if (ball.x < ball.r) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); beep(120, 0.018); }
   256	    if (ball.x > W - ball.r) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); beep(120, 0.018); }
   257	    if (ball.y < 62 + ball.r) { ball.y = 62 + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); beep(120, 0.018); }
   258	    const p = state.paddle;
   259	    if (ball.vy > 0 && circleRectHit(ball, { x: p.x - p.w / 2, y: p.y, w: p.w, h: p.h })) {
   260	      ball.y = p.y - ball.r - 1;
   261	      const hit = clamp((ball.x - p.x) / (p.w / 2), -1, 1);
   262	      const speed = clamp(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.015, 260, ball.heavy ? 475 : 420);
   263	      ball.vx = hit * speed * 0.92; ball.vy = -Math.sqrt(Math.max(120, speed * speed - ball.vx * ball.vx));
   264	      if (p.sticky > 0 && !ball.stuck) { ball.stuck = true; ball.launched = false; state.armed = true; }
   265	      burst(ball.x, p.y, ball.heavy ? '#ffca66' : '#eaffff', 4); beep(245, 0.025);
   266	    }
   267	    for (const d of state.debris) {
   268	      if (!circleRectHit(ball, d)) continue;
   269	      if (ball.heavy) { d.life = 0; addScore(12); burst(ball.x, ball.y, d.color, 5); }
   270	      else { bounceFromRect(ball, d); d.life -= 1.5; }
   271	      state.shake = Math.min(8, state.shake + 1.2); break;
   272	    }
   273	    for (const b of state.bricks) {
   274	      if (!b.alive || !circleRectHit(ball, b)) continue;
   275	      const beforeY = ball.y;
   276	      b.hit = 0.12; b.hp -= ball.heavy ? 2 : 1;
   277	      if (b.hp <= 0) destroyBrick(b, 'ball'); else { addScore(4); burst(ball.x, ball.y, b.color, 3); beep(240, 0.022); }
   278	      if (!ball.heavy || b.hp > 0) bounceFromRect(ball, b); else {
   279	        ball.vy *= 1.015; ball.vx *= 1.015;
   280	        if (Math.abs(ball.y - beforeY) < 0.2) ball.vy *= -1;
   281	      }
   282	      break;
   283	    }
   284	    if (state.boss && circleRectHit(ball, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 })) {
   285	      state.boss.hp -= ball.heavy ? 2 : 1; bounceFromRect(ball, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 });
   286	      burst(state.boss.x, state.boss.y, '#fff19a', 6); addScore(12); state.shake = 4;
   287	    }
   288	    if (ball.y - ball.r > H + 20) loseBall(ball);
   289	  }
   290	  function bounceFromRect(ball, rect) {
   291	    const left = Math.abs(ball.x - rect.x), right = Math.abs(ball.x - (rect.x + rect.w));
   292	    const top = Math.abs(ball.y - rect.y), bottom = Math.abs(ball.y - (rect.y + rect.h));
   293	    if (Math.min(left, right) < Math.min(top, bottom)) ball.vx *= -1; else ball.vy *= -1;
   294	    const speed = clamp(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.003, 230, ball.heavy ? 470 : 410);
   295	    const len = Math.max(1, Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy)); ball.vx = ball.vx / len * speed; ball.vy = ball.vy / len * speed;
   296	  }

   298	  function updateDebris(dt) {
   299	    for (const d of state.debris) {
   300	      d.vy += 370 * d.mass * dt; d.x += d.vx * dt; d.y += d.vy * dt; d.angle += d.spin * dt; d.life -= dt;
   301	      if (d.x < -40 || d.x > W + 40 || d.y > H + 60) d.life = 0;
   302	      const box = { x: d.x, y: d.y, w: d.w, h: d.h };
   303	      if (d.vy > 0 && rectsHit(box, { x: state.paddle.x - state.paddle.w / 2, y: state.paddle.y, w: state.paddle.w, h: state.paddle.h })) {
   304	        d.life = 0; state.paddle.stun = Math.max(state.paddle.stun, 0.8); state.shake = 9; burst(d.x + d.w / 2, state.paddle.y, '#ff718d', 10); beep(72, 0.08, 'sawtooth');
   305	      }
   306	      if (d.vy > 0) for (const b of state.bricks) {
   307	        if (b.alive && rectsHit(box, b)) { destroyBrick(b, 'crush'); d.life = 0; break; }
   308	      }
   309	    }
   310	    state.debris = state.debris.filter(d => d.life > 0);
   311	  }
   312	  function updatePowerups(dt) {
   313	    for (const p of state.powerups) {
   314	      p.y += p.vy * dt; p.t += dt * 4;

   316	    }

   318	  }
   319	  function updateLasers(dt) {
   320	    for (const l of state.lasers) {
   321	      l.y += l.vy * dt;
   322	      for (const b of state.bricks) if (b.alive && rectsHit(l, b)) { l.y = -100; destroyBrick(b, 'laser'); break; }
   323	      if (state.boss && rectsHit(l, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 })) { state.boss.hp--; l.y = -100; burst(state.boss.x, state.boss.y, '#ff8bb5', 4); }
   324	    }
   325	    state.lasers = state.lasers.filter(l => l.y > -30);
   326	  }
   327	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   328	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) state.particles.push({ x, y, vx: rand(-125, 125), vy: rand(-145, 85), life: rand(0.3, 0.8), max: 0.8, size: rand(1.5, 4), color });
   329	  }
   330	  function updateParticles(dt) {

   332	    state.particles = state.particles.filter(q => q.life > 0);
   333	  }

    59	      const px = x + d.x;
    60	      const py = y + d.y;
    61	      if (insideRoom(px, py, w, h) && !hasCrate(state.crates, px, py)) {
    62	        out.push({ kind: "walk", dx: d.x, dy: d.y });
    63	      }
    64	    }
    65	    for (const d of DIRS) {
    66	      const crate = getCrate(state.crates, x + d.x, y + d.y);
    67	      const px = x - d.x;
    68	      const py = y - d.y;
    69	      if (crate >= 0 && insideRoom(px, py, w, h) && !hasCrate(state.crates, px, py, crate)) {
    70	        out.push({ kind: "push", dx: d.x, dy: d.y, crate });
    71	      }
    72	    }
    73	    return out;
    74	  }
    75	  function applyReverse(state, op) {
    76	    const old = clonePoint(state.worker);
    77	    if (op.kind === "walk") {
    78	      state.worker.x += op.dx;
    79	      state.worker.y += op.dy;
    80	      return { dx: -op.dx, dy: -op.dy };
    81	    }
    82	    state.crates[op.crate].x = old.x;
    83	    state.crates[op.crate].y = old.y;
    84	    state.worker.x = old.x - op.dx;
    85	    state.worker.y = old.y - op.dy;
    86	    return { dx: op.dx, dy: op.dy };
    87	  }
    88	  function solveState(state, targets) {
    89	    return targets.every(t => state.crates.some(c => c.x === t.x && c.y === t.y && c.color === t.color));
    90	  }
    91	  function makeTargetPoints(w, h, count, rng) {
    92	    const midX = Math.floor(w / 2);
    93	    const midY = Math.floor(h / 2);
    94	    const pool = [
    95	      { x: 1, y: 1 }, { x: w - 2, y: h - 2 }, { x: w - 2, y: 1 }, { x: 1, y: h - 2 },
    96	      { x: midX, y: 1 }, { x: w - 2, y: midY }, { x: midX, y: h - 2 }, { x: 1, y: midY }
    97	    ];
    98	    const points = [];
    99	    for (const p of pool.sort(() => rng() - .5)) {
   100	      if (!points.some(q => q.x === p.x && q.y === p.y)) points.push(p);
   101	      if (points.length === count) return points;
   102	    }
   103	    return points;
   104	  }
   105	  function makeLevel(index, seedBump = 0) {
   106	    const rng = mulberry32(0x41C64E6D + index * 0x9E3779B9 + seedBump * 0x6D2B79F5);
   107	    const stage = Math.floor(index / 6);
   108	    const w = index < 6 ? 7 : index < 18 ? 8 : 9;
   109	    const h = index < 6 ? 7 : index < 12 ? 7 : 8;
   110	    const count = index < 6 ? 1 : index < 12 ? 2 : index < 24 ? 3 : 4;
   111	    const targets = makeTargetPoints(w, h, count, rng).map((p, i) => ({ ...p, color: i % COLORS.length }));
   112	    const occupied = new Set(targets.map(p => key(p.x, p.y)));
   113	    let worker = { x: Math.floor(w / 2), y: Math.floor(h / 2) };
   114	    if (occupied.has(key(worker.x, worker.y))) {
   115	      const options = [];
   116	      for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) if (!occupied.has(key(x, y))) options.push({ x, y });
   117	      worker = pick(rng, options);
   118	    }
   119	    const state = { worker, crates: targets.map(p => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y, color: p.color })) };
   120	    const trace = [cloneState(state)];
   121	    const reverseOps = [];
   122	    let pushes = 0;
   123	    const desiredPushes = Math.min(5 + stage * 2, Math.max(3, count * 3));
   124	    const goalSteps = 18 + index * 5;
   125	    const runReverse = () => {
   126	      const candidates = reverseCandidates(state, w, h);
   127	      if (!candidates.length) return false;
   128	      const pushMoves = candidates.filter(c => c.kind === "push");
   129	      let op;
   130	      const walkMoves = candidates.filter(c => c.kind === "walk");
   131	      if (pushMoves.length && (pushes < desiredPushes || !walkMoves.length || rng() < 0.34)) {
   132	        op = pick(rng, pushMoves);
   133	        pushes++;
   134	      } else {
   135	        op = pick(rng, walkMoves);
   136	      }
   137	      reverseOps.push(applyReverse(state, op));
   138	      trace.push(cloneState(state));
   139	      return true;
   140	    };
   141	    for (let i = 0; i < goalSteps; i++) runReverse();
   142	    let guard = 0;
   143	    while ((solveState(state, targets) || pushes < Math.min(desiredPushes, goalSteps / 5)) && guard++ < 80) runReverse();
   144	
   145	    const traceCells = new Set();
   146	    trace.forEach(s => {
   147	      traceCells.add(key(s.worker.x, s.worker.y));
   148	      s.crates.forEach(c => traceCells.add(key(c.x, c.y)));
   149	    });
   150	    const free = [];
   151	    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) {
   152	      if (!traceCells.has(key(x, y))) free.push({ x, y });
   153	    }
   154	    const used = new Set();
   155	    const takeFree = () => {
   156	      const choices = free.filter(p => !used.has(key(p.x, p.y)));
   157	      if (!choices.length) return null;
   158	      const p = pick(rng, choices);
   159	      used.add(key(p.x, p.y));
   160	      return p;
   161	    };
   162	    const conveyors = [];
   163	    const gates = [];
   164	    let plate = null;
   165	    let door = null;
   166	    if (index >= 12) {
   167	      for (let i = 0; i < (index >= 18 ? 3 : 2); i++) {
   168	        const p = takeFree();
   169	        if (p) {
   170	          const d = pick(rng, DIRS);
   171	          conveyors.push({ ...p, dx: d.x, dy: d.y });
   172	        }
   173	      }
   174	    }
   175	    if (index >= 18) {
   176	      const p = takeFree();
   177	      if (p) {
   178	        const d = pick(rng, DIRS);
   179	        gates.push({ ...p, dx: d.x, dy: d.y });
   180	      }
   181	    }
   182	    if (index >= 24) {
   183	      plate = takeFree();
   184	      door = takeFree();
   185	    }
   186	    const walls = new Set();
   187	    const wallCount = Math.min(free.length - used.size, index < 6 ? 1 : 2 + stage);
   188	    for (let i = 0; i < wallCount; i++) {
   189	      const p = takeFree();
   190	      if (p) walls.add(key(p.x, p.y));
   191	    }
   192	    if (reverseOps.length < Math.max(16, Math.floor(goalSteps * .75)) && seedBump < 20) return makeLevel(index, seedBump + 1);
   193	    const mechanics = index < 6 ? "PUSH ROUTE" : index < 12 ? "DUAL CORE" : index < 18 ? "COLOR SORT" : index < 24 ? "FLOW GATES" : "LOCK SEQUENCE";
   194	    return {
   195	      w, h, targets, worker: state.worker, crates: state.crates, walls, conveyors, gates, plate, door,
   196	      par: reverseOps.length, mechanics, proof: reverseOps.length > 0
   197	    };
   198	  }
   199	  function loadProgress() {
   200	    try {
   201	      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY) || "null");
   202	      if (saved && Array.isArray(saved.stars)) return {
   203	        unlocked: Math.max(0, saved.unlocked | 0),
   204	        stars: saved.stars.slice(0, 30).map(n => Math.max(0, Math.min(3, n | 0))),
   205	        best: Array.isArray(saved.best) ? saved.best.slice(0, 30).map(n => n > 0 ? n | 0 : 0) : []
   206	      };
   207	    } catch (_) {}
   208	    return { unlocked: 0, stars: [], best: [] };
   209	  }
   210	  function saveProgress() {
   211	    try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(progress)); } catch (_) {}
   212	  }
   213	  function startLevel(index) {
   214	    levelIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(levels.length - 1, index));
   215	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   216	    play = { worker: clonePoint(l.worker), crates: cloneCrates(l.crates), history: [], moves: 0, won: false, stars: 0 };
   217	    mode = "game";
   218	    pulse = 0;
   219	    particles = [];
   220	  }
   221	  function openLevels() { mode = "select"; pointer = null; }
   222	  function resetLevel() {
   223	    startLevel(levelIndex);
   224	    burstAt(195, 340, "#8ba5bb", 9);
   225	  }
   226	  function undo() {
   227	    if (!play || !play.history.length) return;
   228	    const previous = play.history.pop();
   229	    play.worker = previous.worker;
   230	    play.crates = previous.crates;
   231	    play.moves = previous.moves;
   232	    play.won = false;
   233	    play.stars = 0;
   234	    shake = 0;
   235	    pulse = .2;
   236	  }
   237	  function isDoorOpen() {
   238	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   239	    if (!l.door || !l.plate) return true;
   240	    return hasCrate(play.crates, l.plate.x, l.plate.y);
   241	  }
   242	  function gateAt(x, y) { return levels[levelIndex].gates.find(g => g.x === x && g.y === y); }
   243	  function conveyorAt(x, y) { return levels[levelIndex].conveyors.find(c => c.x === x && c.y === y); }
   244	  function canEnter(from, to) {
   245	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   246	    if (!insideRoom(to.x, to.y, l.w, l.h) || l.walls.has(key(to.x, to.y))) return false;
   247	    if (l.door && l.door.x === to.x && l.door.y === to.y && !isDoorOpen()) return false;
   248	    const gate = gateAt(to.x, to.y);
   249	    if (gate && (to.x - from.x !== gate.dx || to.y - from.y !== gate.dy)) return false;
   250	    return true;
   251	  }
   252	  function resolveConveyor() {
   253	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   254	    for (let n = 0; n < 6; n++) {
   255	      const belt = conveyorAt(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   256	      if (!belt) break;
   257	      const next = { x: play.worker.x + belt.dx, y: play.worker.y + belt.dy };
   258	      if (!canEnter(play.worker, next)) break;
   259	      const crate = getCrate(play.crates, next.x, next.y);
   260	      if (crate >= 0) {
   261	        const beyond = { x: next.x + belt.dx, y: next.y + belt.dy };
   262	        if (getCrate(play.crates, beyond.x, beyond.y) >= 0 || !canEnter(next, beyond)) break;
   263	        play.crates[crate].x = beyond.x;
   264	        play.crates[crate].y = beyond.y;
   265	      }
   266	      play.worker = next;
   267	      burstAt(cellCenter(next.x, next.y).x, cellCenter(next.x, next.y).y, "#9cecff", 2);
   268	    }
   269	  }
   270	  function tryMove(dx, dy) {
   271	    if (mode !== "game" || !play || play.won) return;
   272	    const from = clonePoint(play.worker);
   273	    const next = { x: from.x + dx, y: from.y + dy };
   274	    if (!canEnter(from, next)) { shake = .08; return; }
   275	    const crate = getCrate(play.crates, next.x, next.y);
   276	    if (crate >= 0) {
   277	      const beyond = { x: next.x + dx, y: next.y + dy };
   278	      if (getCrate(play.crates, beyond.x, beyond.y) >= 0 || !canEnter(next, beyond)) { shake = .08; return; }
   279	      play.history.push({ worker: clonePoint(play.worker), crates: cloneCrates(play.crates), moves: play.moves });
   280	      play.crates[crate].x = beyond.x;
   281	      play.crates[crate].y = beyond.y;
   282	      play.worker = next;
   283	    } else {
   284	      play.history.push({ worker: clonePoint(play.worker), crates: cloneCrates(play.crates), moves: play.moves });
   285	      play.worker = next;
   286	    }
   287	    play.moves++;
   288	    resolveConveyor();
   289	    const c = cellCenter(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   290	    burstAt(c.x, c.y, crate >= 0 ? COLORS[play.crates[crate].color].glow : "#9cecff", crate >= 0 ? 7 : 3);
   291	    pulse = .35;
   292	    if (solveState(play, levels[levelIndex].targets)) winLevel();
   293	  }
   294	  function winLevel() {
   295	    play.won = true;
   296	    play.stars = play.moves <= levels[levelIndex].par ? 3 : play.moves <= Math.ceil(levels[levelIndex].par * 1.3) ? 2 : 1;
   297	    progress.stars[levelIndex] = Math.max(progress.stars[levelIndex] || 0, play.stars);
   298	    progress.best[levelIndex] = progress.best[levelIndex] ? Math.min(progress.best[levelIndex], play.moves) : play.moves;
   299	    progress.unlocked = Math.max(progress.unlocked || 0, Math.min(levels.length - 1, levelIndex + 1));
   300	    saveProgress();
   301	    const c = cellCenter(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   302	    burstAt(c.x, c.y, "#ffe19a", 26);
   303	    shake = .35;
   304	  }
   305	  function burstAt(x, y, color, count) {
   306	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   307	      const a = Math.random() * TAU;
   308	      const speed = 18 + Math.random() * 62;
   309	      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * speed, vy: Math.sin(a) * speed - 12, life: .35 + Math.random() * .45, max: .75, color, size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 3 });
   310	    }
   311	  }
   312	  function update(dt) {
   313	    elapsed += dt;
   314	    pulse = Math.max(0, pulse - dt);
   315	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 1.8);
   316	    for (const p of particles) { p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 88 * dt; }
   317	    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
   318	  }
   319	  function resize() {
   320	    const width = window.innerWidth;
   321	    const height = window.innerHeight;
   322	    const rawDpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   323	    const dpr = Math.min(rawDpr, Math.max(.5, 960 / Math.max(width, height)));
   324	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * dpr));
   325	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * dpr));
   326	    view.dpr = dpr;
   327	    view.scale = Math.min(width / VW, height / VH);
   328	    view.ox = (width - VW * view.scale) / 2;
   329	    view.oy = (height - VH * view.scale) / 2;
   330	  }
   331	  function logicalPoint(e) {
   332	    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   333	    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left - view.ox) / view.scale, y: (e.clientY - r.top - view.oy) / view.scale };
   334	  }
   335	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   336	    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   337	    ctx.beginPath();
   338	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
   339	    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
   340	    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
   341	    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
   342	  }
   343	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align = "left", weight = 700) {
   344	    ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`;
   345	    ctx.textAlign = align; ctx.textBaseline = "middle"; ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   346	  }
   347	  function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width = 1) {
   348	    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke();
   349	  }
   350	  function drawBackground() {
   351	    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, VH);
   352	    g.addColorStop(0, "#0c1723"); g.addColorStop(.55, "#09111b"); g.addColorStop(1, "#070c13");
   353	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   354	    ctx.globalAlpha = .16;
   355	    for (let x = 10; x < VW; x += 20) line(x, 0, x, VH, "#1f3947");
   356	    for (let y = 8; y < VH; y += 20) line(0, y, VW, y, "#1f3947");
   357	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   358	    ctx.fillStyle = "#142431"; ctx.fillRect(0, 69, VW, 1); ctx.fillRect(0, VH - 113, VW, 1);
   359	  }
   360	  function drawHeader() {
   361	    text("FORGELOCK", 22, 25, 18, "#f2f7fd", "left", 900);
   362	    text("PUSH-BLOCK FABRICATION", 23, 47, 8, "#5d93a8", "left", 800);
   363	    if (mode === "game") {
   364	      const l = levels[levelIndex];
   365	      text(`LEVEL ${String(levelIndex + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`, 198, 22, 11, "#dbe7ef", "left", 800);
   366	      text(l.mechanics, 198, 43, 8, "#67b3c9", "left", 800);
   367	      button(300, 13, 72, 33, "RESET", "#172a37", "#7dd9ee", 10);
   368	    } else {
   369	      button(300, 13, 72, 33, "PLAY", "#172a37", "#7dd9ee", 10);
   370	    }
   371	  }
   372	  function button(x, y, w, h, label, fill, accent, size = 11, disabled = false) {
   373	    ctx.save();
   374	    ctx.shadowColor = disabled ? "transparent" : "rgba(0,0,0,.25)"; ctx.shadowBlur = 8; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
   375	    roundRect(x, y, w, h, 9); ctx.fillStyle = disabled ? "#131b23" : fill; ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
   376	    ctx.strokeStyle = disabled ? "#202c37" : accent; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
   377	    text(label, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 1, size, disabled ? "#53616c" : accent, "center", 900);
   378	    ctx.restore();
   379	  }
   380	  function boardMetrics(l) {
   381	    const cell = Math.min(46, (VW - 38) / l.w, 392 / l.h);
   382	    return { cell, x: (VW - l.w * cell) / 2, y: 104 + (392 - l.h * cell) / 2 };
   383	  }
   384	  function cellCenter(x, y) {
   385	    const m = boardMetrics(levels[levelIndex]);
   386	    return { x: m.x + (x + .5) * m.cell, y: m.y + (y + .5) * m.cell };
   387	  }
   388	  function tileRect(m, x, y, inset = 2) {
   389	    return { x: m.x + x * m.cell + inset, y: m.y + y * m.cell + inset, w: m.cell - inset * 2, h: m.cell - inset * 2 };
   390	  }
   391	  function drawBoard() {
   392	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   393	    const m = boardMetrics(l);
   394	    const shakeX = shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * shake * 9 : 0;
   395	    const shakeY = shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * shake * 7 : 0;
   396	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(shakeX, shakeY);
   397	    roundRect(m.x - 12, m.y - 12, l.w * m.cell + 24, l.h * m.cell + 24, 17);
   398	    ctx.fillStyle = "#0d1a25"; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#203b48"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
   399	    for (let y = 0; y < l.h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < l.w; x++) {
   400	      const r = tileRect(m, x, y, 2);
   401	      if (x === 0 || y === 0 || x === l.w - 1 || y === l.h - 1 || l.walls.has(key(x, y))) {
   402	        roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 5); ctx.fillStyle = "#111b25"; ctx.fill();
   403	        ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
   404	        for (let q = -r.h; q < r.w + r.h; q += 9) line(r.x + q, r.y + r.h, r.x + q + r.h, r.y, "#213541", 2);
   405	        ctx.restore();
   406	        continue;
   407	      }
   408	      roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 5); ctx.fillStyle = ((x + y) % 2) ? "#1a2a34" : "#1b2d38"; ctx.fill();
   409	      ctx.strokeStyle = "#284451"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();
   410	    }
   411	    for (const b of l.conveyors) drawConveyor(m, b);
   412	    for (const g of l.gates) drawGate(m, g);
   413	    if (l.plate) drawPlate(m, l.plate, isDoorOpen());
   414	    if (l.door) drawDoor(m, l.door, isDoorOpen());
   415	    for (const t of l.targets) drawTarget(m, t);
   416	    for (const c of play.crates) drawCrate(m, c);
   417	    drawWorker(m, play.worker);
   418	    ctx.restore();
   419	  }
   420	  function drawConveyor(m, b) {
   421	    const r = tileRect(m, b.x, b.y, 4);
   422	    ctx.save(); roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 4); ctx.clip();
   423	    ctx.fillStyle = "#1d4a59"; ctx.fill();
   424	    const shift = (elapsed * 28) % 18;
   425	    ctx.strokeStyle = "#57d3e2"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.globalAlpha = .75;
   426	    for (let p = -30 + shift; p < r.w + r.h; p += 18) {
   427	      ctx.beginPath();
   428	      if (b.dx !== 0) { const x = b.dx > 0 ? r.x + p : r.x + r.w - p; ctx.moveTo(x, r.y + 7); ctx.lineTo(x + (b.dx > 0 ? 5 : -5), r.y + r.h / 2); ctx.lineTo(x, r.y + r.h - 7); }
   429	      else { const y = b.dy > 0 ? r.y + p : r.y + r.h - p; ctx.moveTo(r.x + 7, y); ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w / 2, y + (b.dy > 0 ? 5 : -5)); ctx.lineTo(r.x + r.w - 7, y); }
   430	      ctx.stroke();
   431	    }
   432	    ctx.restore(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   433	  }
   434	  function drawGate(m, g) {
   435	    const r = tileRect(m, g.x, g.y, 5);
   436	    roundRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 4); ctx.fillStyle = "#542e50"; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#e36ca6"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();

   551	  function pointerDown(e) {
   552	    e.preventDefault(); const p = logicalPoint(e); pointer = { id: e.pointerId, x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y }; canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
   553	  }
   554	  function pointerUp(e) {
   555	    e.preventDefault(); if (!pointer || pointer.id !== e.pointerId) return; const p = logicalPoint(e); const dx = p.x - pointer.sx; const dy = p.y - pointer.sy; const was = pointer; pointer = null;
   556	    if (mode === "game" && !play.won && (Math.abs(dx) > 24 || Math.abs(dy) > 24) && was.sy > 78 && was.sy < 590) {
   557	      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tryMove(dx > 0 ? 1 : -1, 0); else tryMove(0, dy > 0 ? 1 : -1);
   558	    } else if (Math.abs(dx) < 16 && Math.abs(dy) < 16) handleClick(p);
   559	  }
   560	  function keyDown(e) {
   561	    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   562	    if (["arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright", " "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
   563	    if (mode === "select") {
   564	      if (k === "escape" || k === "enter" || k === " ") startLevel(levelIndex);
   565	      return;
   566	    }
   567	    if (play.won) {
   568	      if (k === "enter" || k === " ") { levelIndex < levels.length - 1 ? startLevel(levelIndex + 1) : openLevels(); e.preventDefault(); }
   569	      if (k === "escape") openLevels();
   570	      return;
   571	    }
   572	    if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w") tryMove(0, -1);
   573	    else if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") tryMove(0, 1);
   574	    else if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") tryMove(-1, 0);
   575	    else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") tryMove(1, 0);
   576	    else if (k === "z") undo();
   577	    else if (k === "r") resetLevel();
   578	    else if (k === "escape") openLevels();
   579	  }

   170	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   171	    const p = game.player;
   172	    p.invuln = Math.max(0, p.invuln - dt);
   173	    p.dashCooldown = Math.max(0, p.dashCooldown - dt);
   174	    p.attackCooldown = Math.max(0, p.attackCooldown - dt);
   175	    p.attack = Math.max(0, p.attack - dt);
   176	    if (input.dash || game.dashQueued) {
   177	      game.dashQueued = false;
   178	      input.dash = false;
   179	      if (p.dashCooldown <= 0) {
   180	        const v = movementVector();
   181	        const dx = v.strength ? v.x : p.faceX;
   182	        const dy = v.strength ? v.y : p.faceY;
   183	        p.dash = .19;
   184	        p.dashCooldown = 1.05;
   185	        p.invuln = .23;
   186	        p.faceX = dx; p.faceY = dy;
   187	        burst(p.x, p.y, 178, 12);
   188	        game.shake = .22;
   189	      }
   190	    }
   191	    const v = movementVector();
   192	    if (v.strength > .12) { p.faceX = v.x; p.faceY = v.y; }
   193	    if (input.attack || game.attackQueued) {
   194	      game.attackQueued = false;
   195	      input.attack = false;
   196	      if (p.attackCooldown <= 0) {
   197	        p.attack = .17;
   198	        p.attackCooldown = .28;
   199	        doAttack();
   200	      }
   201	    }
   202	    const speed = p.dash > 0 ? 530 : 154;
   203	    const oldX = p.x, oldY = p.y;
   204	    p.x += v.x * speed * dt;
   205	    p.y += v.y * speed * dt;
   206	    if (p.dash > 0) p.dash -= dt;
   207	    p.x = clamp(p.x, arena.l + p.r, arena.r - p.r - 2);
   208	    p.y = clamp(p.y, arena.t + p.r, arena.b - p.r);
   209	    if (collidesObstacle(p.x, p.y, p.r)) { p.x = oldX; p.y = oldY; }
   210	    if (p.dash > 0 || Math.hypot(p.x - oldX, p.y - oldY) > 1) {
   211	      p.trail.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, life: .28 });
   212	      if (p.trail.length > 8) p.trail.shift();
   213	    }
   214	    p.trail.forEach(t => t.life -= dt);
   215	    p.trail = p.trail.filter(t => t.life > 0);
   216	    if (game.key && !game.key.collected && distance(p, game.key) < 25) {
   217	      game.key.collected = true;
   218	      burst(game.key.x, game.key.y, 49, 20);
   219	      game.shake = .16;
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	  function collidesObstacle(x, y, r) {
   223	    return game.rooms[game.roomIndex].obstacles.some(o => {
   224	      const nx = clamp(x, o.x, o.x + o.w), ny = clamp(y, o.y, o.y + o.h);
   225	      return Math.hypot(x - nx, y - ny) < r;
   226	    });
   227	  }
   228	
   229	  function doAttack() {
   230	    const p = game.player;
   231	    burst(p.x + p.faceX * 24, p.y + p.faceY * 24, 42, 4);
   232	    for (const e of game.enemies) {
   233	      const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y, dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   234	      const dot = (dx * p.faceX + dy * p.faceY) / dist;
   235	      if (dist < (e.type === 'warden' ? 62 : 55) && dot > -.12 && e.hitCooldown <= 0) {
   236	        e.hp -= 1;
   237	        e.hitCooldown = .18;
   238	        e.hurt = .18;
   239	        e.x += dx / dist * 16;
   240	        e.y += dy / dist * 16;
   241	        burst(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'warden' ? 322 : 24, 7);
   242	        game.shake = .1;
   243	        if (e.hp <= 0) {
   244	          burst(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'warden' ? 322 : 8, e.type === 'warden' ? 26 : 13);
   245	        }
   246	      }
   247	    }
   248	    game.enemies = game.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0);
   249	  }
   250	
   251	  function updateEnemies(dt) {
   252	    const p = game.player;
   253	    for (const e of game.enemies) {
   254	      e.hurt = Math.max(0, e.hurt - dt);
   255	      e.hitCooldown = Math.max(0, e.hitCooldown - dt);
   256	      e.phase += dt * (e.type === 'skitter' ? 5 : 1.5);
   257	      let dx = p.x - e.x, dy = p.y - e.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   258	      if (e.type === 'watcher') {
   259	        if (d > 134) { e.x += dx / d * 24 * dt; e.y += dy / d * 24 * dt; }
   260	        if (d < 220 && Math.sin(e.phase * .7) > .82 && e.shotClock !== 1) {
   261	          e.shotClock = 1;
   262	          game.bolts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: dx / d * 112, vy: dy / d * 112, life: 2.6 });
   263	        }
   264	        if (Math.sin(e.phase * .7) < .72) e.shotClock = 0;
   265	      } else if (e.type === 'skitter') {
   266	        const sx = -dy / d * Math.sin(e.phase) * 34;
   267	        const sy = dx / d * Math.sin(e.phase) * 34;
   268	        e.x += (dx / d * 66 + sx) * dt;
   269	        e.y += (dy / d * 66 + sy) * dt;
   270	      } else if (e.type === 'warden') {
   271	        if (d > 116) { e.x += dx / d * 30 * dt; e.y += dy / d * 30 * dt; }
   272	        if (d < 270 && Math.sin(e.phase * .72) > .91 && e.shotClock !== 1) {
   273	          e.shotClock = 1;
   274	          for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
   275	            const a = Math.atan2(dy, dx) + i * .23;
   276	            game.bolts.push({ x: e.x, y: e.y, vx: Math.cos(a) * 136, vy: Math.sin(a) * 136, life: 2.4, heavy: true });
   277	          }
   278	        }
   279	        if (Math.sin(e.phase * .72) < .75) e.shotClock = 0;
   280	      } else {
   281	        e.x += dx / d * 47 * e.speed * dt;
   282	        e.y += dy / d * 47 * e.speed * dt;
   283	      }
   284	      e.x = clamp(e.x, arena.l + 18, arena.r - 22);
   285	      e.y = clamp(e.y, arena.t + 18, arena.b - 18);
   286	      if (d < p.r + (e.type === 'warden' ? 24 : 14)) hurtPlayer(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'warden' ? 1.3 : 1);
   287	    }
   288	  }
   289	  function updateBolts(dt) {
   290	    for (const b of game.bolts) {
   291	      b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; b.life -= dt;
   292	      if (b.life > 0 && distance(b, game.player) < game.player.r + 8) {
   293	        b.life = 0;
   294	        hurtPlayer(b.x, b.y, b.heavy ? 1.1 : .8);
   295	        burst(b.x, b.y, 335, 5);
   296	      }
   297	    }
   298	    game.bolts = game.bolts.filter(b => b.life > 0 && b.x > -20 && b.x < W + 20 && b.y > -20 && b.y < H + 20);
   299	  }
   300	  function updateHazards(dt) {
   301	    const p = game.player;
   302	    for (const h of game.hazards) {
   303	      h.hitCooldown = Math.max(0, h.hitCooldown - dt);
   304	      h.active = h.timing ? Math.sin(game.roomTime * 2.8 + h.phase) > -.18 : true;
   305	      if (h.active && h.hitCooldown <= 0 && circleRect(p.x, p.y, p.r, h)) {
   306	        h.hitCooldown = .9;
   307	        hurtPlayer(h.x + h.w / 2, h.y + h.h / 2, 1.2);
   308	      }
   309	    }
   310	  }
   311	  function hurtPlayer(fromX, fromY, amount) {
   312	    const p = game.player;
   313	    if (p.invuln > 0 || game.mode !== 'run') return;
   314	    p.invuln = .65;
   315	    game.roomHits += 1;
   316	    game.roomFlash = .2;
   317	    game.runTime += 2;
   318	    game.roomPenalty += 2;
   319	    game.shake = .5;
   320	    const dx = p.x - fromX, dy = p.y - fromY, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   321	    p.x = clamp(p.x + dx / d * 28, arena.l + p.r, arena.r - p.r - 2);
   322	    p.y = clamp(p.y + dy / d * 28, arena.t + p.r, arena.b - p.r);
   323	    burst(p.x, p.y, 347, 13);
   324	    if (game.roomHits >= 3) restartRoom();
   325	  }
   326	  function restartRoom() {
   327	    game.roomPenalty = 0;
   328	    game.runTime += 10;
   329	    game.roomFlash = .7;
   330	    game.transitionText = `ROOM ${pad(game.roomIndex + 1)} RESET  +10s`;
   331	    loadRoom(game.roomIndex, false);
   332	    game.transition = 1.05;
   333	  }
   334	  function advanceRoom() {
   335	    if (game.roomIndex >= game.rooms.length - 1) {
   336	      game.mode = 'done';
   337	      game.completed = true;
   338	      game.won = true;
   339	      const key = `${game.type}:${game.seed}`;
   340	      const previousBest = bests[key];
   341	      game.newBest = previousBest == null || game.runTime < previousBest;
   342	      game.best = previousBest == null ? game.runTime : Math.min(previousBest, game.runTime);
   343	      bests[key] = game.best;
   344	      saveBest();
   345	      burst(314, 368, 168, 42);
   346	      return;
   347	    }
   348	    game.roomIndex += 1;
   349	    loadRoom(game.roomIndex, false);
   350	  }
   351	
   352	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   353	    for (const p of game.particles) { p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= .966; p.vy *= .966; p.life -= dt; }
   354	    game.particles = game.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
   355	  }
   356	  function burst(x, y, hue, count) {
   357	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   358	      const a = Math.random() * TAU, s = 18 + Math.random() * 90;
   359	      game.particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: .3 + Math.random() * .45, max: .75, size: 1 + Math.random() * 3, hue });
   360	    }
   361	  }
   362	
   363	  function draw() {
   364	    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
   365	    const sh = game.shake * 7;
   366	    ctx.fillStyle = '#080c16'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   367	    ctx.save();
   368	    if (sh) ctx.translate((Math.random() - .5) * sh, (Math.random() - .5) * sh);
   369	    drawBackdrop();
   370	    drawHud();
   371	    drawRoom();
   372	    drawEntities();
   373	    drawParticles();
   374	    drawControls();
   375	    ctx.restore();
   376	    if (game.mode === 'done') drawDone();
   377	    if (game.transition > 0 && game.mode === 'run') drawTransition();
   378	  }
   379	  function drawBackdrop() {
   380	    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   381	    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b1222'); g.addColorStop(.52, '#111a2d'); g.addColorStop(1, '#080c16');
   382	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   383	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#18243a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   384	    for (let x = 12; x < W; x += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 90); ctx.lineTo(x, H); ctx.stroke(); }
   385	    for (let y = 100; y < H; y += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(W, y); ctx.stroke(); }
   386	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e1728'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 78);
   387	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#283756'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 78); ctx.lineTo(W, 78); ctx.stroke();
   388	  }
   389	  function drawHud() {
   390	    const room = game.rooms[game.roomIndex];
   391	    ctx.fillStyle = '#92a5c8'; ctx.font = '700 10px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.letterSpacing = '1px';
   392	    ctx.fillText(`${game.type === 'daily' ? 'DAILY' : 'PRACTICE'}  /  SEED ${game.seedLabel}`, 15, 18);
   393	    ctx.fillStyle = '#f3f7ff'; ctx.font = '800 23px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace'; ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';
   394	    ctx.fillText(formatTime(game.runTime), 14, 48);
   395	    ctx.fillStyle = '#92a5c8'; ctx.font = '700 10px ui-sans-serif, system-ui';
   396	    ctx.fillText(`BEST ${game.best == null ? '--:--.--' : formatTime(game.best)}`, 15, 65);
   397	    pill(210, 10, 58, 29, `R${pad(game.roomIndex + 1)}`, '#17243c', '#b9c9e4');
   398	    pill(274, 10, 72, 29, 'PRACTICE', '#17243c', '#93f2d6');
   399	    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
   400	      ctx.fillStyle = i < game.roomIndex ? '#4ae2bd' : (i === game.roomIndex ? '#ffd36b' : '#263754');
   401	      ctx.fillRect(15 + i * 26, 82, 20, 3);
   402	    }
   403	    ctx.fillStyle = '#b9c9e4'; ctx.font = '800 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui';
   404	    ctx.fillText(`${roomLabel(room)}  ·  SPLIT ${formatTime(game.roomTime)}`, 15, 104);
   405	    if (game.roomPenalty > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = '#ff7582'; ctx.fillText(`+${game.roomPenalty.toFixed(0)}s`, 286, 104); }
   406	  }
   407	  function pill(x, y, w, h, text, fill, color) {
   408	    ctx.fillStyle = fill; roundRect(x, y, w, h, 9); ctx.fill();
   409	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#304363'; ctx.stroke();
   410	    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = '800 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(text, x + w / 2, y + 19); ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   411	  }
   412	  function drawRoom() {
   413	    const room = game.rooms[game.roomIndex];
   414	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0c1525'; roundRect(arena.l, arena.t + 12, arena.r - arena.l, arena.b - arena.t - 12, 14); ctx.fill();
   415	    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${room.hue}, 70%, 64%, .35)`; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
   416	    ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${room.hue}, 70%, 64%, .1)`; ctx.fillRect(arena.l + 4, arena.t + 16, 6, arena.b - arena.t - 20);
   417	    for (const o of room.obstacles) {
   418	      ctx.fillStyle = '#192941'; roundRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 7); ctx.fill();
   419	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#2c4362'; ctx.stroke();
   420	      ctx.fillStyle = '#315073'; ctx.fillRect(o.x + 5, o.y + 7, 3, Math.max(4, o.h - 14));
   421	    }
   422	    for (const h of game.hazards) drawHazard(h);
   423	    drawGate();
   424	    if (game.key && !game.key.collected) drawKey(game.key);
   425	  }
   426	  function drawHazard(h) {
   427	    ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = h.active ? 1 : .22;
   428	    ctx.fillStyle = h.active ? '#d74d75' : '#532d50'; roundRect(h.x, h.y, h.w, h.h, 5); ctx.fill();
   429	    ctx.strokeStyle = h.active ? '#ff8a7f' : '#8d516d'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   430	    const n = h.w > h.h ? 5 : 4;
   431	    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   432	      const px = h.w > h.h ? h.x + 7 + i * (h.w - 14) / Math.max(1, n - 1) : h.x + h.w / 2;
   433	      const py = h.w > h.h ? h.y + h.h / 2 : h.y + 7 + i * (h.h - 14) / Math.max(1, n - 1);
   434	      ctx.beginPath();
   435	      if (h.w > h.h) { ctx.moveTo(px - 5, py + 5); ctx.lineTo(px, py - 5); ctx.lineTo(px + 5, py + 5); }
   436	      else { ctx.moveTo(px - 5, py - 5); ctx.lineTo(px + 5, py); ctx.lineTo(px - 5, py + 5); }
   437	      ctx.stroke();
   438	    }
   439	    if (h.timing) { ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b'; ctx.globalAlpha *= .7; ctx.fillRect(h.x, h.y - 4, h.w, 2); }
   440	    ctx.restore();
   441	  }
   442	  function drawGate() {
   443	    const g = game.gate;
   444	    ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = g.open ? .98 : .38;
   445	    ctx.fillStyle = g.open ? '#41e2b0' : '#5e708f'; roundRect(g.x, g.y, g.w, g.h, 7); ctx.fill();
   446	    ctx.fillStyle = g.open ? '#d8fff4' : '#a5b3c8'; ctx.fillRect(g.x + 6, g.y + 10, 3, g.h - 20); ctx.fillRect(g.x + 13, g.y + 10, 3, g.h - 20);
   447	    ctx.strokeStyle = g.open ? '#b7ffe8' : '#8493aa'; ctx.stroke();
   448	    if (g.open) { ctx.fillStyle = '#9dffe0'; ctx.font = '800 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('GO', g.x + 11, g.y - 7); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; }
   449	    ctx.restore();
   450	  }
   451	  function drawKey(k) {
   452	    const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 180) * .12;
   453	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(k.x, k.y); ctx.rotate(-.25); ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
   454	    ctx.shadowColor = '#ffd36b'; ctx.shadowBlur = 16; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe69a'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
   455	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-5, 0, 7, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(2, 0); ctx.lineTo(16, 0); ctx.lineTo(16, 5); ctx.moveTo(10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 5); ctx.stroke();
   456	    ctx.restore();
   457	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b'; ctx.font = '800 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.fillText('KEY', k.x - 12, k.y - 17);
   458	  }
   459	  function drawEntities() {
   460	    for (const b of game.bolts) {
   461	      ctx.fillStyle = b.heavy ? '#ff8b8b' : '#f79cf4'; ctx.shadowColor = ctx.fillStyle; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
   462	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.heavy ? 6 : 4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
   463	    }
   464	    for (const e of game.enemies) drawEnemy(e);
   465	    const p = game.player;
   466	    for (const t of p.trail) { ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(167, 84%, 70%, ${t.life * .55})`; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 6 * t.life, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   467	    if (p.attack > 0) {
   468	      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(p.faceY, p.faceX));
   469	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#d9fff5'; ctx.shadowColor = '#45e1bb'; ctx.shadowBlur = 18; ctx.lineWidth = 7; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   470	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4, 0, 29, -.78, .78); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
   471	    }
   472	    ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = p.invuln > 0 && Math.floor(p.invuln * 18) % 2 === 0 ? .4 : 1;
   473	    ctx.fillStyle = '#e9fff9'; ctx.shadowColor = '#43e0b8'; ctx.shadowBlur = p.dash > 0 ? 23 : 10;
   474	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   475	    ctx.fillStyle = '#1a3945'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x + p.faceX * 4, p.y + p.faceY * 4, 3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
   476	    if (game.roomHits > 0) {
   477	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8da1bf'; ctx.font = '800 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.fillText(`IMPACT ${Math.floor(game.roomHits)}/3`, 27, 119);
   478	      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = i < game.roomHits ? '#ff6e7e' : '#31415b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(102 + i * 11, 116, 3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   479	    }
   480	  }
   481	  function drawEnemy(e) {
   482	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(e.x, e.y); ctx.globalAlpha = e.hurt > 0 ? .45 : 1;
   483	    const boss = e.type === 'warden';
   484	    const color = boss ? '#c183ff' : e.type === 'watcher' ? '#ffbd6f' : e.type === 'skitter' ? '#ff718a' : '#f35d76';
   485	    ctx.shadowColor = color; ctx.shadowBlur = boss ? 20 : 10; ctx.fillStyle = color;
   486	    if (boss) {
   487	      ctx.rotate(Math.sin(e.phase) * .05); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 27, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   488	      ctx.fillStyle = '#211a38'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 16, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   489	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0d6ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 21, e.phase, e.phase + 4.8); ctx.stroke();
   490	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd36b'; ctx.font = '800 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('WARDEN', 0, -38); ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   491	      ctx.fillStyle = '#2e2046'; roundRect(-34, 32, 68, 5, 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#c183ff'; ctx.fillRect(-34, 32, 68 * Math.max(0, e.hp / e.maxHp), 5);
   492	    } else if (e.type === 'watcher') {
   493	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#382b23'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   494	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe0a8'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-17, 0); ctx.lineTo(17, 0); ctx.stroke();
   495	    } else if (e.type === 'skitter') {
   496	      ctx.rotate(e.phase * .4); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -15); ctx.lineTo(12, 12); ctx.lineTo(-12, 12); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   497	      ctx.fillStyle = '#401c32'; ctx.fillRect(-3, 3, 6, 5);
   498	    } else {
   499	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 14, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#421b35'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(4, -3, 4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   500	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffb0a4'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-13, 9); ctx.lineTo(-20, 15); ctx.moveTo(13, 9); ctx.lineTo(20, 15); ctx.stroke();
   501	    }
   502	    ctx.restore();

   504	  function drawParticles() {

    99	    for (const p of pool.sort(() => rng() - .5)) {
   100	      if (!points.some(q => q.x === p.x && q.y === p.y)) points.push(p);
   101	      if (points.length === count) return points;
   102	    }
   103	    return points;
   104	  }
   105	  function makeLevel(index, seedBump = 0) {
   106	    const rng = mulberry32(0x41C64E6D + index * 0x9E3779B9 + seedBump * 0x6D2B79F5);
   107	    const stage = Math.floor(index / 6);
   108	    const w = index < 6 ? 7 : index < 18 ? 8 : 9;
   109	    const h = index < 6 ? 7 : index < 12 ? 7 : 8;
   110	    const count = index < 6 ? 1 : index < 12 ? 2 : index < 24 ? 3 : 4;
   111	    const targets = makeTargetPoints(w, h, count, rng).map((p, i) => ({ ...p, color: i % COLORS.length }));
   112	    const occupied = new Set(targets.map(p => key(p.x, p.y)));
   113	    let worker = { x: Math.floor(w / 2), y: Math.floor(h / 2) };
   114	    if (occupied.has(key(worker.x, worker.y))) {
   115	      const options = [];
   116	      for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) if (!occupied.has(key(x, y))) options.push({ x, y });
   117	      worker = pick(rng, options);
   118	    }
   119	    const state = { worker, crates: targets.map(p => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y, color: p.color })) };
   120	    const trace = [cloneState(state)];
   121	    const reverseOps = [];
   122	    let pushes = 0;
   123	    const desiredPushes = Math.min(5 + stage * 2, Math.max(3, count * 3));
   124	    const goalSteps = 18 + index * 5;
   125	    const runReverse = () => {
   126	      const candidates = reverseCandidates(state, w, h);
   127	      if (!candidates.length) return false;
   128	      const pushMoves = candidates.filter(c => c.kind === "push");
   129	      let op;
   130	      const walkMoves = candidates.filter(c => c.kind === "walk");
   131	      if (pushMoves.length && (pushes < desiredPushes || !walkMoves.length || rng() < 0.34)) {
   132	        op = pick(rng, pushMoves);
   133	        pushes++;
   134	      } else {
   135	        op = pick(rng, walkMoves);
   136	      }
   137	      reverseOps.push(applyReverse(state, op));
   138	      trace.push(cloneState(state));
   139	      return true;
   140	    };
   141	    for (let i = 0; i < goalSteps; i++) runReverse();
   142	    let guard = 0;
   143	    while ((solveState(state, targets) || pushes < Math.min(desiredPushes, goalSteps / 5)) && guard++ < 80) runReverse();
   144	
   145	    const traceCells = new Set();
   146	    trace.forEach(s => {
   147	      traceCells.add(key(s.worker.x, s.worker.y));
   148	      s.crates.forEach(c => traceCells.add(key(c.x, c.y)));
   149	    });
   150	    const free = [];
   151	    for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) {
   152	      if (!traceCells.has(key(x, y))) free.push({ x, y });
   153	    }
   154	    const used = new Set();
   155	    const takeFree = () => {
   156	      const choices = free.filter(p => !used.has(key(p.x, p.y)));
   157	      if (!choices.length) return null;
   158	      const p = pick(rng, choices);
   159	      used.add(key(p.x, p.y));
   160	      return p;
   161	    };
   162	    const conveyors = [];
   163	    const gates = [];
   164	    let plate = null;
   165	    let door = null;
   166	    if (index >= 12) {
   167	      for (let i = 0; i < (index >= 18 ? 3 : 2); i++) {
   168	        const p = takeFree();
   169	        if (p) {
   170	          const d = pick(rng, DIRS);
   171	          conveyors.push({ ...p, dx: d.x, dy: d.y });
   172	        }
   173	      }
   174	    }
   175	    if (index >= 18) {
   176	      const p = takeFree();
   177	      if (p) {
   178	        const d = pick(rng, DIRS);
   179	        gates.push({ ...p, dx: d.x, dy: d.y });
   180	      }
   181	    }
   182	    if (index >= 24) {
   183	      plate = takeFree();
   184	      door = takeFree();
   185	    }
   186	    const walls = new Set();
   187	    const wallCount = Math.min(free.length - used.size, index < 6 ? 1 : 2 + stage);
   188	    for (let i = 0; i < wallCount; i++) {
   189	      const p = takeFree();
   190	      if (p) walls.add(key(p.x, p.y));
   191	    }
   192	    if (reverseOps.length < Math.max(16, Math.floor(goalSteps * .75)) && seedBump < 20) return makeLevel(index, seedBump + 1);
   193	    const mechanics = index < 6 ? "PUSH ROUTE" : index < 12 ? "DUAL CORE" : index < 18 ? "COLOR SORT" : index < 24 ? "FLOW GATES" : "LOCK SEQUENCE";
   194	    return {
   195	      w, h, targets, worker: state.worker, crates: state.crates, walls, conveyors, gates, plate, door,
   196	      par: reverseOps.length, mechanics, proof: reverseOps.length > 0
   197	    };
   198	  }
   199	  function loadProgress() {
   200	    try {
   201	      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY) || "null");
   202	      if (saved && Array.isArray(saved.stars)) return {
   203	        unlocked: Math.max(0, saved.unlocked | 0),
   204	        stars: saved.stars.slice(0, 30).map(n => Math.max(0, Math.min(3, n | 0))),
   205	        best: Array.isArray(saved.best) ? saved.best.slice(0, 30).map(n => n > 0 ? n | 0 : 0) : []
   206	      };
   207	    } catch (_) {}
   208	    return { unlocked: 0, stars: [], best: [] };
   209	  }
   210	  function saveProgress() {
   211	    try { localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(progress)); } catch (_) {}
   212	  }
   213	  function startLevel(index) {
   214	    levelIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(levels.length - 1, index));
   215	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   216	    play = { worker: clonePoint(l.worker), crates: cloneCrates(l.crates), history: [], moves: 0, won: false, stars: 0 };
   217	    mode = "game";
   218	    pulse = 0;
   219	    particles = [];
   220	  }
   221	  function openLevels() { mode = "select"; pointer = null; }
   222	  function resetLevel() {
   223	    startLevel(levelIndex);
   224	    burstAt(195, 340, "#8ba5bb", 9);
   225	  }
   226	  function undo() {
   227	    if (!play || !play.history.length) return;
   228	    const previous = play.history.pop();
   229	    play.worker = previous.worker;
   230	    play.crates = previous.crates;
   231	    play.moves = previous.moves;
   232	    play.won = false;
   233	    play.stars = 0;
   234	    shake = 0;
   235	    pulse = .2;
   236	  }
   237	  function isDoorOpen() {
   238	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   239	    if (!l.door || !l.plate) return true;
   240	    return hasCrate(play.crates, l.plate.x, l.plate.y);
   240	    return hasCrate(play.crates, l.plate.x, l.plate.y);
   241	  }
   242	  function gateAt(x, y) { return levels[levelIndex].gates.find(g => g.x === x && g.y === y); }
   243	  function conveyorAt(x, y) { return levels[levelIndex].conveyors.find(c => c.x === x && c.y === y); }
   244	  function canEnter(from, to) {
   245	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   246	    if (!insideRoom(to.x, to.y, l.w, l.h) || l.walls.has(key(to.x, to.y))) return false;
   247	    if (l.door && l.door.x === to.x && l.door.y === to.y && !isDoorOpen()) return false;
   248	    const gate = gateAt(to.x, to.y);
   249	    if (gate && (to.x - from.x !== gate.dx || to.y - from.y !== gate.dy)) return false;
   250	    return true;
   251	  }
   252	  function resolveConveyor() {
   253	    const l = levels[levelIndex];
   254	    for (let n = 0; n < 6; n++) {
   255	      const belt = conveyorAt(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   256	      if (!belt) break;
   257	      const next = { x: play.worker.x + belt.dx, y: play.worker.y + belt.dy };
   258	      if (!canEnter(play.worker, next)) break;
   259	      const crate = getCrate(play.crates, next.x, next.y);
   260	      if (crate >= 0) {
   261	        const beyond = { x: next.x + belt.dx, y: next.y + belt.dy };
   262	        if (getCrate(play.crates, beyond.x, beyond.y) >= 0 || !canEnter(next, beyond)) break;
   263	        play.crates[crate].x = beyond.x;
   264	        play.crates[crate].y = beyond.y;
   265	      }
   266	      play.worker = next;
   267	      burstAt(cellCenter(next.x, next.y).x, cellCenter(next.x, next.y).y, "#9cecff", 2);
   268	    }
   269	  }
   270	  function tryMove(dx, dy) {
   271	    if (mode !== "game" || !play || play.won) return;
   272	    const from = clonePoint(play.worker);
   273	    const next = { x: from.x + dx, y: from.y + dy };
   274	    if (!canEnter(from, next)) { shake = .08; return; }
   275	    const crate = getCrate(play.crates, next.x, next.y);
   276	    if (crate >= 0) {
   277	      const beyond = { x: next.x + dx, y: next.y + dy };
   278	      if (getCrate(play.crates, beyond.x, beyond.y) >= 0 || !canEnter(next, beyond)) { shake = .08; return; }
   279	      play.history.push({ worker: clonePoint(play.worker), crates: cloneCrates(play.crates), moves: play.moves });
   280	      play.crates[crate].x = beyond.x;
   281	      play.crates[crate].y = beyond.y;
   282	      play.worker = next;
   283	    } else {
   284	      play.history.push({ worker: clonePoint(play.worker), crates: cloneCrates(play.crates), moves: play.moves });
   285	      play.worker = next;
   286	    }
   287	    play.moves++;
   288	    resolveConveyor();
   289	    const c = cellCenter(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   290	    burstAt(c.x, c.y, crate >= 0 ? COLORS[play.crates[crate].color].glow : "#9cecff", crate >= 0 ? 7 : 3);
   291	    pulse = .35;
   292	    if (solveState(play, levels[levelIndex].targets)) winLevel();
   293	  }
   294	  function winLevel() {
   295	    play.won = true;
   296	    play.stars = play.moves <= levels[levelIndex].par ? 3 : play.moves <= Math.ceil(levels[levelIndex].par * 1.3) ? 2 : 1;
   297	    progress.stars[levelIndex] = Math.max(progress.stars[levelIndex] || 0, play.stars);
   298	    progress.best[levelIndex] = progress.best[levelIndex] ? Math.min(progress.best[levelIndex], play.moves) : play.moves;
   299	    progress.unlocked = Math.max(progress.unlocked || 0, Math.min(levels.length - 1, levelIndex + 1));
   300	    saveProgress();
   301	    const c = cellCenter(play.worker.x, play.worker.y);
   302	    burstAt(c.x, c.y, "#ffe19a", 26);
   303	    shake = .35;
   304	  }
   305	  function burstAt(x, y, color, count) {
   306	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   307	      const a = Math.random() * TAU;
   308	      const speed = 18 + Math.random() * 62;
   309	      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * speed, vy: Math.sin(a) * speed - 12, life: .35 + Math.random() * .45, max: .75, color, size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 3 });
   310	    }
   311	  }
   312	  function update(dt) {
   313	    elapsed += dt;
   314	    pulse = Math.max(0, pulse - dt);
   315	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 1.8);
   316	    for (const p of particles) { p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 88 * dt; }
   317	    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
   318	  }
   319	  function resize() {
   320	    const width = window.innerWidth;
   321	    const height = window.innerHeight;
   322	    const rawDpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   323	    const dpr = Math.min(rawDpr, Math.max(.5, 960 / Math.max(width, height)));
   324	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(width * dpr));
   325	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(height * dpr));
   326	    view.dpr = dpr;
   327	    view.scale = Math.min(width / VW, height / VH);
   328	    view.ox = (width - VW * view.scale) / 2;
   329	    view.oy = (height - VH * view.scale) / 2;
   330	  }
   331	  function logicalPoint(e) {
   332	    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   333	    return { x: (e.clientX - r.left - view.ox) / view.scale, y: (e.clientY - r.top - view.oy) / view.scale };
   334	  }
   335	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   336	    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   337	    ctx.beginPath();
   338	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
   339	    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
   340	    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
   341	    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
   342	  }
   343	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align = "left", weight = 700) {
   344	    ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`;
   345	    ctx.textAlign = align; ctx.textBaseline = "middle"; ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   346	  }
   347	  function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width = 1) {
   348	    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke();
   349	  }
   350	  function drawBackground() {

   353	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   354	    ctx.globalAlpha = .16;
   355	    for (let x = 10; x < VW; x += 20) line(x, 0, x, VH, "#1f3947");
   356	    for (let y = 8; y < VH; y += 20) line(0, y, VW, y, "#1f3947");
   357	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   358	    ctx.fillStyle = "#142431"; ctx.fillRect(0, 69, VW, 1); ctx.fillRect(0, VH - 113, VW, 1);
   359	  }
   360	  function drawHeader() {

   372	  function button(x, y, w, h, label, fill, accent, size = 11, disabled = false) {

   380	  function boardMetrics(l) {
   381	    const cell = Math.min(46, (VW - 38) / l.w, 392 / l.h);
   382	    return { cell, x: (VW - l.w * cell) / 2, y: 104 + (392 - l.h * cell) / 2 };
   383	  }
   384	  function cellCenter(x, y) {
   385	    const m = boardMetrics(levels[levelIndex]);

   387	  }
   388	  function tileRect(m, x, y, inset = 2) {
   389	    return { x: m.x + x * m.cell + inset, y: m.y + y * m.cell + inset, w: m.cell - inset * 2, h: m.cell - inset * 2 };
   390	  }
   530	    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0); ctx.fillStyle = "#091018"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   531	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr * view.scale, 0, 0, view.dpr * view.scale, view.dpr * view.ox, view.dpr * view.oy);

   535	  function hit(x, y, r) { return x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h; }
   536	  function handleClick(p) {
   537	    if (mode === "select") {
   538	      if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 296, y: 10, w: 80, h: 40 }) || hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 24, y: 636, w: 342, h: 48 })) { startLevel(levelIndex); return; }
   539	      for (let i = 0; i < levels.length; i++) if (hit(p.x, p.y, selectCardRect(i)) && i <= (progress.unlocked || 0)) { startLevel(i); return; }
   540	      return;
   541	    }
   542	    if (play.won) {
   543	      if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 50, y: 388, w: 136, h: 52 })) { resetLevel(); return; }
   544	      if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 204, y: 388, w: 136, h: 52 })) { levelIndex < levels.length - 1 ? startLevel(levelIndex + 1) : openLevels(); return; }
   545	      return;
   546	    }
   547	    if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 294, y: 10, w: 82, h: 40 })) { resetLevel(); return; }
   548	    if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 20, y: 596, w: 168, h: 62 })) { undo(); return; }
   549	    if (hit(p.x, p.y, { x: 202, y: 596, w: 170, h: 62 })) { openLevels(); return; }
   550	  }
   551	  function pointerDown(e) {
   552	    e.preventDefault(); const p = logicalPoint(e); pointer = { id: e.pointerId, x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y }; canvas.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
   553	  }
   554	  function pointerUp(e) {
   555	    e.preventDefault(); if (!pointer || pointer.id !== e.pointerId) return; const p = logicalPoint(e); const dx = p.x - pointer.sx; const dy = p.y - pointer.sy; const was = pointer; pointer = null;
   556	    if (mode === "game" && !play.won && (Math.abs(dx) > 24 || Math.abs(dy) > 24) && was.sy > 78 && was.sy < 590) {
   557	      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) tryMove(dx > 0 ? 1 : -1, 0); else tryMove(0, dy > 0 ? 1 : -1);
   558	    } else if (Math.abs(dx) < 16 && Math.abs(dy) < 16) handleClick(p);
   559	  }
   560	  function keyDown(e) {
   561	    const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   562	    if (["arrowup", "arrowdown", "arrowleft", "arrowright", " "].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
   563	    if (mode === "select") {
   564	      if (k === "escape" || k === "enter" || k === " ") startLevel(levelIndex);
   565	      return;
   566	    }
   567	    if (play.won) {
   568	      if (k === "enter" || k === " ") { levelIndex < levels.length - 1 ? startLevel(levelIndex + 1) : openLevels(); e.preventDefault(); }
   569	      if (k === "escape") openLevels();
   570	      return;
   571	    }
   572	    if (k === "arrowup" || k === "w") tryMove(0, -1);
   573	    else if (k === "arrowdown" || k === "s") tryMove(0, 1);
   574	    else if (k === "arrowleft" || k === "a") tryMove(-1, 0);
   575	    else if (k === "arrowright" || k === "d") tryMove(1, 0);
   576	    else if (k === "z") undo();
   577	    else if (k === "r") resetLevel();
   578	    else if (k === "escape") openLevels();
   579	  }
   580	  function loop(now) {
   581	    const dt = Math.min(.034, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)); lastFrame = now; update(dt); render(); requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   582	  }
   583	
   584	  levels = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => makeLevel(i));
   585	  progress.unlocked = Math.min(29, Math.max(0, progress.unlocked || 0));
   586	  startLevel(0);
   587	  resize();
   588	  window.addEventListener("resize", resize, { passive: true });
   589	  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", pointerDown, { passive: false });
   590	  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", pointerUp, { passive: false });
   591	  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { pointer = null; }, { passive: true });
   592	  canvas.addEventListener("touchmove", e => e.preventDefault(), { passive: false });
   593	  window.addEventListener("keydown", keyDown, { passive: false });
   594	  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   595	})();

   542	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   543	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); ctx.closePath();
   544	  }
   545	  function clamp(n, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n)); }
   546	  function distance(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
   547	  function circleRect(x, y, r, q) { const nx = clamp(x, q.x, q.x + q.w), ny = clamp(y, q.y, q.y + q.h); return Math.hypot(x - nx, y - ny) < r; }
   548	  function canvasPoint(ev) {
   549	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   550	    return { x: (ev.clientX - rect.left) * W / rect.width, y: (ev.clientY - rect.top) * H / rect.height };
   551	  }
   552	  function pressAt(x, y, id) {
   553	    input.pointer.x = x; input.pointer.y = y;
   554	    if (game.mode === 'done') {
   555	      if (x >= 40 && x <= 320 && y >= 278 && y <= 350) { resetRun('daily', dailySeed()); return; }
   556	      if (x >= 40 && x <= 320 && y >= 350 && y <= 428) { resetRun('practice'); return; }
   557	    }
   558	    if (y < 55 && x > 265) { resetRun('practice'); return; }
   559	    if (x < 142 && y > 505) { input.joy.active = true; input.joy.id = id; updateJoy(x, y); return; }
   560	    if (x > 210 && y > 500) { game.attackQueued = true; return; }
   561	    if (x > 270 && y > 425 && y < 515) { game.dashQueued = true; return; }
   562	  }
   563	  function updateJoy(x, y) {
   564	    const dx = x - input.joy.cx, dy = y - input.joy.cy, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy), max = 31;
   565	    const s = d > max ? max / d : 1;
   566	    input.joy.x = dx * s / max; input.joy.y = dy * s / max;
   567	  }
   568	  function releasePointer(id) {
   569	    if (input.joy.id === id) { input.joy.active = false; input.joy.id = null; input.joy.x = 0; input.joy.y = 0; }
   570	  }

   572	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', ev => { ev.preventDefault(); canvas.setPointerCapture?.(ev.pointerId); const q = canvasPoint(ev); pressAt(q.x, q.y, ev.pointerId); }, { passive: false });
   573	  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', ev => { if (input.joy.id === ev.pointerId) { ev.preventDefault(); const q = canvasPoint(ev); updateJoy(q.x, q.y); } }, { passive: false });
   574	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', ev => { ev.preventDefault(); releasePointer(ev.pointerId); }, { passive: false });
   575	  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', ev => releasePointer(ev.pointerId));

   589	  function resize() {
   590	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   591	    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   592	    const longAxis = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height) * dpr;
   593	    const cap = longAxis > 960 ? 960 / longAxis : 1;
   594	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.width * dpr * cap));
   595	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(rect.height * dpr * cap));
   596	    scaleX = rect.width / W; scaleY = rect.height / H;
   597	  }

   111	  var A = { ctx: null, master: null };
   112	  function ensureAudio() {
   113	    if (A.ctx) { if (A.ctx.state === 'suspended') A.ctx.resume(); return; }
   114	    var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   115	    if (!C) return;
   116	    try {
   117	      A.ctx = new C();
