   119	      A.master.gain.value = 0.22;
   120	      A.master.connect(A.ctx.destination);
   121	    } catch (err) { A.ctx = null; }
   122	  }
   123	  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
   124	    if (!A.ctx) return;
   125	    var t = A.ctx.currentTime;
   126	    var o = A.ctx.createOscillator(), g = A.ctx.createGain();
   127	    o.type = type || 'square';
   128	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   129	    if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, slideTo), t + dur);
   130	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   131	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, vol || 0.2), t + 0.006);
   132	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   133	    o.connect(g); g.connect(A.master);
   134	    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
   135	  }
   136	  var noiseBuf = null;
   137	  function noise(dur, vol, freq) {
   138	    if (!A.ctx) return;
   139	    if (!noiseBuf) {
   140	      noiseBuf = A.ctx.createBuffer(1, A.ctx.sampleRate * 0.5, A.ctx.sampleRate);
   141	      var d = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
   142	      for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
   143	    }
   144	    var t = A.ctx.currentTime;
   145	    var s = A.ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = noiseBuf;
   146	    var f = A.ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'lowpass';
   147	    f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq || 1200, t);
   148	    f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(120, t + dur);
   149	    var g = A.ctx.createGain();
   150	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.25, t);
   151	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   152	    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(A.master);
   153	    s.start(t); s.stop(t + dur);
   154	  }

   157	  var parts = [];
   158	  function spawnParts(x, y, n, color, speed, size, life) {
   159	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   160	      if (parts.length > 340) break;
   161	      var a = Math.random() * TAU, sp = speed * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.85);
   162	      parts.push({

   164	        life: (life || 0.5) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), max: life || 0.5,
   165	        s: size || 2.5, c: color
   166	      });
   167	    }
   168	  }
   169	  function updateParts(dt) {
   170	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {

   174	      p.life -= dt;
   175	      if (p.life <= 0) parts.splice(i, 1);
   176	    }
   177	  }

   184	      var s = p.s * (0.4 + a * 0.8);
   185	      c.fillRect(p.x - s * 0.5, p.y - s * 0.5, s, s);
   186	    }
   187	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   188	  }

   496	      if (b.x < -30 || b.x > W() + 30 || b.y < -46 || b.y > H() + 40) G.eb.splice(i, 1);
   497	    }
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  function collide() {
   501	    var i, j, b, e, dx, dy, p = G.p;
   502	    // player bullets vs enemies / boss
   503	    for (i = G.pb.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   504	      b = G.pb[i];
   505	      var gone = false;
   506	      for (j = G.en.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   507	        e = G.en[j];
   508	        if (e.st === 'wait') continue;
   509	        dx = b.x - e.x; dy = b.y - e.y;
   510	        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < e.r * e.r) {
   511	          damageEnemy(e, b.d, j);
   512	          SH.spawnParts(b.x, b.y, 1, '#fff2a8', 60, 2, 0.18);
   513	          sfx('hit');
   514	          gone = true; break;
   515	        }
   516	      }
   517	      if (gone) { G.pb.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   518	      var bo = G.boss;
   519	      if (bo && (bo.state === 'fight' || bo.state === 'break')) {
   520	        var hitPod = false;
   521	        for (var k = 0; k < bo.pods.length; k++) {
   522	          var pod = bo.pods[k];
   523	          if (pod.hp <= 0) continue;
   524	          dx = b.x - (bo.x + pod.ox); dy = b.y - (bo.y + pod.oy);
   525	          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < pod.r * pod.r) {
   526	            pod.hp -= b.d; pod.flash = 0.08;
   527	            addScore(b.d * 6 * mult());
   528	            SH.spawnParts(b.x, b.y, 1, '#fff2a8', 60, 2, 0.18);
   529	            if (pod.hp <= 0) {
   530	              SH.spawnParts(bo.x + pod.ox, bo.y + pod.oy, 22, '#ffd0a0', 180, 4, 0.65);
   531	              addScore(3000 * mult()); sfx('boom');
   532	              shake = Math.max(shake, 8); shakeT = 0.25;
   533	            }
   534	            hitPod = true; break;
   535	          }
   536	        }
   537	        if (hitPod) { G.pb.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   538	        if (bo.state === 'fight') {
   539	          dx = b.x - bo.x; dy = (b.y - bo.y) * 1.5;
   540	          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 34 * 34) {
   541	            var podsLeft = 0;
   542	            for (var q = 0; q < bo.pods.length; q++) if (bo.pods[q].hp > 0) podsLeft++;
   543	            var dmg = b.d * (podsLeft === 0 ? 1.35 : 1);
   544	            bo.hp -= dmg; bo.flash = 0.06;
   545	            addScore(dmg * 8 * mult());
   546	            SH.spawnParts(b.x, b.y, 1, '#fff2a8', 60, 2, 0.2);
   547	            sfx('hit');
   548	            G.pb.splice(i, 1);
   549	            if (bo.hp <= 0) {
   550	              if (bo.phaseIdx >= bo.def.phases.length - 1) {
   551	                bo.state = 'dying'; bo.dieT = 1.7; G.eb.length = 0; sfx('boom');
   552	              } else {
   553	                bo.state = 'break'; bo.brk = 1.5; G.eb.length = 0;
   554	                flash = 0.6; shake = 14; shakeT = 0.5; sfx('boom');
   555	                SH.spawnParts(bo.x, bo.y, 36, '#ffffff', 200, 4, 0.7);
   556	                addScore(6000 * mult());
   557	              }
   558	            }
   559	            continue;
   560	          }
   561	        }
   562	      }
   563	    }
   564	
   565	    // enemy bullets vs player (graze + hit)
   566	    if (!p.alive) return;
   567	    for (i = G.eb.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   568	      b = G.eb[i];
   569	      dx = b.x - p.x; dy = b.y - p.y;
   570	      var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
   571	      var hr = b.r + p.r;
   572	      if (d2 < hr * hr) {
   573	        if (p.inv <= 0) { playerHit(); return; }
   574	      } else {
   575	        var gr = b.r + (p.focus ? 15 : 12);
   576	        if (!b.gz && d2 < gr * gr && p.inv <= 0) {
   577	          b.gz = 1; G.grazes++;
   578	          G.meter = Math.min(90, G.meter + 2.5);
   579	          addScore(30 * mult());
   580	          if (grazeCd <= 0) { sfx('graze'); grazeCd = 0.05; }
   581	          SH.spawnParts(b.x, b.y, 1, '#ffffff', 40, 2, 0.2);
   582	        }
   583	      }
   584	    }
   585	    // body collision with enemies
   586	    for (j = G.en.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   587	      e = G.en[j];
   588	      if (e.st === 'wait') continue;
   589	      dx = e.x - p.x; dy = e.y - p.y;
   590	      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (e.r + p.r) * (e.r + p.r)) { if (p.inv <= 0) { playerHit(); return; } }
   591	    }
   592	    var bb = G.boss;
   593	    if (bb && bb.state === 'fight') {
   594	      dx = bb.x - p.x; dy = (bb.y - p.y) * 1.4;
   595	      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 30 * 30 && p.inv <= 0) playerHit();
   596	    }
   597	  }
   598	
   599	  /* ---------------- draw ---------------- */
   600	  function drawBG() {
   601	    var th = G.stage.theme;
   602	    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H());
   603	    g.addColorStop(0, th.sky[0]); g.addColorStop(1, th.sky[1]);
   604	    ctx.fillStyle = g;
   605	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
   606	    // parallax bands
   607	    ctx.fillStyle = th.band;
   608	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
   609	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   610	      var y = ((G.t * (18 + i * 12) + i * 190) % (H() + 240)) - 120;
   611	      var w = 90 + i * 34;
   612	      ctx.fillRect(((i * 97) % W()) - w * 0.2, y, w, 5);
   613	    }
   614	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   615	    ctx.fillStyle = th.star;
   616	    for (var s = 0; s < stars.length; s++) {
   617	      var st = stars[s];
   618	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25 + st.s * 0.28;
   619	      ctx.fillRect(st.x, st.y, st.s, st.s * 2.2);
   620	    }
   621	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   622	  }
   623	
   624	  function drawShip(x, y, focus, alpha) {
   625	    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
   626	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1b2c';
   627	    ctx.beginPath();
   628	    ctx.moveTo(x, y - 14); ctx.lineTo(x + 11, y + 10); ctx.lineTo(x, y + 5); ctx.lineTo(x - 11, y + 10);
   629	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   630	    ctx.strokeStyle = focus ? '#ffd166' : '#7ef9ff';
   631	    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
   632	    ctx.stroke();
   633	    ctx.fillStyle = focus ? '#ffd166' : '#7ef9ff';
   634	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - 10); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, y + 3); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   635	    // thruster
   636	    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
   637	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff9a5c';
   638	    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + 8, 4, 6 + Math.random() * 5);
   639	    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
   640	    if (focus) {
   641	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,0.85)';
   642	      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   643	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 13, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
   644	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
   645	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   646	    }
   647	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   648	  }
   649	
   650	  function drawEnemy(e) {
   651	    var c = e.flash > 0 ? '#ffffff' : e.color;
   652	    ctx.fillStyle = c;
   653	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
   654	    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   655	    ctx.save();
   656	    ctx.translate(e.x, e.y);
   657	    if (e.kind === 'drone') {
   658	      ctx.beginPath();
   659	      ctx.moveTo(0, e.r); ctx.lineTo(e.r, -e.r * 0.7); ctx.lineTo(0, -e.r * 0.2); ctx.lineTo(-e.r, -e.r * 0.7);
   660	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   661	    } else if (e.kind === 'pod') {
   662	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, e.r, e.r * 0.78, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   663	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
   664	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, e.r * 0.4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   665	    } else if (e.kind === 'orb') {
   666	      ctx.rotate(e.rot);
   667	      ctx.beginPath();
   668	      for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
   669	        var a = i * TAU / 6;
   670	        ctx[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * e.r, Math.sin(a) * e.r);
   671	      }
   672	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   673	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
   674	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, e.r * 0.3, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   675	    } else {
   676	      ctx.fillRect(-e.r, -e.r * 0.8, e.r * 2, e.r * 1.6);
   677	      ctx.strokeRect(-e.r, -e.r * 0.8, e.r * 2, e.r * 1.6);
   678	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
   679	      ctx.fillRect(-e.r * 0.5, -e.r * 0.3, e.r, e.r * 0.6);
   680	    }
   681	    ctx.restore();
   682	    // hp pip
   683	    if (e.hp < e.maxhp) {
   684	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
   685	      ctx.fillRect(e.x - e.r, e.y - e.r - 6, e.r * 2, 2.5);
   686	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8dff9c';
   687	      ctx.fillRect(e.x - e.r, e.y - e.r - 6, e.r * 2 * Math.max(0, e.hp / e.maxhp), 2.5);
   688	    }
   689	  }
   690	
   691	  function drawBoss() {
   692	    var b = G.boss;
   693	    if (!b) return;
   694	    var bf = b.flash > 0;
   695	    ctx.save();
   696	    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
   697	    // arms
   698	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)';
   699	    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
   700	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-48, 8); ctx.lineTo(48, 8); ctx.stroke();
   701	    // body
   702	    ctx.fillStyle = bf ? '#ffffff' : '#22304f';
   703	    ctx.strokeStyle = ['#ff8ab5', '#ffd166', '#7ef9ff'][b.phaseIdx];
   704	    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
   705	    ctx.beginPath();
   706	    ctx.moveTo(0, -30); ctx.lineTo(30, -8); ctx.lineTo(22, 26); ctx.lineTo(-22, 26); ctx.lineTo(-30, -8);
   707	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   708	    ctx.fillStyle = bf ? '#ffffff' : ['#ff8ab5', '#ffd166', '#7ef9ff'][b.phaseIdx];
   709	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 9 + Math.sin(b.t * 5) * 1.5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   710	    ctx.restore();
   711	    // pods
   712	    for (var i = 0; i < b.pods.length; i++) {
   713	      var p = b.pods[i];
   714	      if (p.hp <= 0) continue;
   715	      var px = b.x + p.ox, py = b.y + p.oy;
   716	      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(px, py); ctx.rotate(b.t * 1.2 * (i ? -1 : 1));
   717	      ctx.fillStyle = p.flash > 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#3b2a52';
   718	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffb14c'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   719	      ctx.beginPath();
   720	      for (var k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
   721	        var a = k * TAU / 6;
   722	        ctx[k ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * p.r, Math.sin(a) * p.r);
   723	      }
   724	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   725	      ctx.restore();
   726	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
   727	      ctx.fillRect(px - 13, py - 20, 26, 3);
   728	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffb14c';
   729	      ctx.fillRect(px - 13, py - 20, 26 * Math.max(0, p.hp / p.maxhp), 3);
   730	    }
   731	  }
   732	
   733	  function drawBullets() {
   734	    var buckets = {}, i, b;
   735	    for (i = 0; i < G.eb.length; i++) {
   736	      b = G.eb[i];
   737	      (buckets[b.c] || (buckets[b.c] = [])).push(b);
   738	    }
   739	    for (var c in buckets) {
   740	      var arr = buckets[c];
   741	      ctx.fillStyle = c;
   742	      ctx.beginPath();
   743	      for (i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
   744	        b = arr[i];
   745	        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.r, b.y);
   746	        ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, TAU);
   747	      }
   748	      ctx.fill();
   749	    }
   750	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)';
   751	    ctx.beginPath();
   752	    for (i = 0; i < G.eb.length; i++) {
   753	      b = G.eb[i];
   754	      ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.r * 0.45, b.y);
   755	      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 0.45, 0, TAU);
   756	    }
   757	    ctx.fill();
   758	    // player shots
   759	    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff3a6';
   760	    for (i = 0; i < G.pb.length; i++) {
   761	      b = G.pb[i];
   762	      ctx.fillRect(b.x - 1.6, b.y - 7, 3.2, 10);
   763	    }
   764	  }
   765	
   766	  function txt(s, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   767	    ctx.font = (weight || 'bold') + ' ' + size + 'px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
   768	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   769	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   770	    ctx.fillStyle = color;
   771	    ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
   772	  }

   774	  function drawHUD() {
   775	    var w = W(), h = H();
   776	    // top strip
   777	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,6,14,0.55)';
   778	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, 34);
   779	    txt(String(G.score).padStart(8, '0'), 8, 16, 13, '#ffffff');
   780	    txt('BEST ' + String(Math.max(best, G.score)).padStart(8, '0'), 8, 29, 9, '#8fa6c8');
   781	    txt('x' + mult().toFixed(1), w - 8, 16, 13, G.meter > 5 ? '#ffd166' : '#8fa6c8', 'right');
   782	    txt('GRAZE ' + G.grazes, w - 8, 29, 9, '#8fa6c8', 'right');
   783	    txt('ST ' + (G.stageIdx + 1) + '/3', w * 0.5, 16, 11, '#7ef9ff', 'center');
   784	
   785	    // boss bar
   786	    var b = G.boss;
   787	    if (b && b.state !== 'enter') {
   788	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
   789	      ctx.fillRect(20, 40, w - 40, 7);
   790	      var frac = Math.max(0, b.hp / b.maxhp);
   791	      ctx.fillStyle = ['#ff5f9e', '#ffb14c', '#62e8ff'][b.phaseIdx];
   792	      ctx.fillRect(20, 40, (w - 40) * frac, 7);
   793	      for (var i = 0; i < b.def.phases.length; i++) {
   794	        ctx.fillStyle = i <= b.phaseIdx ? '#ffffff' : '#54607a';
   795	        ctx.fillRect(20 + i * 9, 51, 6, 3);
   796	      }
   797	      txt(b.name, w - 20, 55, 9, '#c8d6ee', 'right');
   798	    }
   799	
   800	    // lives / bombs
   801	    for (var l = 0; l < Math.max(0, G.lives); l++) {
   802	      var lx = 12 + l * 14, ly = h - 20;
   803	      ctx.fillStyle = '#7ef9ff';
   804	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx, ly - 7); ctx.lineTo(lx + 5, ly + 4); ctx.lineTo(lx - 5, ly + 4);
   805	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   806	    }
   807	    for (var bm = 0; bm < G.bombs; bm++) {
   808	      var bx = 12 + bm * 14, by = h - 38;
   809	      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
   810	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx, by - 5); ctx.lineTo(bx + 5, by); ctx.lineTo(bx, by + 5); ctx.lineTo(bx - 5, by);
   811	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   812	    }
   813	
   814	    // bomb button
   815	    var bb = bombBtn();
   816	    ctx.globalAlpha = G.bombs > 0 ? 0.85 : 0.3;
   817	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,0.16)';
   818	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bb.x, bb.y, bb.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
   819	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd166'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   820	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bb.x, bb.y, bb.r, 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
   821	    txt('BOMB', bb.x, bb.y - 2, 11, '#ffd166', 'center');
   822	    txt(String(G.bombs), bb.x, bb.y + 13, 12, '#ffffff', 'center');
   823	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   824	
   825	    // intro line
   826	    if (G.intro > 0) {
   827	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, G.intro / 1.2);
   828	      txt('DRAG TO FLY  ·  2ND FINGER = FOCUS  ·  BOMB', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.72, 11, '#ffffff', 'center');
   829	      txt('(keys: arrows / WASD · shift focus · space bomb)', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.72 + 14, 8.5, '#9fb2d0', 'center', 'normal');
   830	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   831	    }
   832	
   833	    // banner
   834	    if (G.bannerT > 0) {
   835	      var a = Math.min(1, G.bannerT / 0.6);
   836	      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
   837	      txt(G.banner, W() * 0.5, H() * 0.4, 20, '#ffffff', 'center');
   838	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   839	    }
   840	    // boss warning
   841	    if (G.bossWarn > 0) {
   842	      var bl = Math.sin(G.t * 18) > 0 ? 1 : 0.25;
   843	      ctx.globalAlpha = bl;
   844	      txt('WARNING', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.45, 26, '#ff5f9e', 'center');
   845	      txt(G.stage.boss.name + ' INBOUND', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.45 + 22, 12, '#ffd166', 'center');
   846	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   847	    }
   848	  }
   849	
   850	  function drawOverlay() {
   851	    if (G.state !== 'over' && G.state !== 'win') return;
   852	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(3,5,12,0.78)';
   853	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
   854	    var win = G.state === 'win';
   855	    txt(win ? 'ALL CLEAR' : 'SHIP LOST', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.38, 30, win ? '#7ef9ff' : '#ff5f9e', 'center');
   856	    if (win) txt('1CC — THREE STAGES DOWN', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.38 + 22, 11, '#ffd166', 'center');
   857	    txt('SCORE  ' + G.score, W() * 0.5, H() * 0.5, 16, '#ffffff', 'center');
   858	    txt('BEST   ' + best, W() * 0.5, H() * 0.5 + 20, 12, '#8fa6c8', 'center');
   859	    txt('GRAZE  ' + G.grazes, W() * 0.5, H() * 0.5 + 38, 12, '#8fa6c8', 'center');
   860	    if (G.overT > 0.6) {
   861	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6 + Math.sin(G.t * 5) * 0.4;
   862	      txt('TAP  ·  ENTER  TO RESTART', W() * 0.5, H() * 0.66, 13, '#ffffff', 'center');
   863	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   864	    }
   865	  }
   866	
   867	  function draw() {
   868	    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
   869	    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
   870	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, SH.canvas.width, SH.canvas.height);
   871	    SH.applyTransform();
   872	    if (shake > 0.2) {
   873	      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
   874	    }
   875	    drawBG();
   876	    if (G.bombFx > 0) {
   877	      var r = (0.75 - G.bombFx) * 900;
   878	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,' + Math.max(0, G.bombFx) + ')';
   879	      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
   880	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(G.p.x, G.p.y, Math.max(1, r), 0, TAU); ctx.stroke();
   881	    }
   882	    for (var i = 0; i < G.en.length; i++) if (G.en[i].st !== 'wait') drawEnemy(G.en[i]);
   883	    drawBoss();
   884	    SH.drawParts(ctx);
   885	    drawBullets();
   886	    if (G.state !== 'over' && G.state !== 'win') {
   887	      var p = G.p;
   888	      var alpha = p.inv > 0 ? (Math.floor(G.t * 22) % 2 ? 0.35 : 1) : 1;
   889	      drawShip(p.x, p.y, p.focus, alpha);
   890	    }
   891	    if (flash > 0) {
   892	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + Math.min(0.75, flash) + ')';
   893	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
   894	    }
   895	    if (hitFlash > 0) {
   896	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,110,' + Math.min(0.4, hitFlash * 0.5) + ')';
   897	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W(), H());
   898	    }
   899	    drawHUD();
   900	    drawOverlay();
   901	  }
   902	
   903	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   904	  var last = 0;
   905	  function frame(ts) {
   906	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   907	    if (!last) last = ts;

   141	  function runPattern(o, pat, dt) {
   142	    if (!pat) return;
   143	    if (o.sa === undefined) { o.sa = Math.random() * TAU; o.ft = pat.period * 0.5; o.bl = 0; o.bt = 0; o.wr = SH.rngObj(pat.seed || 7); }
   144	    var k = pat.kind;
   145	    if (k === 'spiral' || k === 'arms') {
   140	
   141	  function runPattern(o, pat, dt) {
   142	    if (!pat) return;
   143	    if (o.sa === undefined) { o.sa = Math.random() * TAU; o.ft = pat.period * 0.5; o.bl = 0; o.bt = 0; o.wr = SH.rngObj(pat.seed || 7); }
   144	    var k = pat.kind;
   145	    if (k === 'spiral' || k === 'arms') {
   146	      o.sa += pat.rate * dt;
   147	      o.ft -= dt;
   148	      if (o.ft <= 0) {
   149	        o.ft += pat.period;
   150	        var arms = pat.arms;
   151	        for (var i = 0; i < arms; i++) {
   152	          var a = o.sa + i * TAU / arms;
   153	          if (pat.sweep) a += Math.sin(o.sa * 0.5) * 0.6;
   154	          eb(o.x, o.y, a, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   155	        }
   156	      }
   157	      return;
   158	    }
   159	    o.ft -= dt;
   160	    if (o.ft <= 0) {
   161	      o.ft += pat.period;
   162	      if (k === 'aimed') { o.bl = pat.burst || 1; o.bt = 0; }
   163	      else if (k === 'fan') {
   164	        var base = aimAt(o.x, o.y), n = pat.n;
   165	        for (var f = 0; f < n; f++) {
   166	          var ang = base + (f / (n - 1) - 0.5) * pat.spread;
   167	          eb(o.x, o.y, ang, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   168	        }
   169	      } else if (k === 'ring') {
   170	        var off = pat.aim ? aimAt(o.x, o.y) : 0;
   171	        o.sa = (o.sa || 0) + (pat.spin || 0);
   172	        for (var g = 0; g < pat.n; g++) {
   173	          eb(o.x, o.y, off + o.sa + g * TAU / pat.n, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   174	        }
   175	      } else if (k === 'wall') {
   176	        var gc = 40 + o.wr.r() * (W() - 80);
   177	        var step = W() / pat.count;
   178	        for (var w = 0; w < pat.count; w++) {
   179	          var wx = step * 0.5 + w * step;
   180	          if (Math.abs(wx - gc) < pat.gap * 0.5) continue;
   181	          eb(wx, o.y, Math.PI / 2, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   182	        }
   183	      } else if (k === 'rain') {
   184	        var rx = 16 + o.wr.r() * (W() - 32);
   185	        eb(rx, -8, Math.PI / 2 + (o.wr.r() - 0.5) * 0.5, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   186	      }
   187	    }
   188	    if (o.bl > 0) {
   189	      o.bt -= dt;
   190	      if (o.bt <= 0) {
   191	        o.bt = 0.1;
   192	        o.bl--;
   193	        var b0 = aimAt(o.x, o.y), nn = pat.n;
   194	        for (var q = 0; q < nn; q++) {
   195	          var aa = b0 + (nn === 1 ? 0 : (q / (nn - 1) - 0.5) * pat.spread * nn * 0.5);
   196	          eb(o.x, o.y, aa, pat.speed, pat.r, pat.c);
   197	        }
   198	      }
   199	    }
   200	  }

   267	  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   268	  function update(dt) {
   269	    G.t += dt;
   270	    if (soundCd > 0) soundCd -= dt;
   271	    if (grazeCd > 0) grazeCd -= dt;
   272	    if (shakeT > 0) { shakeT -= dt; if (shakeT <= 0) shake = 0; } else shake *= Math.pow(0.02, dt);
   273	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 2.2);
   274	    hitFlash = Math.max(0, hitFlash - dt * 1.6);
   275	    if (G.bombFx > 0) G.bombFx -= dt;
   276	    if (G.bannerT > 0) G.bannerT -= dt;
   277	    if (G.intro > 0) G.intro -= dt;
   278	    SH.updateParts(dt);
   279	
   280	    for (var s = 0; s < stars.length; s++) {
   281	      var st = stars[s];
   282	      st.y += st.v * dt * (1 + G.stageIdx * 0.15);
   283	      if (st.y > H() + 4) { st.y = -4; st.x = Math.random() * W(); }
   284	    }
   285	
   286	    if (G.state === 'over' || G.state === 'win') { G.overT += dt; return; }
   287	
   288	    if (G.state === 'clear') {
   289	      G.clearT -= dt;
   290	      updateBullets(dt, true);
   291	      if (G.clearT <= 0) {
   292	        if (G.stageIdx >= 2) {
   293	          G.state = 'win'; G.overT = 0;
   294	          if (G.score > best) { best = G.score; saveBest(best); }
   295	        } else { G.state = 'play'; beginStage(G.stageIdx + 1); }
   296	      }
   297	      return;
   298	    }
   299	
   300	    G.stageT += dt;
   301	    G.meter = Math.max(0, G.meter - 5 * dt);
   302	    updatePlayer(dt);
   303	
   304	    // waves
   305	    var stg = G.stage;
   306	    while (G.waveIdx < stg.waves.length && G.stageT >= stg.waves[G.waveIdx].t) {
   307	      spawnWave(stg.waves[G.waveIdx]); G.waveIdx++;
   308	    }
   309	    if (!G.boss && G.waveIdx >= stg.waves.length && G.stageT >= stg.bossAt) {
   310	      if (G.bossWarn === 0) { G.bossWarn = 2.2; sfx('warn'); }
   311	    }
   312	    if (G.bossWarn > 0 && !G.boss) {
   313	      G.bossWarn -= dt;
   314	      if (G.bossWarn <= 0) { spawnBoss(); G.bossWarn = 0; }
   315	    }
   316	
   317	    updateEnemies(dt);
   318	    updateBoss(dt);
   319	    updateBullets(dt, false);
   320	    collide();
   321	  }
   322	
   323	  function updatePlayer(dt) {
   324	    var p = G.p;
   325	    if (p.inv > 0) p.inv -= dt;
   326	    if (p.hurt > 0) p.hurt -= dt;
   327	
   328	    // focus: 2nd finger down, or shift
   329	    var extra = 0;
   330	    for (var i = 0; i < input.pointers.length; i++) if (!input.pointers[i].bomb && input.pointers[i].id !== G.driveId) extra++;
   331	    p.focus = extra > 0 || !!(input.keys['ShiftLeft'] || input.keys['ShiftRight']);
   332	
   333	    // relative drag: ship follows the finger 1:1 from wherever it was grabbed
   334	    if (G.driveId !== null) {
   335	      var d = null;
   336	      for (var j = 0; j < input.pointers.length; j++) if (input.pointers[j].id === G.driveId) d = input.pointers[j];
   337	      if (d) {
   338	        var f = p.focus ? 0.42 : 1;
   339	        p.x += (d.x - G.anchorX) * f;
   340	        p.y += (d.y - G.anchorY) * f;
   341	        G.anchorX = d.x; G.anchorY = d.y;
   342	        G.dragX = p.x; G.dragY = p.y;
   343	      }
   344	    }
   345	    // keyboard
   346	    var kx = (key('ArrowRight', 'KeyD') ? 1 : 0) - (key('ArrowLeft', 'KeyA') ? 1 : 0);
   347	    var ky = (key('ArrowDown', 'KeyS') ? 1 : 0) - (key('ArrowUp', 'KeyW') ? 1 : 0);
   348	    if (kx || ky) {
   349	      var m = Math.sqrt(kx * kx + ky * ky) || 1;
   350	      var sp = p.focus ? 108 : 258;
   351	      p.x += (kx / m) * sp * dt; p.y += (ky / m) * sp * dt;
   352	      G.dragX = p.x; G.dragY = p.y;
   353	    }
   354	    p.x = clamp(p.x, 10, W() - 10);
   355	    p.y = clamp(p.y, 20, H() - 16);
   356	
   357	    // auto fire
   358	    p.fire -= dt;
   359	    if (p.fire <= 0) {
   360	      if (p.focus) {
   361	        p.fire = 0.07;
   362	        pb(p.x, p.y - 10, 0, -760, 1.5);
   363	        pb(p.x - 5, p.y - 6, 0, -740, 1.1);
   364	        pb(p.x + 5, p.y - 6, 0, -740, 1.1);
   365	      } else {
   366	        p.fire = 0.085;
   367	        pb(p.x - 6, p.y - 8, 0, -700, 1.2);
   368	        pb(p.x + 6, p.y - 8, 0, -700, 1.2);
   369	        pb(p.x - 9, p.y - 4, -150, -640, 0.7);
   370	        pb(p.x + 9, p.y - 4, 150, -640, 0.7);
   371	      }
   372	      sfx('shot');
   373	    }
   374	  }

   215	  const FX = {
   215	  const FX = {
   216	    parts: [],
   217	    shakeT: 0, shakeMag: 0,
   218	    texts: [],
   219	    MAX: 220,
   220	    burst(x, y, z, n, color, spd, opt) {
   221	      opt = opt || {};
   222	      for (let i = 0; i < n && this.parts.length < this.MAX; i++) {
   223	        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
   224	        const s = spd * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8);
   225	        this.parts.push({
   226	          x: x, y: y, z: z,
   227	          vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - (opt.up || 0),
   228	          life: opt.life || (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.4),
   229	          max: opt.life || 0.7,
   230	          r: opt.r || (2 + Math.random() * 3),
   231	          c: color, g: opt.g === undefined ? 900 : opt.g
   232	        });
   233	      }
   234	    },
   235	    text(x, y, z, str, color) {
   236	      if (this.texts.length > 18) this.texts.shift();
   237	      this.texts.push({ x: x, y: y, z: z, s: str, c: color, life: 0.75, max: 0.75 });
   238	    },
   239	    shake(mag, dur) {
   240	      if (mag > this.shakeMag || this.shakeT <= 0) { this.shakeMag = mag; }
   241	      this.shakeT = Math.max(this.shakeT, dur);
   242	    },
   243	    update(dt) {
   244	      for (let i = this.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   245	        const p = this.parts[i];
   246	        p.life -= dt;
   247	        if (p.life <= 0) { this.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   248	        p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += p.g * dt;
   249	        if (p.y > 0) { p.y = 0; p.vy *= -0.35; p.vx *= 0.6; }
   250	      }
   251	      for (let i = this.texts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   252	        const t = this.texts[i];
   253	        t.life -= dt; t.y += 42 * dt;
   254	        if (t.life <= 0) this.texts.splice(i, 1);
   255	      }
   256	      if (this.shakeT > 0) { this.shakeT -= dt; if (this.shakeT <= 0) this.shakeMag = 0; }
   257	    },
   258	    offset() {
   259	      if (this.shakeT <= 0) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
   260	      const m = this.shakeMag * Math.min(1, this.shakeT * 6);
   261	      return { x: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m, y: (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * m };
   262	    },
   263	    clear() { this.parts.length = 0; this.texts.length = 0; this.shakeT = 0; this.shakeMag = 0; }

    99	  /* ================= stage generation ================= */
   100	  function buildStage(n) {
   101	    L = segLen();
   102	    const rng = makeRng(G.seed + n * 7919);
   103	    G.stage = n;
   104	    G.seg = 0; G.camX = 0; G.camLock = null; G.goT = 0;
   105	    G.foes = []; G.items = []; G.props = []; G.shots = []; G.pending = []; G.boss = null;
   106	    G.bossName = BOSS_NAMES[(n - 1) % BOSS_NAMES.length];
   107	    G.blockName = BLOCK_NAMES[(n - 1) % BLOCK_NAMES.length];
   108	    G.waves = [];
   109	    const diff = 1 + (n - 1) * 0.28;
   110	
   111	    for (let s = 0; s < SEGS; s++) {
   112	      const start = s * L;
   113	      // props & items
   114	      const nProps = rng.int(3, 6);
   115	      for (let i = 0; i < nProps; i++) {
   116	        G.props.push({
   117	          x: start + rng.range(W * 0.4, L - W * 0.3),
   118	          z: rng.pick(LANES) + rng.range(-0.06, 0.06),
   119	          kind: rng.pick(['bin', 'barrel', 'bin']),
   120	          hp: 2, hitT: 0
   121	        });
   122	      }
   123	      if (s < SEGS - 1 && rng() < 0.85) {
   124	        G.items.push(mkItem('pipe', start + rng.range(W * 0.5, L - W * 0.4), rng.pick(LANES)));
   125	      }
   126	      if (rng() < 0.7) {
   127	        G.items.push(mkItem('crate', start + rng.range(W * 0.5, L - W * 0.4), rng.pick(LANES)));
   128	      }
   129	      // waves
   130	      if (s < SEGS - 1) {
   131	        const wCount = s === 0 ? 2 : (rng() < 0.5 ? 2 : 3);
   132	        for (let w = 0; w < wCount; w++) {
   133	          const list = [];
   134	          const size = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.round(rng.range(0, 1.4) + s * 0.6 + diff * 0.7));
   135	          for (let k = 0; k < size; k++) {
   136	            let t = 'rusher';
   137	            const r = rng();
   138	            if (r < 0.30) t = 'rusher';
   139	            else if (r < 0.52) t = 'tosser';
   140	            else if (r < 0.72) t = 'acro';
   141	            else if (r < 0.88) t = 'rusher';
   142	            else t = 'heavy';
   143	            if (s === 0 && w === 0 && (t === 'heavy')) t = 'rusher';
   144	            list.push(t);
   145	            if (t === 'acro') list.push('acro'); // twins
   146	          }
   147	          G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: wCount === 2 ? (w === 0 ? 0.18 : 0.96) : (w * 0.42 + 0.14), list: list, done: false });
   148	        }
   149	      } else {
   150	        G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: 0.20, list: ['rusher', 'rusher', 'tosser'], done: false });
   151	        G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: 0.92, list: ['BOSS'], done: false });
   152	      }
   153	    }
   154	    buildSky();
   155	    banner('STAGE ' + n + ' — ' + G.blockName, 2.0);
   156	  }

   158	  function mkItem(kind, x, z) {
   159	    return { kind: kind, x: x, z: z, y: 0, vy: 0, vx: 0, life: 0, dur: kind === 'pipe' ? 12 : 1 };
   160	  }

   164	  /* ================= spawning ================= */
   165	  function spawnFoe(type, side) {
   166	    const c = FOE[type === 'BOSS' ? 'boss' : type];
   167	    const isBoss = type === 'BOSS';
   168	    const diff = 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.22;
   169	    const x = side > 0 ? G.camX + W + 40 + Math.random() * 120 : G.camX - 40 - Math.random() * 120;
   170	    const f = {
   171	      kind: 'foe', type: isBoss ? 'boss' : type, x: x,
   172	      z: clamp(LANES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08, 0.05, 0.95),
   173	      y: 0, vx: 0, vz: 0, vy: 0, face: side > 0 ? -1 : 1,
   174	      maxhp: Math.round(c.hp * (isBoss ? 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.35 : diff)),
   175	      spd: c.spd, dmg: Math.round(c.dmg * (isBoss ? 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.16 : Math.min(2, diff))),
   176	      w: c.w, col: c.col, col2: c.col2, score: c.score,
   177	      state: 'idle', st: 0, inv: 0, hurtT: 0, downT: 0,
   178	      atk: null, atkT: 0, hasHit: false, think: Math.random() * 0.5,
   179	      cd: 0.6 + Math.random(), anim: Math.random() * 6, tx: 0, tz: 0,
   180	      armorFlash: 0, phase2: false, hitStack: 0, hitStackT: 0
   181	    };
   182	    f.hp = f.maxhp;
   183	    if (isBoss) { f.name = G.bossName; G.boss = f; }
   184	    G.foes.push(f);
   185	    return f;
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  function checkWaves() {
   189	    const segStart = G.seg * L;
   190	    const prog = (G.camX - segStart) / Math.max(1, L - W);
   191	    let pending = false;
   192	    for (const w of G.waves) {
   193	      if (w.done || w.seg !== G.seg) { if (!w.done && w.seg === G.seg) pending = true; continue; }
   194	      if (prog >= w.f - 0.001) {
   195	        w.done = true;
   196	        for (let i = 0; i < w.list.length; i++) G.pending.push(w.list[i]);
   197	        G.camLock = G.camX;
   198	      } else pending = true;
   199	    }
   200	    // trickle-spawn: never more than MAX_ACTIVE brawlers on screen at once
   201	    let side = G.spawnSide || 1;
   202	    while (G.pending.length && G.foes.length < MAX_ACTIVE) {
   203	      const t = G.pending.shift();
   204	      spawnFoe(t, side);
   205	      side = -side;
   206	      if (t === 'BOSS') { banner(G.bossName, 2.0); Audio.tone(90, 0.6, 'sawtooth', 0.25, 55); }
   207	    }
   208	    G.spawnSide = side;
   209	
   210	    const alive = G.foes.length > 0 || G.pending.length > 0;
   211	    if (alive) { if (G.camLock === null) G.camLock = G.camX; }
   212	    else if (!pending) { G.camLock = null; G.goT = 1; }
   213	    else if (!alive) { G.camLock = null; }
   214	  }

   217	  function inLane(a, b, tol) { return Math.abs(a.z - b.z) <= (tol || LANE_TOL); }

   219	  function hitReach(a, b, reach) {
   220	    const dx = b.x - a.x;
   220	    const dx = b.x - a.x;
   221	    if (a.face > 0 ? (dx < -b.w * BH * 0.4) : (dx > b.w * BH * 0.4)) return false;
   222	    return Math.abs(dx) <= reach + b.w * BH * 0.45;
   223	  }

   225	  function damageFoe(f, dmg, kd, dir, kind) {
   226	    if (f.inv > 0 || f.state === 'dying' || f.state === 'carried') return false;
   227	    let stagger = true;
   228	    if (f.type === 'heavy' && !kd && dmg < 15) {
   229	      // armors through jabs
   230	      f.hitStack++; f.hitStackT = 1.1;
   231	      dmg = Math.round(dmg * 0.5);
   232	      f.armorFlash = 0.18;
   233	      stagger = false;
   234	      if (f.hitStack >= 5) { f.hitStack = 0; stagger = true; kd = true; }
   235	    }
   236	    if (f.type === 'boss' && !kd && dmg < 15) {
   237	      f.hitStack++; f.hitStackT = 1.2;
   238	      if (f.hitStack < 4) { stagger = false; f.armorFlash = 0.15; }
   239	      else f.hitStack = 0;
   240	    }
   241	    f.hp -= dmg;
   242	    FX.burst(f.x, -BH * 0.55, f.z, stagger ? 8 : 4, stagger ? '#ffd76b' : '#cfd6e0', 190, { up: 60, life: 0.35 });
   243	    if (f.hp <= 0) {
   244	      f.hp = 0; f.state = 'down'; f.downT = 1e9; f.vy = -480; f.vx = dir * 320; f.dying = true;
   245	      G.score += f.score;
   246	      FX.text(f.x, -BH * 0.9, f.z, '+' + f.score, '#ffe27a');
   247	      FX.burst(f.x, -BH * 0.5, f.z, 16, f.col, 260, { up: 120 });
   248	      Audio.ko(); FX.shake(6 * (W / 960), 0.25);
   249	    } else if (kd) {
   250	      f.state = 'down'; f.downT = 0; f.vy = -430; f.vx = dir * 300; f.inv = 0.05;
   251	      Audio.heavy(); FX.shake(5 * (W / 960), 0.2);
   252	    } else if (stagger) {
   253	      f.state = 'hurt'; f.hurtT = 0.24; f.vx = dir * 130;
   254	      Audio.hit();
   255	    } else {
   256	      Audio.noise(0.08, 0.2, 1800, 2);
   257	      f.vx = dir * 40;
   258	    }
   259	    if (kind === 'combo') FX.shake(3 * (W / 960), 0.12);
   260	    return true;
   261	  }
   262	
   263	  function damagePlayer(p, dmg, kd, dir) {
   264	    if (p.inv > 0 || p.state === 'down' || G.mode !== 'play') return;
   265	    p.hp -= dmg;

   271	      Audio.ko(); FX.shake(9 * (W / 960), 0.35);
   272	    } else if (kd) {
   273	      p.state = 'down'; p.downT = 0; p.vy = -420; p.vx = dir * 280;
   274	      Audio.hurt(); FX.shake(6 * (W / 960), 0.22);
   275	    } else {
   276	      p.state = 'hurt'; p.hurtT = 0.26; p.vx = dir * 120; p.inv = 0.3;
   277	      Audio.hurt(); FX.shake(4 * (W / 960), 0.15);
   278	    }
   279	    p.atk = null; p.atkT = 0;
   280	  }

   282	  function smashProp(pr, dir) {

   284	    if (pr.hp > 0) { Audio.noise(0.1, 0.25, 700, 1); return; }

   291	    else if (r < 0.56) G.items.push(mkItem('pipe', pr.x, pr.z));
   292	    const i = G.props.indexOf(pr); if (i >= 0) G.props.splice(i, 1);
   293	  }

   296	  const ATTACKS = {
   297	    jab: { dur: 0.30, strike: 0.09, reach: BHf(0.58), dmg: 9, kd: false, knock: 1 },

   307	  function updatePlayer(p, dt) {
   308	    p.anim += dt * 8;
   309	    if (p.inv > 0) p.inv -= dt;
   310	    if (p.comboT > 0) { p.comboT -= dt; if (p.comboT <= 0) p.combo = 0; }
   760	  function updateCamera(dt, p) {
   761	    const segStart = G.seg * L;
   762	    const maxCam = G.seg * L + (L - W);
   763	    const minCam = Math.max(0, segStart - W);
   764	    let target = p.x - W * 0.42;
   765	    target = clamp(target, minCam, maxCam);
   766	    if (G.camLock !== null) target = Math.min(target, G.camLock);
   767	    G.camX = lerp(G.camX, target, Math.min(1, dt * 5));
   768	    G.camX = clamp(G.camX, minCam, maxCam);
   769	
   770	    checkWaves();
   771	
   772	    if (G.camLock === null && G.camX >= maxCam - 2) {
   773	      if (G.seg < SEGS - 1) {
   774	        G.seg++;
   775	        G.goT = 0;
   776	        banner('BLOCK ' + (G.seg + 1) + (G.seg === SEGS - 1 ? ' — BOSS ALLEY' : ''), 1.4);
   777	        G.score += 200;
   778	        Audio.clear();
   779	      }
   780	    }
   781	    if (G.goT > 0) G.goT -= dt * 0;
   782	  }
   783	
   784	  /* ================= main update ================= */
   785	  function update(dt) {
   786	    G.t += dt;
   787	    if (G.hintT > 0 && Input.anyInput) G.hintT -= dt;
   788	    if (G.bannerT > 0) { G.bannerT -= dt; if (G.bannerT <= 0) G.banner = null; }
   789	    if (G.flash > 0) G.flash -= dt;
   790	
   791	    if (G.mode === 'over') {
   792	      if (Input.tap.punch || Input.tap.jump || Input.hit('enter', ' ', 'j', 'k', 'r')) { newGame(); }
   793	      FX.update(dt);
   794	      return;
   795	    }
   796	    if (G.mode === 'stageclear') {
   797	      G.st -= dt;
   798	      FX.update(dt);
   799	      if (G.st <= 0) {
   800	        const p = G.player;
   801	        buildStage(G.stage + 1);
   802	        p.x = W * 0.25; p.z = 0.55; p.hp = Math.min(p.maxhp, p.hp + 45); p.carry = null; p.weapon = null;
   803	        p.state = 'idle'; p.inv = 1.2; p.y = 0; p.vy = 0;
   804	        G.mode = 'play';
   805	      }
   806	      return;
   807	    }
   808	
   809	    const p = G.player;
   810	    updatePlayer(p, dt);
   811	    for (let i = G.foes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) updateFoe(G.foes[i], dt, p);
   812	    updateShots(dt, p);
   813	
   814	    // items physics
   815	    for (const it of G.items) { if (it.y < 0) { it.y += it.vy * dt; it.vy += GRAV * dt; if (it.y > 0) { it.y = 0; it.vy = 0; } } }
   816	
   817	    updateCamera(dt, p);
   818	    FX.update(dt);
   819	
   820	    // boss defeat -> stage clear
   821	    if (G.seg === SEGS - 1 && G.waves[G.waves.length - 1].done && !G.boss && G.foes.length === 0 && G.pending.length === 0) {
   822	      G.mode = 'stageclear'; G.st = 2.6;
   823	      G.score += 1000 + G.stage * 250;
   824	      banner('STAGE ' + G.stage + ' CLEAR  +' + (1000 + G.stage * 250), 2.4);
   825	      Audio.clear();
   826	      if (G.score > G.best) { G.best = G.score; try { localStorage.setItem('br_best', String(G.best)); } catch (e) { } }
   827	    }
   828	  }

   143	    var L = V.layout;
   144	    if (hitCircle(L.strike, x, y)) { pointers[id] = 'strike'; IN.strike = true; return; }
   145	    if (hitCircle(L.sup, x, y)) { pointers[id] = 'super'; IN.superBtn = true; IN.superEdge = true; return; }
   146	    for (var i = 0; i < L.ports.length; i++) {
   147	      var p = L.ports[i];
   148	      if (x >= p.x - 6 && x <= p.x + p.w + 6 && y >= p.y - 6 && y <= p.y + p.h + 10) {
   149	        pointers[id] = 'ui'; IN.swapReq = i; return;
   150	      }
   151	    }
   152	    if (L.mute && x >= L.mute.x && x <= L.mute.x + L.mute.w && y >= L.mute.y && y <= L.mute.y + L.mute.h) {
   153	      pointers[id] = 'ui'; V.toggleMute(); return;
   154	    }
   155	    if (!IN.stick.on) {
   156	      pointers[id] = 'stick';
   157	      IN.stick.on = true; IN.stick.id = id;
   158	      IN.stick.ox = x; IN.stick.oy = y; IN.stick.x = x; IN.stick.y = y;
   159	      IN.stick.dx = 0; IN.stick.dy = 0; IN.stick.mag = 0;
   160	      return;
   161	    }
   162	    pointers[id] = 'ui';
   163	  }
   164	  function onMove(id, x, y) {
   165	    var r = pointers[id];
   166	    if (r === 'stick' && IN.stick.id === id) {
   167	      IN.stick.x = x; IN.stick.y = y;
   168	      var dx = x - IN.stick.ox, dy = y - IN.stick.oy;
   169	      var m = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), MAXR = 52;
   170	      if (m > MAXR) { // drag the base along
   171	        IN.stick.ox += dx * (1 - MAXR / m);
   172	        IN.stick.oy += dy * (1 - MAXR / m);
   173	        dx = x - IN.stick.ox; dy = y - IN.stick.oy; m = MAXR;
   174	      }
   175	      IN.stick.mag = V.clamp(m / MAXR, 0, 1);
   176	      if (m > 0.001) { IN.stick.dx = dx / (m || 1); IN.stick.dy = dy / (m || 1); }
   177	      if (m < 6) { IN.stick.mag = 0; }
   178	    }
   179	  }
   180	  function onUp(id) {
   181	    var r = pointers[id];
   182	    if (r === 'strike') IN.strike = false;
   183	    else if (r === 'super') IN.superBtn = false;
   184	    else if (r === 'stick') {
   185	      IN.stick.on = false; IN.stick.id = null; IN.stick.mag = 0; IN.stick.dx = 0; IN.stick.dy = 0;
   186	    }
   187	    delete pointers[id];
   188	  }
   189	
   190	  V.bindInput = function (canvas) {
   191	    function rel(e) {
   192	      var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   193	      return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   194	    }
   195	    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
   196	      e.preventDefault();
   197	      var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   198	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   199	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   200	        onDown(t.identifier, t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
   201	      }
   202	    }, { passive: false });
   203	    canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
   204	      e.preventDefault();
   205	      var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   206	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   207	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   208	        onMove(t.identifier, t.clientX - r.left, t.clientY - r.top);
   209	      }
   210	    }, { passive: false });
   211	    function end(e) {
   212	      e.preventDefault();
   213	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) onUp(e.changedTouches[i].identifier);
   214	    }
   215	    canvas.addEventListener('touchend', end, { passive: false });
   216	    canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel', end, { passive: false });
   217	
   218	    var mouseDown = false;
   219	    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); mouseDown = true; var p = rel(e); onDown('m', p.x, p.y); });
   220	    root.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { if (!mouseDown) return; var p = rel(e); onMove('m', p.x, p.y); });
   221	    root.addEventListener('mouseup', function () { if (mouseDown) { mouseDown = false; onUp('m'); } });
   222	
   223	    root.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   224	      V.initAudio();
   225	      var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
   226	      if (!IN.keys[k]) {
   227	        if (k === 'k' || k === 'shift') IN.superEdge = true;
   228	        if (k >= '1' && k <= '4') IN.swapReq = parseInt(k, 10) - 1;
   229	        if (k === 'm') V.toggleMute();
   230	        if (k === 'p') IN.pausePress = true;
   231	        IN.anyTap = true;
   232	      }
   233	      IN.keys[k] = true;
   234	      if ([' ', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   235	    });
   236	    root.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { IN.keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
   237	    root.addEventListener('blur', function () { IN.keys = {}; IN.strike = false; IN.superBtn = false; pointers = {}; IN.stick.on = false; IN.stick.mag = 0; });
   238	  };
   239	
   240	  /* keyboard-merged movement vector */
   241	  V.moveVec = function () {
   242	    var k = IN.keys, dx = 0, dy = 0;
   243	    if (k['a'] || k['arrowleft']) dx -= 1;
   244	    if (k['d'] || k['arrowright']) dx += 1;
   245	    if (k['w'] || k['arrowup']) dy -= 1;
   246	    if (k['s'] || k['arrowdown']) dy += 1;
   247	    if (dx || dy) {
   248	      var m = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   249	      return { x: dx / m, y: dy / m, mag: 1 };
   250	    }
   251	    if (IN.stick.mag > 0.05) return { x: IN.stick.dx, y: IN.stick.dy, mag: IN.stick.mag };
   252	    return { x: 0, y: 0, mag: 0 };
   253	  };
   254	  V.strikeHeld = function () { return IN.strike || !!IN.keys['j'] || !!IN.keys[' ']; };
   255	  V.takeSuper = function () { var s = IN.superEdge; IN.superEdge = false; return s; };
   256	  V.takeSwap = function () { var s = IN.swapReq; IN.swapReq = -1; return s; };
   257	  V.takeTap = function () { var s = IN.anyTap; IN.anyTap = false; return s; };
   258	})(window);
    35	  }

    55	    },

    59	  G.addStrike = function (o) {
    60	    o.life = o.life || 0.1; o.max = o.life; o.hit = [];
    61	    if (o.owner) { o.x = o.owner.x + Math.cos(o.owner.a) * (o.ox || 0); o.y = o.owner.y + Math.sin(o.owner.a) * (o.ox || 0); o.a = o.owner.a; }
    62	    if (o.a === undefined) o.a = 0;
    63	    G.strikes.push(o);
    64	    return o;
    65	  };

    68	  G.randomEnemy = function () {
    69	    if (!G.enemies.length) return null;
    70	    return G.enemies[V.randi(0, G.enemies.length)];
    71	  };
    72	  G.chainTargets = function (x, y, rad, n) {
    73	    var out = [], src = { x: x, y: y }, used = {};
    74	    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    75	      var best = null, bd = rad * rad;
    76	      for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
    77	        if (used[i]) continue;
    78	        var e = G.enemies[i], d = V.dist2(src, e);
    79	        if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; }
    80	      }
    81	      if (best === null) break;
    82	      used[best] = 1; out.push(G.enemies[best]); src = G.enemies[best];
    83	      rad = 120;
    84	    }
    85	    return out;
    86	  };

    88	  function meterGain(h, amt) {
    89	    if (h.sup) return;
    90	    h.meter = V.clamp(h.meter + amt, 0, 100);
    91	  }
    92	
    93	  G.damageEnemy = function (e, dmg, src, knock, ang, stun) {
    94	    if (e.dead) return;
    95	    if (e.type === 'bracer' && ang !== undefined) {
    96	      if (Math.abs(V.angDiff(ang + Math.PI, e.a)) < 1.05) dmg *= 0.3;
    97	    }
    98	    e.hp -= dmg;
    99	    e.flash = 0.12;
   100	    if (knock) { e.vx += Math.cos(ang) * knock * (e.def.boss ? 0.18 : 1); e.vy += Math.sin(ang) * knock * (e.def.boss ? 0.18 : 1); }
   101	    if (stun) e.stun = Math.max(e.stun, stun * (e.def.boss ? 0.4 : 1));
   102	    if (src && src.isHero) meterGain(src, dmg * 0.55);
   103	    V.burst(e.x, e.y, 3, '#fff', 130, 0.2, 2);
   104	    V.sfx('hit');
   105	    if (e.hp <= 0) killEnemy(e, src);
   106	  };
   107	
   108	  function killEnemy(e, src) {
   109	    e.dead = true;
   110	    G.kills++;
   111	    G.score += e.def.score;
   112	    V.burst(e.x, e.y, e.def.boss ? 40 : 12, e.def.col, e.def.boss ? 330 : 200, 0.55, e.def.boss ? 6 : 3.5);
   113	    V.ring(e.x, e.y, e.r + 8, e.def.col, 0.35);
   114	    V.shake(e.def.boss ? 14 : 2.5);
   115	    V.sfx('kill');
   116	    if (e.def.boss) { G.banner = { txt: 'WARDEN DOWN', t: 2.0, col: '#e8437a' }; G.fx.flash('#ffffff', 0.25); }
   117	    if (src && src.isHero) meterGain(src, 6);
   118	  }

   120	  G.damageHero = function (h, dmg, ang, knock) {
   121	    if (h.downed || h.inv > 0) return;
   122	    h.hp -= dmg;
   123	    h.flash = 0.14;
   124	    h.inv = 0.28;
   125	    if (knock) { h.vx += Math.cos(ang) * knock; h.vy += Math.sin(ang) * knock; }
   126	    meterGain(h, dmg * 0.9);
   127	    V.burst(h.x, h.y, 5, '#ff5f5f', 150, 0.25, 2.5);
   128	    if (h.i === G.ctrl) { V.shake(4); G.fx.flash('#ff2f4f', 0.14); }
   129	    V.sfx('hit');
   130	    if (h.hp <= 0) downHero(h);
   131	  };
   132	
   133	  function downHero(h) {
   134	    h.hp = 0; h.downed = true; h.reviveP = 0; h.sup = null; h.vx = 0; h.vy = 0;
   135	    V.sfx('down'); V.shake(7);
   136	    V.ring(h.x, h.y, 30, '#ff4040', 0.5);
   137	    G.banner = { txt: h.name + ' IS DOWN', t: 1.6, col: '#ff6a6a' };
   138	    if (h.i === G.ctrl) {
   139	      var alt = nearestLiving(h);
   140	      if (alt) setCtrl(alt.i, true);
   141	    }
   142	    if (allDown()) gameOver();
   143	  }

   145	  G.reviveHero = function (h, frac) {
   146	    h.downed = false; h.hp = Math.max(1, Math.round(h.max * (frac || 0.5)));
   147	    h.inv = 1.2; h.reviveP = 0;
   148	    V.ring(h.x, h.y, 34, h.col, 0.5);
   149	    V.burst(h.x, h.y, 14, h.col, 180, 0.45, 3);
   150	    V.sfx('revive');
   151	  };
   152	
   153	  function allDown() {
   154	    for (var i = 0; i < G.heroes.length; i++) if (!G.heroes[i].downed) return false;
   155	    return true;
   156	  }
   157	  function nearestLiving(from) {
   158	    var best = null, bd = 1e9;
   159	    for (var i = 0; i < G.heroes.length; i++) {
   160	      var h = G.heroes[i];
   161	      if (h === from || h.downed) continue;
   162	      var d = V.dist2(from, h);
   163	      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = h; }
   164	    }
   165	    return best;
   166	  }
   167	  function setCtrl(i, silent) {
   168	    if (i < 0 || i > 3) return;
   169	    var h = G.heroes[i];
   170	    if (!h || h.downed || i === G.ctrl) return;
   171	    G.ctrl = i;
   172	    V.ring(h.x, h.y, 30, h.col, 0.35);
   173	    if (!silent) V.sfx('swap');
   174	    G.banner = { txt: h.name + ' - ' + h.def.title.toUpperCase(), t: 1.1, col: h.col };
   175	  }

   177	  function gameOver() {
   178	    if (G.state === 'over') return;
   179	    G.state = 'over'; G.stateT = 0;
   180	    if (G.score > G.best) { G.best = G.score; saveBest(); }
   181	    V.sfx('over'); V.shake(14);
   182	    G.fx.flash('#ff2f4f', 0.5);
   183	  }

   209	  function spawnRoom(r) {
   210	    var boss = (r % 5 === 0);
   211	    var pool = ['husk', 'husk', 'skitter'];
   212	    if (r >= 2) pool.push('lobber', 'skitter');
   213	    if (r >= 3) pool.push('bracer', 'husk');
   214	    if (r >= 4) pool.push('sapper', 'lobber');
   215	    if (r >= 7) pool.push('bracer', 'sapper');
   216	    var n = Math.min(26, 4 + Math.floor(r * 1.9));
   217	    if (boss) n = Math.min(12, 3 + Math.floor(r * 0.7));
   218	    var pace = Math.max(0.10, 0.28 - r * 0.010);
   219	    G.spawns = [];
   220	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   221	      G.spawns.push({ type: V.pick(pool), t: 0.25 + i * pace + (i > 7 ? (i - 7) * pace * 1.6 : 0), x: 0, y: 0, set: false });
   222	    }
   223	    if (boss) {
   224	      G.spawns.push({ type: 'warden', t: 1.0, x: AR.x + AR.w / 2, y: AR.y + 70, set: true });
   225	      G.banner = { txt: 'WARDEN APPROACHES', t: 2.0, col: '#e8437a' };
   226	      V.sfx('boss');
   227	    }
   228	    for (var j = 0; j < G.spawns.length; j++) {
   229	      var s = G.spawns[j];
   230	      if (s.set) continue;
   231	      var edge = V.randi(0, 4);
   232	      if (edge === 0) { s.x = V.rand(AR.x + 24, AR.x + AR.w - 24); s.y = AR.y + 22; }
   233	      else if (edge === 1) { s.x = AR.x + AR.w - 24; s.y = V.rand(AR.y + 24, AR.y + AR.h - 24); }
   234	      else if (edge === 2) { s.x = V.rand(AR.x + 24, AR.x + AR.w - 24); s.y = AR.y + AR.h - 22; }
   235	      else { s.x = AR.x + 24; s.y = V.rand(AR.y + 24, AR.y + AR.h - 24); }
   236	      s.tel = 0;
   237	    }
   238	  }

   240	  function spawnEnemy(type, x, y, r) {
   241	    var d = V.ENEMIES[type];
   242	    var scale = 1 + (G.room - 1) * 0.21;
   243	    var hp = Math.round(d.hp * (d.boss ? (1 + (G.room / 5 - 1) * 0.85) : scale));
   244	    G.enemies.push({
   245	      type: type, def: d, x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: 0, a: Math.PI / 2,
   246	      hp: hp, max: hp, r: d.r, dmg: Math.round(d.dmg * (1 + (G.room - 1) * 0.145)),
   247	      state: 'walk', windT: 0, cd: V.rand(0.3, 1.0), stun: 0, flash: 0,
   248	      dead: false, tgt: null, fuse: type === 'sapper' ? V.rand(7, 10) : 0,
   249	      phase: 0, pcd: 2.0, jit: Math.random() * 6.28, spawnT: 0.35
   250	    });
   251	    V.ring(x, y, 26, d.col, 0.35);
   252	  }

   254	  /* ===================== UPDATE ===================== */
   255	  function clampToArena(e) {
   256	    var pad = e.r || 10;
   257	    if (e.x < AR.x + pad) { e.x = AR.x + pad; e.vx = Math.abs(e.vx) * 0.3; }
   258	    if (e.x > AR.x + AR.w - pad) { e.x = AR.x + AR.w - pad; e.vx = -Math.abs(e.vx) * 0.3; }
   259	    if (e.y < AR.y + pad) { e.y = AR.y + pad; e.vy = Math.abs(e.vy) * 0.3; }
   260	    if (e.y > AR.y + AR.h - pad) { e.y = AR.y + AR.h - pad; e.vy = -Math.abs(e.vy) * 0.3; }
   261	  }

   263	  function nearestHero(e) {
   264	    var best = null, bd = 1e9;
   265	    for (var i = 0; i < G.heroes.length; i++) {
   266	      var h = G.heroes[i];
   267	      if (h.downed) continue;
   268	      var d = V.dist2(e, h);
   269	      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = h; }
   270	    }
   271	    return best;
   272	  }
   273	  function nearestEnemy(p, maxd) {
   274	    var best = null, bd = maxd ? maxd * maxd : 1e9;
   275	    for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   276	      var d = V.dist2(p, G.enemies[i]);
   277	      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = G.enemies[i]; }
   278	    }
   279	    return best;
   280	  }

   282	  function tryAttack(h) {
   283	    if (h.cd > 0 || h.stun > 0 || h.downed || h.sup) return;
   284	    h.cd = h.kit.cd;
   285	    h.kit.atk(h, G);
   286	  }
   287	  function trySuper(h) {
   288	    if (h.meter < 100 || h.downed || h.sup) return;
   289	    h.meter = 0;
   290	    h.kit.sup(h, G);
   291	    G.banner = { txt: h.name + ' SUPER', t: 1.1, col: h.col };
   292	  }
   293	
   294	  function updateHero(h, dt, isPlayer) {
   295	    h.cd -= dt; h.comboT -= dt; h.inv -= dt; h.flash -= dt; h.stun -= dt;
   296	    if (h.kit.tick) h.kit.tick(h, G, dt);
   297	
   298	    if (h.downed) {
   299	      h.vx *= 0.85; h.vy *= 0.85;
   300	      h.x += h.vx * dt; h.y += h.vy * dt;
   301	      // revive by nearby living ally
   302	      var helper = null;
   303	      for (var i = 0; i < G.heroes.length; i++) {
   304	        var a = G.heroes[i];
   305	        if (a === h || a.downed) continue;
   306	        if (V.dist2(a, h) < 46 * 46) { helper = a; break; }
   307	      }
   308	      if (helper) {
   309	        h.reviveP += dt / 1.6;
   310	        if (h.reviveP >= 1) { G.reviveHero(h, 0.5); G.banner = { txt: h.name + ' REVIVED', t: 1.2, col: h.col }; }
   311	        else if (Math.random() < 0.25) V.burst(h.x, h.y, 1, h.col, 60, 0.3, 2);
   312	      } else h.reviveP = Math.max(0, h.reviveP - dt * 0.35);
   313	      clampToArena(h);
   314	      return;
   315	    }
   316	
   317	    var mv = { x: 0, y: 0, mag: 0 };
   318	    if (isPlayer) {
   319	      mv = V.moveVec();
   320	      if (V.strikeHeld()) tryAttack(h);
   321	    } else {
   322	      mv = botThink(h, dt);
   323	    }
   324	
   325	    if (h.dashT > 0) {
   326	      h.dashT -= dt;
   327	      h.x += h.dvx * dt; h.y += h.dvy * dt;

   332	      h.vy = V.lerp(h.vy, mv.y * sp * mv.mag, 1 - Math.pow(0.001, dt));
   333	      if (mv.mag > 0.1) h.a = Math.atan2(mv.y, mv.x);

   345	  function botThink(h, dt) {
   346	    h.botT -= dt;
   347	    var mv = { x: 0, y: 0, mag: 0 };
   348	    // 1. revive priority: closest living hero to a downed ally goes for it

   351	    for (var i = 0; i < G.heroes.length; i++) {

   355	      var closer = false;
   356	      for (var j = 0; j < G.heroes.length; j++) {
   357	        var o = G.heroes[j];
   358	        if (o === h || o.downed || o.i === G.ctrl) continue;
   359	        if (V.dist2(o, d) < mine) closer = true;
   360	      }
   361	      if (!closer && mine < bestD) { bestD = mine; downed = d; }
   362	    }
   363	    if (downed) { mode = 'revive'; target = downed; }
   364	    else {
   365	      target = h.aiTarget;

   367	        h.botT = V.rand(0.6, 1.2);
   368	        // prefer nearest, boss weighted

   370	        for (var k = 0; k < G.enemies.length; k++) {
   371	          var e = G.enemies[k];
   372	          var dd = V.dist2(h, e) * (e.def.boss ? 0.5 : 1) * (e.type === 'sapper' ? 0.55 : 1);
   373	          if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = e; }
   374	        }
   375	        target = best; h.aiTarget = best;
   376	      }
   377	    }
   378	    if (!target) {
   379	      // idle: drift toward centre-ish of the pack
   380	      var p = G.heroes[G.ctrl];
   680	        if (!h1.downed) { h1.x -= ddx / dd * pp; h1.y -= ddy / dd * pp; }
   681	        if (!h2.downed) { h2.x += ddx / dd * pp; h2.y += ddy / dd * pp; }
   682	      }
   683	    }
   684	  }

   686	  function update(dt) {

   691	    if (G.banner) { G.banner.t -= dt; if (G.banner.t <= 0) G.banner = null; }

   724	    }

   741	          else hero.hp = Math.min(hero.max, hero.hp + hero.max * healf);
   742	          hero.meter = Math.min(100, hero.meter + 15);
   743	        }

   749	      }

    94	  var s = Math.min(w / VW, h / VH);

   127	function pressAt(x, y) {
   128	  Audio2.init();
   129	  Input.down = true;
   130	  Input.sx = Input.cx = x; Input.sy = Input.cy = y;
   131	  Input.st = performance.now();

   134	function releaseAt(x, y) {
   135	  if (!Input.down) return;
   136	  Input.down = false;
   137	  var dx = x - Input.sx, dy = y - Input.sy;
   138	  var ad = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   139	  var dir = 'tap';
   140	  if (ad > 22) {
   141	    if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) dir = dx > 0 ? 'right' : 'left';
   142	    else dir = dy > 0 ? 'down' : 'up';
   143	  }
   144	  if (Input.onTap) Input.onTap(Input.sx, Input.sy, dir, x, y);
   145	  if (Input.onRelease) Input.onRelease(x, y);
   146	}

    72	/* ---------------- wave generation (seeded per night) ---------------- */
    73	function startNight(n) {
    74	  var r = makeRng(1337 + n * 7919);
    75	  var dur = 22 + n * 3.2;
    76	  var ev = [];
    77	  function add(kind, count, t0, t1) {
    78	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    79	      var s = Math.floor(r() * 3);
    80	      ev.push({ t: t0 + (t1 - t0) * r(), kind: kind, seg: s });
    81	    }
    82	  }
    83	  add('grunt', 6 + n * 3, 1.0, dur);
    84	  if (n >= 2) add('grap', 1 + (n - 1) * 2, 5, dur);
    85	  if (n >= 4) add('elite', 1 + Math.floor((n - 4) * 1.2), 8, dur);
    86	  if (n >= 3) add('ram', n >= 8 ? 2 : 1, 6, dur * 0.65);
    87	  if (n >= 6) add('tower', n >= 9 ? 2 : 1, 9, dur * 0.7);
    88	  ev.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
    89	  G.wave = { ev: ev, i: 0, dur: dur };
    90	  G.waveT = 0;
    91	  G.nightTitle = 2.4;
    92	  G.ladders.length = 0;
    93	  G.enemies.length = 0;
    94	  G.shots.length = 0;
    95	  G.pours.length = 0;
    96	  G.gateOil = 100;
    97	}

   189	function doAttack(type) {

   191	  h.atk = 0.26; h.atkType = type;
   192	  Audio2.swing();
   193	  var hits = 0;
   194	  var R = type === 'sweep' ? 74 : type === 'kick' ? 58 : 48;
   195	  var dmgBase = (type === 'over' ? 38 : type === 'sweep' ? 21 : 16) * G.heroDmg;
   196	
   197	  // enemies on rampart or near the top of the wall face
   198	  for (var i = 0; i < G.enemies.length; i++) {
   199	    var e = G.enemies[i];
   200	    if (e.dead || e.k === 'ram') continue;

   203	        damage(e, dmgBase * 0.7, type); hits++;
   204	        addPart(e.x, WALL_TOP + 10, 6, '#cfd6e6', 90, 0.3);
   205	      }
   206	      continue;
   207	    }
   208	    if (e.st === 'ground' || e.st === 'fall') continue;
   209	    var reach = (e.st === 'top') ? 0 : (e.y - WALL_TOP);
   210	    if (reach > (type === 'kick' ? 84 : 44)) continue;
   211	    if (Math.abs(e.x - h.x) > R) continue;
   212	    hits++;
   213	    if (type === 'kick') {
   214	      if (e.shield) { e.shield = false; addPart(e.x, e.y - 12, 8, '#dcd6ff', 90); floatText(e.x, e.y - 26, 'SHIELD!', '#dcd6ff'); }
   215	      damage(e, dmgBase, type);
   216	      if (!e.dead && e.st === 'climb') { e.st = 'fall'; e.vy = -40; e.ladder = null; }
   217	      else if (!e.dead) { e.x += h.face * 16; }
   218	    } else if (type === 'sweep') {
   219	      damage(e, dmgBase, type);
   220	      if (!e.dead) {
   221	        e.x += (e.x > h.x ? 1 : -1) * 20;
   222	        if (e.st === 'climb' && Math.random() < 0.4) { e.st = 'fall'; e.vy = -20; e.ladder = null; }
   223	      }
   224	    } else {
   225	      damage(e, dmgBase, type);
   226	    }
   227	    addPart(e.x, e.y - 10, 5, type === 'kick' ? '#ffd9a0' : '#fff0c0', 80, 0.3);
   228	  }
   229	
   230	  // kick knocks ladders off the wall
   231	  if (type === 'kick') {
   232	    for (var j = 0; j < G.ladders.length; j++) {
   233	      var L = G.ladders[j];

   236	        L.hp = 0; hits++;

   238	        Audio2.kick();

   241	          var c = G.enemies[q];

   243	        }
   244	      }
   245	    }
   246	  }
   247	
   248	  if (hits > 0) {
   249	    Audio2.hit();
   250	    shake(type === 'over' ? 5 : 3.5);
   251	    h.comboT = 1.6;
   252	    h.combo = Math.min(9, h.combo + 1);

   254	  }

  1145	function shopTap(x, y) {
  1146	  for (var i = 0; i < shopBtns.length; i++) {
  1147	    var b = shopBtns[i];

  1151	      G.night++;
  1152	      startNight(G.night);
  1153	      Audio2.rally();
  1154	      return;
  1155	    }
  1156	    if (!b.can) { Audio2.ui(); return; }
  1157	    G.valor -= b.cost;
  1158	    var def = null;
  1159	    for (var j = 0; j < UP_DEFS.length; j++) if (UP_DEFS[j].k === b.k) def = UP_DEFS[j];
  1160	    G.upCost[b.k] += def.step;
  1161	    Audio2.buy();
  1162	    if (b.k === 'wall') {
  1163	      for (var s = 0; s < 3; s++) { G.segs[s].max = Math.max(G.segs[s].max, 100); G.segs[s].hp = Math.min(G.segs[s].max, G.segs[s].hp + 45); }
  1164	    } else if (b.k === 'gate') {
  1165	      G.gate.hp = Math.min(G.gate.max, G.gate.hp + 90);
  1166	    } else if (b.k === 'blade') {
  1167	      G.heroDmg *= 1.18;
  1168	    } else if (b.k === 'drill') {
  1169	      G.squadLvl++;
  1170	    } else {
  1171	      G.bannerMul *= 1.3;
  1172	    }
  1173	    return;
  1174	  }
  1175	}

  1177	Input.onKey = function (k) {
  1178	  if (G.mode === 'lose' || G.mode === 'win') {
  1179	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'enter' || k === 'r') newGame();
  1180	    return;
  1181	  }
  1182	  if (G.mode === 'shop') {
  1183	    if (k === 'enter' || k === ' ') { G.mode = 'play'; G.night++; startNight(G.night); Audio2.rally(); return; }
  1184	    var idx = ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'].indexOf(k);
  1185	    if (idx >= 0 && shopBtns[idx]) {
  1186	      var b = shopBtns[idx];
  1187	      if (b.can) { shopTap(b.x + 5, b.y + 5); }
  1188	    }
  1189	    return;
  1190	  }
  1191	  if (k === ' ') doAttack('over');
  1192	  else if (k === 'arrowdown' || k === 's') doAttack('kick');
  1193	  else if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') doAttack('sweep');
  1194	  else if (k === 'enter') bannerBurst();
  1195	  else if (k === '1' || k === '2' || k === '3') { selChip = parseInt(k, 10) - 1; Audio2.ui(); }
  1196	  else if (k === 'q' || k === 'e' || k === 'r') {
  1197	    var seg = k === 'q' ? 0 : (k === 'e' ? 1 : 2);
  1198	    if (selChip >= 0) { orderSquad(selChip, seg); selChip = -1; }
  1199	  }

  1203	var last = 0;
  1204	function frame(ms) {
  1205	  var t = ms / 1000;
  1206	  var dt = Math.min(0.05, t - last || 0.016);
  1207	  last = t;
  1208	  update(dt);
  1209	  draw(t);
  1210	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1211	}

   387	    }

   410	    }
   411	
   412	    if (e.st === 'climb') {

   526	function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {

   533	  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);

    54	    });

    57	    T.flipR = { x: 258, y: 652, len: 56, r: 7.5, rest: 150 * D2R, up: 212 * D2R, angle: 150 * D2R, omega: 0, side: 1, on: false };
    58	    // kickback (left outlane)
    59	    T.kick = { x: 54, y: 660, r: 15, charged: true, flash: 0 };
    60	    // ball entry point of the curl
    61	    T.entry = [90, 105];
    62	  }

    64	  /* ---------- parts ---------- */
    65	  function addPops(T, ax, ay, n, rnd) {
    66	    var base = rnd() * SS.TAU;
    67	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    68	      var a = base + i * SS.TAU / n;
    69	      var rr = 30 + rnd() * 12;

    72	        r: 17, rest: 0.35, kick: 700, kind: 'pop', flash: 0, hits: 0
    73	      };

    75	    }
    76	  }

    78	  function addBank(T, ax, ay, ang, n, rnd) {
    79	    var dx = Math.cos(ang), dy = Math.sin(ang);
    80	    var bank = { x: ax, y: ay, ang: ang, targets: [], flash: 0, done: false, resetAt: 0 };
    81	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    82	      var o = (i - (n - 1) / 2) * 21;
    83	      var cx = ax + dx * o, cy = ay + dy * o;
    84	      var t = { cx: cx, cy: cy, down: false, flash: 0, bank: bank };
    85	      var s = SS.seg(T.segs, cx - dx * 8, cy - dy * 8, cx + dx * 8, cy + dy * 8,
    86	        { rest: 0.45, r: 4.5, kind: 'target' });

    89	    }

    94	  function addSpinner(T, ax, ay, ang) {
    95	    var sp = { x: ax, y: ay, ang: ang, rot: 0, vel: 0, r: 17, spins: 0, flash: 0 };
    96	    var dx = Math.cos(ang), dy = Math.sin(ang); // lane direction

   100	    SS.seg(T.segs, ax - nx * 26 - dx * 40, ay - ny * 26 - dy * 40, ax - nx * 26 + dx * 40, ay - ny * 26 + dy * 40, { rest: 0.3, r: 3.5 });

   104	  function addHole(T, ax, ay) {
   105	    T.hole = { x: ax, y: ay, r: 14, lit: false, flash: 0, hold: 0, ejectAng: 0 };

   111	  function addRamp(T, rampX, rnd) {
   112	    var exitRight = rampX <= 195;
   113	    var s = exitRight ? 1 : -1;
   114	    var ey = 340;
   115	    // funnel guides into the ramp mouth
   116	    SS.seg(T.segs, rampX - 48, ey + 82, rampX - 23, ey + 2, { rest: 0.35, r: 3.5 });
   117	    SS.seg(T.segs, rampX + 48, ey + 82, rampX + 23, ey + 2, { rest: 0.35, r: 3.5 });
   118	    var ctrl;
   119	    if (exitRight) {
   120	      ctrl = [[rampX, ey], [rampX + 22, 264], [rampX + 76, 194], [296, 134], [356, 246], [364, 402], [348, 512], [316, 574]];
   121	    } else {
   122	      ctrl = [[rampX, ey], [rampX - 22, 264], [rampX - 76, 194], [94, 134], [34, 246], [26, 402], [42, 512], [74, 574]];
   123	    }
   124	    var path = SS.smooth(ctrl, 7);
   125	    var len = 0, cum = [0];
   126	    for (var i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
   127	      len += Math.hypot(path[i][0] - path[i - 1][0], path[i][1] - path[i - 1][1]);
   128	      cum.push(len);
   129	    }
   130	    T.ramp = {
   131	      x: rampX, y: ey, path: path, cum: cum, len: len, exitRight: exitRight,
   132	      flash: 0, mouth: { x1: rampX - 23, y1: ey, x2: rampX + 23, y2: ey }
   133	    };
   134	  }

   136	  /* ---------- generator ---------- */
   137	  SS.genTable = function (seed) {
   138	    var rnd = SS.rng(seed);
   139	    var T = {
   140	      seed: seed, segs: [], circles: [], pops: [], banks: [], posts: [],
   141	      ramp: null, spinner: null, hole: null
   142	    };
   143	    buildShell(T);
   144	
   145	    var rampX = [115, 195, 275][Math.floor(rnd() * 3) % 3];
   146	    addRamp(T, rampX, rnd);
   147	
   148	    var used = [{ x: rampX, y: 388, r: 76 }, { x: 90, y: 112, r: 46 }];
   149	    function free(a, r) {
   150	      if (a[0] < 44 || a[0] > 346 || a[1] < 118 || a[1] > 486) return false;
   151	      for (var i = 0; i < used.length; i++) {
   152	        if (Math.hypot(a[0] - used[i].x, a[1] - used[i].y) < r + used[i].r) return false;
   153	      }
   154	      return true;
   155	    }
   156	    function shuffle(arr) {
   157	      var a = arr.slice();
   158	      for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   159	        var j = Math.floor(rnd() * (i + 1)); var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
   160	      }
   161	      return a;
   162	    }
   163	    var upper = shuffle([[100, 178], [195, 148], [292, 178]]);
   164	    var mid = shuffle([[78, 316], [312, 316], [195, 288]]);
   165	    var low = shuffle([[108, 440], [282, 440], [195, 462]]);
   166	    var pool = upper.concat(mid).concat(low);
   167	    function take(list, r) {
   168	      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
   169	        if (free(list[i], r)) { var a = list.splice(i, 1)[0]; used.push({ x: a[0], y: a[1], r: r }); return a; }
   170	      }
   171	      for (var j = 0; j < pool.length; j++) {
   172	        if (free(pool[j], r)) {
   173	          var b = pool[j];
   174	          var k = list.indexOf(b); if (k >= 0) list.splice(k, 1);
   175	          pool.splice(j, 1);
   176	          used.push({ x: b[0], y: b[1], r: r }); return b;
   177	        }
   178	      }
   179	      return null;
   180	    }
   181	    function sync(a) { var i = pool.indexOf(a); if (i >= 0) pool.splice(i, 1); }
   182	
   183	    // pop bumper cluster
   184	    var pa = take(upper, 58); if (pa) { sync(pa); addPops(T, pa[0], pa[1], 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 2), rnd); }
   185	    // primary drop bank
   186	    var ba = take(upper.concat(mid).slice(0), 52);
   187	    if (ba) {
   188	      sync(ba); removeFrom(upper, ba); removeFrom(mid, ba);
   189	      addBank(T, ba[0], ba[1], (rnd() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (20 + rnd() * 45) * D2R, 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3), rnd);
   190	    }
   191	    // spinner lane
   192	    var sa = take(mid, 46);
   193	    if (sa) { sync(sa); addSpinner(T, sa[0], sa[1], (75 + rnd() * 30) * D2R); }
   194	    // second drop bank
   195	    var b2 = take(low, 50);
   196	    if (b2) { sync(b2); addBank(T, b2[0], b2[1], (rnd() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (15 + rnd() * 40) * D2R, 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 2), rnd); }
   197	    // mode hole
   198	    var ha = take(mid.concat(low).concat(upper), 40);
   199	    if (!ha) ha = [195, 230];
   200	    else { sync(ha); removeFrom(upper, ha); removeFrom(mid, ha); removeFrom(low, ha); }
   201	    addHole(T, ha[0], ha[1]);
   202	    T.hole.ejectAng = (rnd() < 0.5 ? -125 : -55) * D2R;
   203	
   204	    // scattered rubber posts
   205	    var np = 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * 4);
   206	    for (var i = 0, guard = 0; i < np && guard < 200; guard++) {
   207	      var px = 50 + rnd() * 296, py = 150 + rnd() * 330;
   208	      if (!free([px, py], 22)) continue;
   209	      used.push({ x: px, y: py, r: 20 });
   210	      var post = { x: px, y: py, r: 6.5, rest: 0.62, kind: 'post', flash: 0 };
   211	      T.circles.push(post); T.posts.push(post);
   212	      i++;
   213	    }
   214	
   215	    function removeFrom(list, a) { var i = list.indexOf(a); if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1); }
   216	
   217	    T.name = tableName(seed);
   218	    return T;
   219	  };
   220	
   221	  var ADJ = ['CRIMSON', 'HOLLOW', 'IRON', 'VOLT', 'GLASS', 'NEON', 'ASH', 'DEEP', 'STORM', 'COBALT', 'RUST', 'PRISM'];
   222	  var NOUN = ['CARAPACE', 'REEF', 'FORGE', 'SPIRE', 'BASIN', 'CIRCUIT', 'MOLT', 'HARBOR', 'VAULT', 'DRIFT', 'SHELL', 'CRATER'];
   223	  function tableName(seed) {
   224	    var r = SS.rng(seed ^ 0x9e37);
   225	    return ADJ[Math.floor(r() * ADJ.length)] + ' ' + NOUN[Math.floor(r() * NOUN.length)];
   226	  }
   227	})(SS);

   107	  function flipperStep(f, dt) {
   108	    var target = (f.on && !S.tilt) ? f.up : f.rest;
   109	    var sp = 27, d = target - f.angle;
   110	    var step = sp * dt;
   111	    if (Math.abs(d) <= step) { f.omega = d / Math.max(dt, 1e-4); f.angle = target; }
   112	    else { var s = d > 0 ? 1 : -1; f.angle += s * step; f.omega = s * sp; }
   113	    f.omega = SS.clamp(f.omega, -sp, sp);
   114	  }

   157	  function sensors(px, py) {

   224	  function physics(dt) {
   225	    flipperStep(T.flipL, dt);
   226	    flipperStep(T.flipR, dt);
   227	
   228	    if (ball.state === 'ready') {
   229	      ball.x = 401; ball.y = 714.5;
   230	      ball.trail.length = 0;
   231	    } else if (ball.state === 'saucer') {
   232	      ball.hold -= dt;
   233	      if (ball.hold <= 0) {
   234	        ball.state = 'live';

   237	        ball.x = T.hole.x + Math.cos(a) * 34; ball.y = T.hole.y + Math.sin(a) * 34;
   238	        ball.holeCool = 0.45;

   240	      }
   241	    } else if (ball.state === 'ramp') {

   249	        ball.x = a2[0]; ball.y = a2[1];

   255	      } else {

   257	        ball.x = p[0]; ball.y = p[1];
   258	      }
   259	      ball.trail.push([ball.x, ball.y]);
   260	      if (ball.trail.length > 9) ball.trail.shift();

   262	      if (ball.holeCool > 0) ball.holeCool -= dt;

   268	        ball.vx *= damp; ball.vy *= damp;

   270	        if (sp > VMAX) { ball.vx *= VMAX / sp; ball.vy *= VMAX / sp; }

   274	        if (ball.state !== 'live') break;
   275	      }

   277	      if (ball.trail.length > 9) ball.trail.shift();

   279	      var moved = Math.hypot(ball.x - (ball.lx === undefined ? 1e9 : ball.lx), ball.y - (ball.ly === undefined ? 0 : ball.ly));

   285	          ball.y -= 2;

   288	      // a weak plunge rolls back into the lane: allow a re-plunge

   291	      }
   292	      if (ball.y > 716 && ball.x < 372) drain();
   293	      if (ball.y > 900) drain();
   294	    }

   297	  function samplePath(R, d) {
   298	    var c = R.cum, p = R.path;
   299	    var lo = 0, hi = c.length - 1;
   300	    while (lo < hi - 1) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (c[mid] <= d) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
   301	    var t = (d - c[lo]) / Math.max(1e-6, c[hi] - c[lo]);
   302	    return [SS.lerp(p[lo][0], p[hi][0], t), SS.lerp(p[lo][1], p[hi][1], t)];
   303	  }

   306	  function update(dt) {
   307	    S.t += dt;
   308	    if (S.over) { parts.update(dt); decay(dt); return; }
   309	
   310	    physics(dt);
   311	    parts.update(dt);
   312	    decay(dt);
   313	
   314	    // spinner rotation & scoring
   315	    var sp = T.spinner;
   316	    if (sp) {
   317	      var prev = sp.rot;
   318	      sp.rot += sp.vel * dt;
   319	      sp.vel *= (1 - 1.15 * dt);
   320	      if (Math.abs(sp.vel) < 0.25) sp.vel = 0;
   321	      var half = Math.PI;
   322	      if (Math.floor(Math.abs(sp.rot) / half) !== Math.floor(Math.abs(prev) / half)) {
   323	        sp.spins++;
   324	        addScore(130 * S.level, sp.x, sp.y, '');
   325	        SS.SFX.spin();
   326	        progress('spin', sp.x, sp.y);
   327	      }
   328	    }
   329	    // bank auto-reset
   330	    for (var i = 0; i < T.banks.length; i++) {
   331	      var b = T.banks[i];
   332	      if (b.done && S.t > b.resetAt) {
   333	        b.done = false;
   334	        for (var k = 0; k < b.targets.length; k++) { b.targets[k].down = false; b.targets[k].seg.down = false; }
   335	      }
   336	    }
   337	    // mission timer
   338	    if (S.mode.on) {
   339	      S.mode.time -= dt;
   340	      if (S.mode.time <= 0) { S.mode.on = false; banner('MISSION OVER', 1.8); }
   341	    }
   342	    // nudge spring
   343	    var n = nudgeOff;
   344	    n.vx += -n.x * 260 * dt - n.vx * 9 * dt;
   345	    n.vy += -n.y * 260 * dt - n.vy * 9 * dt;
   346	    n.x += n.vx * dt; n.y += n.vy * dt;
   347	  }
   348	
   349	  function decay(dt) {
   350	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - shake * 6 * dt - 2 * dt);
   351	    if (S.msgT > 0) S.msgT -= dt;
   352	    var f = function (o) { if (o && o.flash > 0) o.flash = Math.max(0, o.flash - dt * 3.2); };
   353	    T.circles.forEach(f); T.slings.forEach(f); T.banks.forEach(f);
   354	    T.banks.forEach(function (b) { b.targets.forEach(f); });
   355	    f(T.spinner); f(T.hole); f(T.kick); f(T.ramp);
   356	    for (var i = pops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   357	      pops[i].life -= dt; pops[i].y -= 26 * dt;
   358	      if (pops[i].life <= 0) pops.splice(i, 1);
   359	    }
   360	  }

  var cv = document.getElementById('cv'), g = cv.getContext('2d');
  var view = { f: 1 };
  var G = 1500, VMAX = 1750, BALLR = 9.5;
  var COL = {
    bg0: '#111a2b', bg1: '#070a12', wall: '#46597a', rail: '#8fa8cc',
    cy: '#4fd8ff', mg: '#ff5aa8', am: '#ffc24f', gr: '#6ef07a', wt: '#eaf2ff'
  };

  var MISSIONS = [
    { k: 'ramp', need: 3, label: 'SHOOT 3 RAMPS' },
    { k: 'pop', need: 14, label: 'HIT 14 BUMPERS' },
    { k: 'spin', need: 24, label: 'SPIN 24 TIMES' },

  var seedNum = 0;

  /* ---------------- setup ---------------- */
  function newGame(seed) {
    seedNum = seed >>> 0;
    SS.saveSeed(seedNum);
    T = SS.genTable(seedNum);
    parts = SS.Particles(180);
    S = {
      score: 0, balls: 3, ball: 1, over: false, level: 1, tilt: false,
      mode: { on: false, idx: 0, prog: 0, time: 0 }, nudges: [], msg: '', msgT: 0,
      best: SS.best(seedNum), launchPow: 0, plunging: false, t: 0
    };
    pops = [];
    serve();
  }
  function serve() {
    ball = {
      x: 401, y: 714.5 - 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALLR, state: 'ready',
      trail: [], stillT: 0, rd: 0, rs: 0, hold: 0
    };
    S.tilt = false; S.nudges = []; S.launchPow = 0;
    T.flipL.on = T.flipR.on = false;
    T.kick.charged = true;
    T.banks.forEach(function (b) {
      b.targets.forEach(function (t) { t.down = false; t.seg.down = false; });
      b.done = false; b.resetAt = 0;
    });
