  /* ---------------- scoring ---------------- */
  function addScore(n, x, y, txt) {
    if (S.tilt) return;
    S.score += n;
    if (txt) popup(x, y, txt);
  }
  function popup(x, y, txt, col) {
    pops.push({ x: x, y: y, txt: txt, life: 1.1, col: col || COL.wt });
    if (pops.length > 14) pops.shift();
  }
  function banner(t, dur) { S.msg = t; S.msgT = dur || 2.2; }

  function progress(kind, x, y) {
    var m = S.mode;
    if (!m.on) return false;
    if (MISSIONS[m.idx].k !== kind) return false;
    m.prog++;
    addScore(3000 * S.level, x, y, '+' + (3000 * S.level));
    if (m.prog >= MISSIONS[m.idx].need) {
      var jack = 25000 * S.level;
      addScore(jack, 195, 300, 'JACKPOT ' + jack);
      banner('JACKPOT! ' + jack.toLocaleString(), 3);
      m.on = false; S.level++;
      shake = Math.max(shake, 16);
      parts.burst(195, 300, 60, COL.am, 460, 0.9);
      SS.SFX.jack();
    }
    return true;
  }

  function bankDone(b) {
    b.done = true; b.resetAt = S.t + 1.5; b.flash = 1;
    addScore(5000 * S.level, b.x, b.y, 'BANK ' + (5000 * S.level));
    SS.SFX.bank();
    shake = Math.max(shake, 9);
    parts.burst(b.x, b.y, 26, COL.gr, 340, 0.7);
    T.kick.charged = true;
    if (!progress('bank', b.x, b.y) && !S.mode.on && T.hole) {
      T.hole.lit = true;
      banner('MISSION LIT - SHOOT THE HOLE', 2.6);
    }
  }

  function startMission() {
    var m = S.mode;
    m.idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * MISSIONS.length);
    m.on = true; m.prog = 0; m.time = 60;
    T.hole.lit = false;
    banner(MISSIONS[m.idx].label, 3);
    SS.SFX.jack();
  }

  /* ---------------- physics ---------------- */
  function flipperStep(f, dt) {
    var target = (f.on && !S.tilt) ? f.up : f.rest;
    var sp = 27, d = target - f.angle;
    var step = sp * dt;
    if (Math.abs(d) <= step) { f.omega = d / Math.max(dt, 1e-4); f.angle = target; }
    else { var s = d > 0 ? 1 : -1; f.angle += s * step; f.omega = s * sp; }
    f.omega = SS.clamp(f.omega, -sp, sp);
  }

  function collide() {
    var i, h, s;
    for (i = 0; i < T.segs.length; i++) {
      s = T.segs[i];
      h = SS.hitSeg(ball, s);
      if (!h) continue;
      if (s.kind === 'target' && s.target && !s.target.down) {
        s.target.down = true; s.down = true; s.target.flash = 1;
        addScore(500 * S.level, s.target.cx, s.target.cy, '500');
        SS.SFX.target();
        parts.burst(s.target.cx, s.target.cy, 10, COL.gr, 240, 0.45);
        var b = s.target.bank, all = true;
        for (var k = 0; k < b.targets.length; k++) if (!b.targets[k].down) all = false;
        if (all) bankDone(b);
      } else if (s.kind === 'sling') {
        s.ref.flash = 1;
        addScore(50, (s.x1 + s.x2) / 2, (s.y1 + s.y2) / 2, '');
        SS.SFX.sling();
        parts.burst(ball.x, ball.y, 6, COL.mg, 260, 0.35);
        shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
      } else if (h.speed > 260) {
        SS.SFX.wall(h.speed);
      }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < T.circles.length; i++) {
      var c = T.circles[i];
      h = SS.hitCircle(ball, c);
      if (!h) continue;
      if (c.kind === 'pop') {
        c.flash = 1; c.hits++;
        addScore(100 * S.level, c.x, c.y, '');
        SS.SFX.pop();
        parts.burst(c.x, c.y, 8, COL.cy, 300, 0.4);
        shake = Math.max(shake, 4);
        progress('pop', c.x, c.y);
      } else if (c.kind === 'post') { c.flash = 1; }
    }
    h = SS.hitFlipper(ball, T.flipL); if (h && h.speed > 200) SS.SFX.wall(h.speed);
    h = SS.hitFlipper(ball, T.flipR); if (h && h.speed > 200) SS.SFX.wall(h.speed);
  }

  function sensors(px, py) {
    // ramp mouth (crossing upward)
    var R = T.ramp;
    if (R && ball.state === 'live') {
      var m = R.mouth;
      if (py > m.y1 && ball.y <= m.y1 && ball.vy < 0 &&
        ball.x > m.x1 - 4 && ball.x < m.x2 + 4) {
        var sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
        if (sp > 520) {
          ball.state = 'ramp'; ball.rd = 0; ball.rs = SS.clamp(sp * 0.85, 520, 1150);
          R.flash = 1; SS.SFX.ramp();
        } else {
          ball.y = m.y1 + 2; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy) * 0.4 + 40;
        }
      }
    }
    // spinner
    var sp2 = T.spinner;
    if (sp2 && ball.state === 'live') {
      var d = Math.hypot(ball.x - sp2.x, ball.y - sp2.y);
      if (d < sp2.r + ball.r) {
        if (!sp2.inside) {
          sp2.inside = true;
          sp2.vel += Math.min(46, Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 0.045) * (ball.vy > 0 ? 1 : -1);
          sp2.flash = 1;
        }
      } else sp2.inside = false;
    }
    // mode hole
    var ho = T.hole;
    if (ho && ball.state === 'live' && !(ball.holeCool > 0)) {
      if (Math.hypot(ball.x - ho.x, ball.y - ho.y) < ho.r) {
        ball.state = 'saucer'; ball.hold = 0.85;
        ball.vx = ball.vy = 0; ball.x = ho.x; ball.y = ho.y;
        ho.flash = 1; SS.SFX.hole();
        if (ho.lit && !S.mode.on) startMission();
        else if (!progress('hole', ho.x, ho.y)) addScore(1000 * S.level, ho.x, ho.y, '1000');
      }
    }
    // kickback
    var kb = T.kick;
    if (kb && ball.state === 'live' && Math.hypot(ball.x - kb.x, ball.y - kb.y) < kb.r + ball.r) {
      if (kb.charged && !S.tilt) {
        kb.charged = false; kb.flash = 1;
        ball.x = 52; ball.y = 654;
        ball.vx = -420; ball.vy = -1290;
        SS.SFX.kickb(); shake = Math.max(shake, 8);
        banner('KICKBACK!', 1.4);
        parts.burst(kb.x, kb.y, 18, COL.am, 380, 0.6);
      }
    }
  }

  function drain() {
    SS.SFX.drain();
    shake = Math.max(shake, 10);
    S.mode.on = false;
    S.ball++;
    if (S.ball > S.balls) {
      S.over = true;
      if (S.score > S.best) { S.best = S.score; SS.setBest(seedNum, S.score); }
    } else {
      banner('BALL ' + S.ball, 1.6);
      serve();
    }
  }

  function physics(dt) {
    flipperStep(T.flipL, dt);
    flipperStep(T.flipR, dt);

    if (ball.state === 'ready') {
      ball.x = 401; ball.y = 714.5;
      ball.trail.length = 0;
    } else if (ball.state === 'saucer') {
      ball.hold -= dt;
      if (ball.hold <= 0) {
        ball.state = 'live';
        var a = T.hole.ejectAng;
        ball.vx = Math.cos(a) * 820; ball.vy = Math.sin(a) * 820;
        ball.x = T.hole.x + Math.cos(a) * 34; ball.y = T.hole.y + Math.sin(a) * 34;
        ball.holeCool = 0.45;
        parts.burst(T.hole.x, T.hole.y, 12, '#ff5aa8', 320, 0.5);
      }
    } else if (ball.state === 'ramp') {
      var R = T.ramp;
      ball.rs = Math.max(360, ball.rs - 150 * dt);
      ball.rd += ball.rs * dt;
      if (ball.rd >= R.len) {
        var n = R.path.length;
        var a1 = R.path[n - 2], a2 = R.path[n - 1];
        var dx = a2[0] - a1[0], dy = a2[1] - a1[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        ball.x = a2[0]; ball.y = a2[1];
        ball.vx = dx / L * 300; ball.vy = dy / L * 300 + 60;
        ball.state = 'live';
        addScore(2500 * S.level, ball.x, ball.y, 'RAMP ' + (2500 * S.level));
        progress('ramp', ball.x, ball.y);
        parts.burst(ball.x, ball.y, 12, COL.cy, 260, 0.5);
      } else {
        var p = samplePath(R, ball.rd);
        ball.x = p[0]; ball.y = p[1];
      }
      ball.trail.push([ball.x, ball.y]);
      if (ball.trail.length > 9) ball.trail.shift();
    } else {
      if (ball.holeCool > 0) ball.holeCool -= dt;
      var STEPS = 8, h = dt / STEPS;
      for (var i = 0; i < STEPS; i++) {
        var px = ball.x, py = ball.y;
        ball.vy += G * h;
        var damp = 1 - 0.16 * h;
        ball.vx *= damp; ball.vy *= damp;
        var sp = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
        if (sp > VMAX) { ball.vx *= VMAX / sp; ball.vy *= VMAX / sp; }
        ball.x += ball.vx * h; ball.y += ball.vy * h;
        collide();
        sensors(px, py);
        if (ball.state !== 'live') break;
      }
      ball.trail.push([ball.x, ball.y]);
      if (ball.trail.length > 9) ball.trail.shift();
      // anti-wedge: if the ball has barely moved, shake it loose
      var moved = Math.hypot(ball.x - (ball.lx === undefined ? 1e9 : ball.lx), ball.y - (ball.ly === undefined ? 0 : ball.ly));
      ball.lx = ball.x; ball.ly = ball.y;
      if (moved < 0.9) {
        ball.stillT += dt;
        if (ball.stillT > 1.4) {
          ball.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 420; ball.vy = -260; ball.stillT = 0;
          ball.y -= 2;
        }
      } else ball.stillT = 0;
      // a weak plunge rolls back into the lane: allow a re-plunge
      if (ball.x > 386 && ball.y > 688 && Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) < 70) {
        ball.state = 'ready'; ball.vx = ball.vy = 0; S.launchPow = 0; ball.stillT = 0;
      }
      if (ball.y > 716 && ball.x < 372) drain();
      if (ball.y > 900) drain();
    }
  }

  function samplePath(R, d) {
    var c = R.cum, p = R.path;
    var lo = 0, hi = c.length - 1;
    while (lo < hi - 1) { var mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (c[mid] <= d) lo = mid; else hi = mid; }
    var t = (d - c[lo]) / Math.max(1e-6, c[hi] - c[lo]);
    return [SS.lerp(p[lo][0], p[hi][0], t), SS.lerp(p[lo][1], p[hi][1], t)];
  }

  /* ---------------- update ---------------- */
  function update(dt) {
    S.t += dt;
    if (S.over) { parts.update(dt); decay(dt); return; }

    physics(dt);
    parts.update(dt);
    decay(dt);

    // spinner rotation & scoring
    var sp = T.spinner;
    if (sp) {
      var prev = sp.rot;
      sp.rot += sp.vel * dt;
      sp.vel *= (1 - 1.15 * dt);
      if (Math.abs(sp.vel) < 0.25) sp.vel = 0;
      var half = Math.PI;
      if (Math.floor(Math.abs(sp.rot) / half) !== Math.floor(Math.abs(prev) / half)) {
        sp.spins++;
        addScore(130 * S.level, sp.x, sp.y, '');
        SS.SFX.spin();
        progress('spin', sp.x, sp.y);
      }
    }
    // bank auto-reset
    for (var i = 0; i < T.banks.length; i++) {
      var b = T.banks[i];
      if (b.done && S.t > b.resetAt) {
        b.done = false;
        for (var k = 0; k < b.targets.length; k++) { b.targets[k].down = false; b.targets[k].seg.down = false; }
      }
    }
    // mission timer
    if (S.mode.on) {
      S.mode.time -= dt;
      if (S.mode.time <= 0) { S.mode.on = false; banner('MISSION OVER', 1.8); }
    }
    // nudge spring
    var n = nudgeOff;
    n.vx += -n.x * 260 * dt - n.vx * 9 * dt;
    n.vy += -n.y * 260 * dt - n.vy * 9 * dt;
    n.x += n.vx * dt; n.y += n.vy * dt;
  }

  function decay(dt) {
    shake = Math.max(0, shake - shake * 6 * dt - 2 * dt);
    if (S.msgT > 0) S.msgT -= dt;
    var f = function (o) { if (o && o.flash > 0) o.flash = Math.max(0, o.flash - dt * 3.2); };
    T.circles.forEach(f); T.slings.forEach(f); T.banks.forEach(f);
    T.banks.forEach(function (b) { b.targets.forEach(f); });
    f(T.spinner); f(T.hole); f(T.kick); f(T.ramp);
    for (var i = pops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      pops[i].life -= dt; pops[i].y -= 26 * dt;
      if (pops[i].life <= 0) pops.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- input ---------------- */
  var pointers = {};
  function toLocal(e) {
    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * CWID,
      y: (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * CH
    };
  }
  function inRect(p, x, y, w, h) { return p.x >= x && p.x <= x + w && p.y >= y && p.y <= y + h; }

  function press(p, id) {
    SS.audioInit();
    // HUD buttons
    if (inRect(p, 314, 0, 116, 58)) { newGame((Math.random() * 4294967295) >>> 0); return; }
    if (inRect(p, 266, 0, 48, 58)) { SS.setMuted(!SS.isMuted()); return; }
    if (S.over) {
      if (inRect(p, 65, 470, 300, 56)) { newGame(seedNum); return; }
      if (inRect(p, 65, 540, 300, 56)) { newGame((Math.random() * 4294967295) >>> 0); return; }
      return;
    }
    if (p.y < HUD) return;
    var ty = p.y - HUD;
    // plunger drag zone (generous: bottom-right quadrant while ball waits)
    if (ball.state === 'ready' && p.x > 292 && ty > 470) {
      pointers[id] = { role: 'plunge', sx: p.x, sy: p.y, t: performance.now(), moved: 0 };
      S.plunging = true;
      return;
    }
    var role = p.x < CWID / 2 ? 'L' : 'R';
    pointers[id] = { role: role, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, t: performance.now(), moved: 0, swiped: false };
    if (role === 'L') { T.flipL.on = true; } else { T.flipR.on = true; }
    if (!S.tilt) SS.SFX.flip();
  }
  function move(p, id) {
    var q = pointers[id]; if (!q) return;
    var dx = p.x - q.sx, dy = p.y - q.sy;
    q.moved = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (q.role === 'plunge') {
      S.launchPow = SS.clamp(dy / 110, 0, 1);
    } else if (!q.swiped && q.moved > 34 && performance.now() - q.t < 320) {
      q.swiped = true;
      nudge(dx, dy);
    }
  }
  function release(id) {
    var q = pointers[id]; if (!q) return;
    delete pointers[id];
    if (q.role === 'plunge') {
      S.plunging = false;
      launch();
    } else {
      var still = false;
      for (var k in pointers) if (pointers[k].role === q.role) still = true;
      if (!still) { if (q.role === 'L') T.flipL.on = false; else T.flipR.on = false; }
    }
  }
  function launch() {
    if (ball.state !== 'ready') { S.launchPow = 0; return; }
    var pow = S.launchPow;
    ball.state = 'live';
    ball.vy = -(1370 + 380 * pow);
    ball.vx = 0;
    S.launchPow = 0;
    SS.SFX.launch();
    parts.burst(401, 716, 10, COL.am, 200, 0.4);
  }
  function nudge(dx, dy) {
    if (S.tilt || S.over) return;
    var L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    var ux = dx / L, uy = dy / L;
    if (ball.state === 'live') { ball.vx += ux * 190; ball.vy += uy * 120 - 60; }
    nudgeOff.vx -= ux * 130; nudgeOff.vy -= uy * 90;
    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
    var now = performance.now();
    S.nudges.push(now);
    S.nudges = S.nudges.filter(function (t) { return now - t < 2600; });
    if (S.nudges.length > 3) {
      S.tilt = true;
      T.flipL.on = T.flipR.on = false;
      banner('TILT', 3);
      SS.SFX.tilt();
      shake = Math.max(shake, 18);
    }
  }

  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault(); cv.setPointerCapture && cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    press(toLocal(e), e.pointerId);
  }, { passive: false });
  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault(); if (pointers[e.pointerId]) move(toLocal(e), e.pointerId);
  }, { passive: false });
  ['pointerup', 'pointercancel'].forEach(function (n) {
    cv.addEventListener(n, function (e) { e.preventDefault(); release(e.pointerId); }, { passive: false });
  });
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
  document.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });

/* Shellshock Pinball - engine: rng, geometry, collision, particles, audio */
var SS = (function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ---------- deterministic rng ---------- */
  function rng(seed) {
    var s = (seed >>> 0) || 1;
    return function () {
      s ^= s << 13; s >>>= 0;
      s ^= s >> 17;
      s ^= s << 5; s >>>= 0;
      return s / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  function hashSeed(str) {
    var h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; }
    return h >>> 0;
  }

  /* ---------- small math ---------- */
  var clamp = function (v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; };
  var lerp = function (a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; };
  var TAU = Math.PI * 2;

  function closestOnSeg(px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    var dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1, l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy, t = 0;
    if (l2 > 1e-9) t = ((px - x1) * dx + (py - y1) * dy) / l2;
    t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t;
    return { x: x1 + t * dx, y: y1 + t * dy, t: t };
  }

  /* ellipse arc -> polyline points */
  function arcPts(cx, cy, rx, ry, a0, a1, n) {
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      var a = lerp(a0, a1, i / n);
      out.push([cx + rx * Math.cos(a), cy + ry * Math.sin(a)]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* catmull-rom through points -> dense polyline */
  function smooth(pts, per) {
    per = per || 8;
    var p = [pts[0]].concat(pts, [pts[pts.length - 1]]), out = [];
    for (var i = 1; i < p.length - 2; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < per; j++) {
        var t = j / per, t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
        var x = 0.5 * ((2 * p[i][0]) + (-p[i - 1][0] + p[i + 1][0]) * t +
          (2 * p[i - 1][0] - 5 * p[i][0] + 4 * p[i + 1][0] - p[i + 2][0]) * t2 +
          (-p[i - 1][0] + 3 * p[i][0] - 3 * p[i + 1][0] + p[i + 2][0]) * t3);
        var y = 0.5 * ((2 * p[i][1]) + (-p[i - 1][1] + p[i + 1][1]) * t +
          (2 * p[i - 1][1] - 5 * p[i][1] + 4 * p[i + 1][1] - p[i + 2][1]) * t2 +
          (-p[i - 1][1] + 3 * p[i][1] - 3 * p[i + 1][1] + p[i + 2][1]) * t3);
        out.push([x, y]);
      }
    }
    out.push(pts[pts.length - 1]);
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------- static geometry builders ---------- */
  function seg(list, x1, y1, x2, y2, opt) {
    var s = { x1: x1, y1: y1, x2: x2, y2: y2, r: 4, rest: 0.32, kind: 'wall' };
    if (opt) for (var k in opt) s[k] = opt[k];
    list.push(s);
    return s;
  }
  function chain(list, pts, opt) {
    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++)
      seg(list, pts[i][0], pts[i][1], pts[i + 1][0], pts[i + 1][1], opt);
  }

  /* ---------- collision ---------- */
  // returns null or {nx,ny,speed,obj}
  function hitSeg(b, s) {
    if (s.down) return null;
    var c = closestOnSeg(b.x, b.y, s.x1, s.y1, s.x2, s.y2);
    var nx = b.x - c.x, ny = b.y - c.y;
    var d = Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny);
    var R = b.r + (s.r || 0);
    if (d >= R) return null;
    if (d < 1e-6) { nx = 0; ny = -1; d = 1e-6; } else { nx /= d; ny /= d; }
    if (s.oneWay && (b.vx * s.oneWay.x + b.vy * s.oneWay.y) > 0) return null;
    b.x += nx * (R - d + 0.05);
    b.y += ny * (R - d + 0.05);
    var vn = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
    if (vn > 0) return null;
    var e = s.rest;
    if (e === undefined) e = 0.32;
    var impact = -vn;
    b.vx -= (1 + e) * vn * nx;
    b.vy -= (1 + e) * vn * ny;
    // tangential friction
    var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
    var vt = b.vx * tx + b.vy * ty;
    var f = s.fric === undefined ? 0.02 : s.fric;
    b.vx -= vt * f * tx; b.vy -= vt * f * ty;
    if (s.kick) {
      var k = s.kick;
      b.vx = nx * k + tx * (vt * 0.25);
      b.vy = ny * k + ty * (vt * 0.25);
    }
    return { nx: nx, ny: ny, speed: impact, obj: s };
  }

  function hitCircle(b, c) {
    if (c.down) return null;
    var nx = b.x - c.x, ny = b.y - c.y;
    var d = Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny);
    var R = b.r + c.r;
    if (d >= R) return null;
    if (d < 1e-6) { nx = 0; ny = -1; d = 1e-6; } else { nx /= d; ny /= d; }
    b.x += nx * (R - d + 0.05);
    b.y += ny * (R - d + 0.05);
    var vn = b.vx * nx + b.vy * ny;
    if (vn > 0) return null;
    var impact = -vn;
    var e = c.rest === undefined ? 0.45 : c.rest;
    b.vx -= (1 + e) * vn * nx;
    b.vy -= (1 + e) * vn * ny;
    if (c.kick) {
      b.vx = nx * c.kick + b.vx * 0.12;
      b.vy = ny * c.kick + b.vy * 0.12;
    }
    return { nx: nx, ny: ny, speed: impact, obj: c };
  }

  // moving capsule (flipper)
  function hitFlipper(b, f) {
    var px = f.x, py = f.y;
    var a = f.angle;
    var ex = px + Math.cos(a) * f.len, ey = py + Math.sin(a) * f.len;
    var c = closestOnSeg(b.x, b.y, px, py, ex, ey);
    var nx = b.x - c.x, ny = b.y - c.y;
    var d = Math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny);
    var R = b.r + f.r;
    if (d >= R) return null;
    if (d < 1e-6) { nx = 0; ny = -1; d = 1e-6; } else { nx /= d; ny /= d; }
    b.x += nx * (R - d + 0.05);
    b.y += ny * (R - d + 0.05);
    // surface point velocity
    var rx = c.x - px, ry = c.y - py;
    var pvx = -f.omega * ry, pvy = f.omega * rx;
    var rvx = b.vx - pvx, rvy = b.vy - pvy;
    var vn = rvx * nx + rvy * ny;
    if (vn > 0) return null;
    var e = 0.42;
    rvx -= (1 + e) * vn * nx;
    rvy -= (1 + e) * vn * ny;
    var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
    var vt = rvx * tx + rvy * ty;
    rvx -= vt * 0.10 * tx; rvy -= vt * 0.10 * ty;
    b.vx = rvx + pvx; b.vy = rvy + pvy;
    return { nx: nx, ny: ny, speed: -vn, obj: f };
  }

  /* ---------- particles ---------- */
  function Particles(max) {
    var p = [], i;
    for (i = 0; i < max; i++) p.push({ life: 0 });
    return {
      list: p,
      burst: function (x, y, n, col, spd, life) {
        var made = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < p.length && made < n; i++) {
          if (p[i].life > 0) continue;
          var a = Math.random() * TAU, s = spd * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
          p[i].x = x; p[i].y = y;
          p[i].vx = Math.cos(a) * s; p[i].vy = Math.sin(a) * s;
          p[i].life = p[i].max = life * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7);
          p[i].c = col; p[i].sz = 1.6 + Math.random() * 2.4;
          made++;
        }
      },
      update: function (dt) {
        for (var i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
          var q = p[i]; if (q.life <= 0) continue;
          q.life -= dt;
          q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt;
          q.vy += 900 * dt; q.vx *= 0.98; q.vy *= 0.98;
        }
      },
      draw: function (g) {
        for (var i = 0; i < p.length; i++) {
          var q = p[i]; if (q.life <= 0) continue;
          g.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, q.life / q.max);
          g.fillStyle = q.c;
          g.fillRect(q.x - q.sz * 0.5, q.y - q.sz * 0.5, q.sz, q.sz);
        }
        g.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- audio (WebAudio only) ---------- */
  var actx = null, master = null, muted = false;
  function audioInit() {
    if (actx) { if (actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume(); return; }
    try {
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      actx = new AC();
      master = actx.createGain();
      master.gain.value = 0.24;
      master.connect(actx.destination);
    } catch (e) { actx = null; }
  }
  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
    if (!actx || muted) return;
    var t = actx.currentTime;
    var o = actx.createOscillator(), g = actx.createGain();
    o.type = type || 'square';
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, slideTo), t + dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol === undefined ? 0.5 : vol, t + 0.008);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(master);
    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
  }
  function noise(dur, vol) {
    if (!actx || muted) return;
    var n = Math.floor(actx.sampleRate * dur);
    var buf = actx.createBuffer(1, n, actx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
    var src = actx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    var g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.3;
    src.connect(g); g.connect(master); src.start();
  }
  var SFX = {
    flip: function () { tone(180, 0.05, 'square', 0.18, 120); },
    pop: function () { tone(420 + Math.random() * 120, 0.09, 'square', 0.35, 180); },
    sling: function () { tone(300, 0.06, 'sawtooth', 0.3, 700); },
    target: function () { tone(700, 0.07, 'square', 0.3, 900); },
    bank: function () { tone(520, 0.1, 'square', 0.35, 1040); setTimeout(function () { tone(780, 0.14, 'square', 0.3, 1560); }, 90); },
    ramp: function () { tone(300, 0.35, 'sine', 0.3, 1200); },
    spin: function () { tone(900 + Math.random() * 300, 0.03, 'square', 0.13); },
    hole: function () { tone(200, 0.2, 'sine', 0.35, 90); },
    kickb: function () { tone(120, 0.18, 'sawtooth', 0.4, 600); },
    launch: function () { tone(90, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.4, 420); },
    drain: function () { tone(320, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.35, 60); },
    jack: function () {
      [0, 90, 180, 300].forEach(function (d, i) {
        setTimeout(function () { tone(523 * Math.pow(1.26, i), 0.16, 'square', 0.35); }, d);
      });
    },
    tilt: function () { tone(140, 0.6, 'sawtooth', 0.4, 60); noise(0.4, 0.25); },
    wall: function (v) { if (v > 320) tone(150, 0.03, 'sine', Math.min(0.2, v / 4000)); }
  };

  /* ---------- storage ---------- */
  function best(seed) {
    try { return parseInt(localStorage.getItem('ssp_best_' + seed) || '0', 10) || 0; }
    catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  function setBest(seed, v) {
    try { localStorage.setItem('ssp_best_' + seed, String(v)); } catch (e) { }
  }
  function lastSeed() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem('ssp_seed'); } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  function saveSeed(s) { try { localStorage.setItem('ssp_seed', String(s)); } catch (e) { } }

  return {
    rng: rng, hashSeed: hashSeed, clamp: clamp, lerp: lerp, TAU: TAU,
    closestOnSeg: closestOnSeg, arcPts: arcPts, smooth: smooth,
    seg: seg, chain: chain,
    hitSeg: hitSeg, hitCircle: hitCircle, hitFlipper: hitFlipper,
    Particles: Particles, audioInit: audioInit, SFX: SFX,
    best: best, setBest: setBest, lastSeed: lastSeed, saveSeed: saveSeed,
    setMuted: function (m) { muted = m; }, isMuted: function () { return muted; }
  };
})();
/* Shellshock Pinball - table: static shell + seeded parts grammar */
(function (SS) {
  'use strict';

  var W = SS.W = 430, H = SS.H = 730;
  var D2R = Math.PI / 180;

  function buildShell(T) {
    var S = T.segs;
    // outer top arc
    SS.chain(S, SS.arcPts(216, 150, 206, 132, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2, 26), { rest: 0.36 });
    // left wall / right outer wall
    SS.seg(S, 10, 150, 10, 530, { rest: 0.36 });
    SS.seg(S, 422, 150, 422, 730, { rest: 0.36 });
    // plunger lane divider (straight + curl over the top)
    SS.seg(S, 380, 730, 380, 180, { rest: 0.3 });
    var curl = SS.arcPts(216, 180, 164, 116, 0, -140 * D2R, 22);
    SS.chain(S, curl, { rest: 0.3 });
    T.curl = curl;
    // one-way exit gate at the end of the curl
    var g = SS.seg(S, 90, 105, 74, 140, { rest: 0.2, r: 3 });
    g.oneWay = { x: -0.909, y: -0.416 };
    g.kind = 'gate';
    T.gate = g;
    // plunger floor
    SS.seg(S, 380, 724, 422, 724, { rest: 0.05, kind: 'plungerfloor' });
    // lower funnels
    T.funL = [[10, 530], [13, 600], [46, 672], [60, 712]];
    T.funR = [[380, 530], [377, 600], [344, 672], [330, 712]];
    SS.chain(S, T.funL, { rest: 0.3 });
    SS.chain(S, T.funR, { rest: 0.3 });
    // inlane / outlane dividers (closed quads)
    T.divL = [[48, 580], [136, 644], [130, 656], [42, 590]];
    T.divR = [[342, 580], [254, 644], [260, 656], [348, 590]];
    [T.divL, T.divR].forEach(function (q) {
      SS.chain(S, q.concat([q[0]]), { rest: 0.25, r: 3 });
    });
    // outlane inner guides + under-flipper closers
    T.outL = [[46, 592], [96, 712]];
    T.outR = [[344, 592], [294, 712]];
    SS.chain(S, T.outL, { rest: 0.28, r: 3 });
    SS.chain(S, T.outR, { rest: 0.28, r: 3 });
    // slingshots
    T.slings = [
      { p: [[96, 524], [162, 590], [96, 590]], flash: 0 },
      { p: [[294, 524], [228, 590], [294, 590]], flash: 0 }
    ];
    T.slings.forEach(function (sl) {
      var a = sl.p[0], b = sl.p[1], c = sl.p[2];
      var f = SS.seg(S, a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1], { rest: 0.5, r: 4, kick: 640, kind: 'sling' });
      f.ref = sl;
      SS.seg(S, b[0], b[1], c[0], c[1], { rest: 0.3, r: 3, kind: 'slingedge' });
      SS.seg(S, c[0], c[1], a[0], a[1], { rest: 0.3, r: 3, kind: 'slingedge' });
    });
    // flippers
    T.flipL = { x: 132, y: 652, len: 56, r: 7.5, rest: 30 * D2R, up: -32 * D2R, angle: 30 * D2R, omega: 0, side: -1, on: false };
    T.flipR = { x: 258, y: 652, len: 56, r: 7.5, rest: 150 * D2R, up: 212 * D2R, angle: 150 * D2R, omega: 0, side: 1, on: false };
    // kickback (left outlane)
    T.kick = { x: 54, y: 660, r: 15, charged: true, flash: 0 };
    // ball entry point of the curl
    T.entry = [90, 105];
  }

  /* ---------- parts ---------- */
  function addPops(T, ax, ay, n, rnd) {
    var base = rnd() * SS.TAU;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var a = base + i * SS.TAU / n;
      var rr = 30 + rnd() * 12;
      var p = {
        x: ax + Math.cos(a) * rr, y: ay + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.85,
        r: 17, rest: 0.35, kick: 700, kind: 'pop', flash: 0, hits: 0
      };
      T.circles.push(p); T.pops.push(p);
    }
  }

  function addBank(T, ax, ay, ang, n, rnd) {
    var dx = Math.cos(ang), dy = Math.sin(ang);
    var bank = { x: ax, y: ay, ang: ang, targets: [], flash: 0, done: false, resetAt: 0 };
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var o = (i - (n - 1) / 2) * 21;
      var cx = ax + dx * o, cy = ay + dy * o;
      var t = { cx: cx, cy: cy, down: false, flash: 0, bank: bank };
      var s = SS.seg(T.segs, cx - dx * 8, cy - dy * 8, cx + dx * 8, cy + dy * 8,
        { rest: 0.45, r: 4.5, kind: 'target' });
      s.target = t; t.seg = s;
      bank.targets.push(t);
    }
    T.banks.push(bank);
    return bank;
  }

  function addSpinner(T, ax, ay, ang) {
    var sp = { x: ax, y: ay, ang: ang, rot: 0, vel: 0, r: 17, spins: 0, flash: 0 };
    var dx = Math.cos(ang), dy = Math.sin(ang); // lane direction
    var nx = -dy, ny = dx;
    // chute guides either side of the lane
    SS.seg(T.segs, ax + nx * 26 - dx * 40, ay + ny * 26 - dy * 40, ax + nx * 26 + dx * 40, ay + ny * 26 + dy * 40, { rest: 0.3, r: 3.5 });
    SS.seg(T.segs, ax - nx * 26 - dx * 40, ay - ny * 26 - dy * 40, ax - nx * 26 + dx * 40, ay - ny * 26 + dy * 40, { rest: 0.3, r: 3.5 });
    T.spinner = sp;
  }

  function addHole(T, ax, ay) {
    T.hole = { x: ax, y: ay, r: 14, lit: false, flash: 0, hold: 0, ejectAng: 0 };
    // horseshoe rim so the saucer reads as a target
    var pts = SS.arcPts(ax, ay, 24, 24, 152 * D2R, 388 * D2R, 12);
    SS.chain(T.segs, pts, { rest: 0.4, r: 3 });
  }

  function addRamp(T, rampX, rnd) {
    var exitRight = rampX <= 195;
    var s = exitRight ? 1 : -1;
    var ey = 340;
    // funnel guides into the ramp mouth
    SS.seg(T.segs, rampX - 48, ey + 82, rampX - 23, ey + 2, { rest: 0.35, r: 3.5 });
    SS.seg(T.segs, rampX + 48, ey + 82, rampX + 23, ey + 2, { rest: 0.35, r: 3.5 });
    var ctrl;
    if (exitRight) {
      ctrl = [[rampX, ey], [rampX + 22, 264], [rampX + 76, 194], [296, 134], [356, 246], [364, 402], [348, 512], [316, 574]];
    } else {
      ctrl = [[rampX, ey], [rampX - 22, 264], [rampX - 76, 194], [94, 134], [34, 246], [26, 402], [42, 512], [74, 574]];
    }
    var path = SS.smooth(ctrl, 7);
    var len = 0, cum = [0];
    for (var i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
      len += Math.hypot(path[i][0] - path[i - 1][0], path[i][1] - path[i - 1][1]);
      cum.push(len);
    }
    T.ramp = {
      x: rampX, y: ey, path: path, cum: cum, len: len, exitRight: exitRight,
      flash: 0, mouth: { x1: rampX - 23, y1: ey, x2: rampX + 23, y2: ey }
    };
  }

  /* ---------- generator ---------- */
  SS.genTable = function (seed) {
    var rnd = SS.rng(seed);
    var T = {
      seed: seed, segs: [], circles: [], pops: [], banks: [], posts: [],
      ramp: null, spinner: null, hole: null

    function free(a, r) {
      if (a[0] < 44 || a[0] > 346 || a[1] < 118 || a[1] > 486) return false;
      for (var i = 0; i < used.length; i++) {
        if (Math.hypot(a[0] - used[i].x, a[1] - used[i].y) < r + used[i].r) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }
    function shuffle(arr) {
      var a = arr.slice();
      for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        var j = Math.floor(rnd() * (i + 1)); var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
      }
      return a;
    }

    var low = shuffle([[108, 440], [282, 440], [195, 462]]);

    function take(list, r) {
      for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
        if (free(list[i], r)) { var a = list.splice(i, 1)[0]; used.push({ x: a[0], y: a[1], r: r }); return a; }
      }
      for (var j = 0; j < pool.length; j++) {
        if (free(pool[j], r)) {
          var b = pool[j];
          var k = list.indexOf(b); if (k >= 0) list.splice(k, 1);
          pool.splice(j, 1);
          used.push({ x: b[0], y: b[1], r: r }); return b;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    function sync(a) { var i = pool.indexOf(a); if (i >= 0) pool.splice(i, 1); }

    var pa = take(upper, 58); if (pa) { sync(pa); addPops(T, pa[0], pa[1], 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 2), rnd); }

      sync(ba); removeFrom(upper, ba); removeFrom(mid, ba);
      addBank(T, ba[0], ba[1], (rnd() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (20 + rnd() * 45) * D2R, 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 3), rnd);
    }
    // spinner lane
    var sa = take(mid, 46);
    if (sa) { sync(sa); addSpinner(T, sa[0], sa[1], (75 + rnd() * 30) * D2R); }
    // second drop bank
    var b2 = take(low, 50);
    if (b2) { sync(b2); addBank(T, b2[0], b2[1], (rnd() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (15 + rnd() * 40) * D2R, 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 2), rnd); }

    else { sync(ha); removeFrom(upper, ha); removeFrom(mid, ha); removeFrom(low, ha); }
    addHole(T, ha[0], ha[1]);
    T.hole.ejectAng = (rnd() < 0.5 ? -125 : -55) * D2R;

    // scattered rubber posts
    var np = 4 + Math.floor(rnd() * 4);
    for (var i = 0, guard = 0; i < np && guard < 200; guard++) {
      var px = 50 + rnd() * 296, py = 150 + rnd() * 330;

      used.push({ x: px, y: py, r: 20 });
      var post = { x: px, y: py, r: 6.5, rest: 0.62, kind: 'post', flash: 0 };
      T.circles.push(post); T.posts.push(post);
      i++;
    }

    function removeFrom(list, a) { var i = list.indexOf(a); if (i >= 0) list.splice(i, 1); }

    T.name = tableName(seed);
    return T;
  };

  var ADJ = ['CRIMSON', 'HOLLOW', 'IRON', 'VOLT', 'GLASS', 'NEON', 'ASH', 'DEEP', 'STORM', 'COBALT', 'RUST', 'PRISM'];
  var NOUN = ['CARAPACE', 'REEF', 'FORGE', 'SPIRE', 'BASIN', 'CIRCUIT', 'MOLT', 'HARBOR', 'VAULT', 'DRIFT', 'SHELL', 'CRATER'];
  function tableName(seed) {
    var r = SS.rng(seed ^ 0x9e37);
    return ADJ[Math.floor(r() * ADJ.length)] + ' ' + NOUN[Math.floor(r() * NOUN.length)];
  }
})(SS);

  }
  function btn(x, y, w, h, label, col) {
    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,32,54,0.95)'; roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10); g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = col; g.lineWidth = 2; roundRect(x, y, w, h, 10); g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle = col; g.font = 'bold 17px ui-monospace,monospace'; g.textAlign = 'center';
    g.fillText(label, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 6);
  }

  function render() {
    g.setTransform(view.f, 0, 0, view.f, 0, 0);
    g.clearRect(0, 0, CWID, CH);
    g.fillStyle = '#07080d'; g.fillRect(0, 0, CWID, CH);
    drawHUD();
    g.save();
    g.beginPath(); g.rect(0, HUD, CWID, TH); g.clip();
    var sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake + nudgeOff.x;
    var sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake + nudgeOff.y;
    g.translate(sx, HUD + sy);
    drawPlayfield();
    drawSegs();
    drawSlings();
    drawBanks();
    drawPops();
    drawSpinner();
    drawHole();
    drawKick();
    drawPlunger();
    drawFlipper(T.flipL); drawFlipper(T.flipR);
    if (ball.state !== 'ramp') drawBall();
    drawRamp();
    if (ball.state === 'ramp') drawBall();
    parts.draw(g);
    drawPops2();
    if (S.tilt) {
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,60,60,0.10)'; g.fillRect(0, 0, CWID, TH);
      g.fillStyle = '#ff5a5a'; g.font = 'bold 40px ui-monospace,monospace'; g.textAlign = 'center';
      g.fillText('TILT', 195, 380);
    }
    g.restore();
    drawOverlay();
  }

  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
  var last = 0;
  function frame(ts) {
    if (!last) last = ts;
    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    if (S.plunging && ball.state === 'ready') S.launchPow = SS.clamp(S.launchPow + dt * 1.3, 0, 1);
    update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  SS.debug = function () { return { S: S, ball: ball, T: T, nudge: nudge, launch: launch }; };

  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
  var stored = SS.lastSeed();
  var startSeed = stored ? (parseInt(stored, 10) >>> 0) : ((Math.random() * 4294967295) >>> 0);
  if (!startSeed) startSeed = 12345;
  newGame(startSeed);
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})(SS);

   200	      }
   201	    }
   202	    const speed = p.dash > 0 ? 530 : 154;
   203	    const oldX = p.x, oldY = p.y;
   204	    p.x += v.x * speed * dt;
   205	    p.y += v.y * speed * dt;
   206	    if (p.dash > 0) p.dash -= dt;
   207	    p.x = clamp(p.x, arena.l + p.r, arena.r - p.r - 2);
   208	    p.y = clamp(p.y, arena.t + p.r, arena.b - p.r);

   211	      p.trail.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, life: .28 });
   212	      if (p.trail.length > 8) p.trail.shift();
   213	    }
   214	    p.trail.forEach(t => t.life -= dt);
   215	    p.trail = p.trail.filter(t => t.life > 0);
   216	    if (game.key && !game.key.collected && distance(p, game.key) < 25) {
   217	      game.key.collected = true;
   218	      burst(game.key.x, game.key.y, 49, 20);
   219	      game.shake = .16;
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	  function collidesObstacle(x, y, r) {
   223	    return game.rooms[game.roomIndex].obstacles.some(o => {
   224	      const nx = clamp(x, o.x, o.x + o.w), ny = clamp(y, o.y, o.y + o.h);
   225	      return Math.hypot(x - nx, y - ny) < r;
   226	    });
   227	  }

   229	  function doAttack() {
   230	    const p = game.player;
   231	    burst(p.x + p.faceX * 24, p.y + p.faceY * 24, 42, 4);
   232	    for (const e of game.enemies) {
   233	      const dx = e.x - p.x, dy = e.y - p.y, dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   234	      const dot = (dx * p.faceX + dy * p.faceY) / dist;
   235	      if (dist < (e.type === 'warden' ? 62 : 55) && dot > -.12 && e.hitCooldown <= 0) {
   236	        e.hp -= 1;

   240	        e.y += dy / dist * 16;

   242	        game.shake = .1;
   243	        if (e.hp <= 0) {
   244	          burst(e.x, e.y, e.type === 'warden' ? 322 : 8, e.type === 'warden' ? 26 : 13);
   245	        }
   246	      }
   247	    }
   248	    game.enemies = game.enemies.filter(e => e.hp > 0);
   249	  }

   251	  function updateEnemies(dt) {

   289	  function updateBolts(dt) {
   290	    for (const b of game.bolts) {

   300	  function updateHazards(dt) {

   101	        if (row > 1 && state.rng() < 0.13 + (level % 3) * 0.025) present = false;
   102	        if (row === rows - 1 && state.rng() < 0.18) present = false;
   103	        if (level % 5 === 0 && row === 0 && col > 0 && col < cols - 1) present = state.rng() > 0.18;
   104	        if (present) {
   105	          const hp = 1 + (level > 3 && state.rng() < 0.22 ? 1 : 0) + (level > 8 && state.rng() < 0.12 ? 1 : 0);
   106	          bricks.push({
   107	            row, col, x: side + col * (bw + gap), y: top + row * (bh + gap), w: bw, h: bh,
   108	            hp, maxHp: hp, mass: 0.7 + state.rng() * 1.4, color: palette[(row + col + level) % palette.length],
   109	            alive: true, support: false, hit: 0
   110	          });
   111	        }
   112	      }
   113	    }
   114	    state.bricks = bricks;
   115	    state.wallRemaining = bricks.length;
   116	    state.boss = level % 5 === 0 ? { x: W / 2, y: top - 32, r: 18, hp: 9 + level * 2, maxHp: 9 + level * 2, t: 0 } : null;
   117	    state.debris.length = 0; state.powerups.length = 0; state.lasers.length = 0; state.stars.length = 0;
   118	    state.particles.length = 0; state.combo = 0; state.comboTimer = 0; state.shake = 0; state.flash = 0;
   119	    state.paddle.stun = 0; state.paddle.sticky = 0; state.paddle.laser = 0;
   120	    state.paddle.y = H - 74; state.paddle.x = W / 2; state.paddle.targetX = W / 2;
   121	    state.balls = [newBall(true)]; state.armed = true; state.levelStart = performance.now();
   122	    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) state.stars.push({ x: rand(0, W), y: rand(0, H), r: rand(0.5, 1.7), a: rand(0.2, 0.8) });
   123	    collapseUnsupported(false);
   124	  }
   125	
   126	  function newBall(attached = false, source = null) {
   127	    return {
   128	      x: state.paddle.x, y: state.paddle.y - 12, r: source ? source.r : 7,
   129	      vx: 0, vy: 0, launched: !attached, stuck: attached, heavy: !!(source && source.heavy),
   130	      color: source ? source.color : '#f8ffff', trail: []
   131	    };
   132	  }
   133	  function launchBall(ball) {
   134	    if (!ball) return;
   135	    ball.stuck = false; ball.launched = true;
   136	    const speed = 305 + Math.min(85, state.level * 5);
   137	    const angle = rand(-0.72, 0.72);
   138	    ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed; ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed;
   139	    state.armed = false; beep(420, 0.08, 'triangle');
   140	  }
   141	  function action() {
   142	    if (state.phase !== 'play') { restart(); return; }
   143	    wakeAudio();
   144	    const held = state.balls.find(b => b.stuck || !b.launched);
   145	    if (held) launchBall(held);
   146	    else if (state.paddle.laser > 0) fireLaser();
   147	  }
   148	
   149	  function destroyBrick(brick, source = 'ball') {
   150	    if (!brick || !brick.alive) return;
   151	    brick.alive = false; state.wallRemaining--;
   152	    const points = source === 'crush' ? 16 : 24;
   153	    state.combo = Math.min(99, state.combo + 1); state.comboTimer = 2.2;
   154	    addScore(points + state.combo * 3); state.shake = Math.min(12, state.shake + 2.5); state.flash = 0.05;
   155	    burst(brick.x + brick.w / 2, brick.y + brick.h / 2, brick.color, source === 'crush' ? 8 : 14);
   156	    beep(source === 'crush' ? 125 : 190 + state.combo * 8, 0.035, 'square');
   157	    if (state.rng() < 0.14) dropPowerup(brick.x + brick.w / 2, brick.y + brick.h / 2);
   158	    if (state.wallRemaining <= 0 && (!state.boss || state.boss.hp <= 0)) completeWall();
   159	    else collapseUnsupported(true);
   160	  }
   161	  function collapseUnsupported(makeDebris) {
   162	    const alive = state.bricks.filter(b => b.alive);
   163	    const supported = new Set();
   164	    const open = [];
   165	    for (const b of alive) if (b.row === 0 || b.col === 0 || b.col === Math.max(...state.bricks.map(x => x.col))) { supported.add(b); open.push(b); }
   166	    while (open.length) {
   167	      const b = open.pop();
   168	      for (const n of alive) {
   169	        if (supported.has(n)) continue;
   170	        if (Math.abs(n.row - b.row) + Math.abs(n.col - b.col) === 1) { supported.add(n); open.push(n); }
   171	      }
   172	    }
   173	    for (const b of alive) {
   174	      b.support = supported.has(b);
   175	      if (!b.support) {
   176	        b.alive = false; state.wallRemaining--;
   177	        if (makeDebris) {
   178	          state.debris.push({ x: b.x, y: b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h, vx: rand(-45, 45), vy: rand(15, 60),
   179	            angle: rand(-0.2, 0.2), spin: rand(-3, 3), color: b.color, mass: b.mass, life: 10 });
   180	          burst(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, b.color, 4);
   181	        }
   182	      }
   183	    }
   184	    if (state.wallRemaining <= 0 && (!state.boss || state.boss.hp <= 0) && state.phase === 'play') completeWall();
   185	  }
   186	
   187	  function dropPowerup(x, y) {
   188	    const types = ['multi', 'wreck', 'sticky', 'laser'];
   189	    state.powerups.push({ x, y, w: 30, h: 17, vy: 65, type: types[Math.floor(rand(0, types.length))], t: rand(0, TAU) });
   190	  }
   191	  function applyPowerup(type) {
   192	    state.shake = 7; beep(650, 0.11, 'sine');
   193	    if (type === 'multi') {
   194	      const base = state.balls.find(b => b.launched) || state.balls[0];
   195	      if (base) {
   196	        for (const sign of [-1, 1]) state.balls.push({ ...base, vx: base.vx * 0.68 + sign * 115, vy: base.vy * 0.94, trail: [], color: '#8bf6e7' });
   197	      }
   198	    } else if (type === 'wreck') {
   199	      state.balls.forEach(b => { b.heavy = true; b.r = Math.max(b.r, 10); b.color = '#ffca66'; });
   200	    } else if (type === 'sticky') state.paddle.sticky = 12;
   201	    else if (type === 'laser') state.paddle.laser = 12;
   202	    burst(state.paddle.x, state.paddle.y, powerColor(type), 22);
   203	  }
   204	  function powerColor(type) { return type === 'multi' ? '#64e6d4' : type === 'wreck' ? '#ffbd5c' : type === 'sticky' ? '#d593ff' : '#ff719d'; }
   205	
   206	  function fireLaser() {
   207	    state.lasers.push({ x: state.paddle.x - 25, y: state.paddle.y - 12, w: 4, h: 16, vy: -520 },
   208	      { x: state.paddle.x + 21, y: state.paddle.y - 12, w: 4, h: 16, vy: -520 });
   209	    beep(770, 0.04, 'sawtooth');
   210	  }
   211	  function completeWall() {
   212	    if (state.phase !== 'play') return;
   213	    state.phase = 'clear'; state.armed = true; state.shake = 12; burst(W / 2, H * 0.38, '#fff4a8', 55); beep(820, 0.18, 'triangle');
   214	    setTimeout(() => { if (state.phase === 'clear') { state.level++; state.phase = 'play'; buildLevel(state.level); } }, 900);
   215	  }
   216	  function loseBall(ball) {
   217	    const idx = state.balls.indexOf(ball); if (idx < 0) return;
   218	    state.balls.splice(idx, 1); burst(ball.x, H - 14, '#ff668c', 18); state.shake = 10; beep(90, 0.12, 'sawtooth');
   219	    if (state.balls.length === 0) {
   220	      state.lives--;
   221	      if (state.lives <= 0) { state.phase = 'over'; state.armed = false; return; }
   222	      state.balls = [newBall(true)]; state.armed = true; state.paddle.stun = 0;
   223	    }
   224	  }
   225	  function restart() {
   226	    state.phase = 'play'; state.level = 1; state.lives = 3; state.score = 0; state.paddle.x = W / 2; state.paddle.targetX = W / 2; buildLevel(1); wakeAudio();
   227	  }
   228	
   229	  function update(dt) {
   230	    if (state.phase === 'over') { updateParticles(dt); return; }
   231	    dt = Math.min(0.032, dt);
   232	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 22); state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt); state.comboTimer -= dt;
   233	    if (state.comboTimer <= 0) state.combo = 0;
   234	    const p = state.paddle;
   235	    if (state.paddle.stun > 0) state.paddle.stun -= dt;
   236	    if (p.sticky > 0) p.sticky -= dt;
   237	    if (p.laser > 0) p.laser -= dt;
   238	    const keyboard = (keyRight ? 1 : 0) - (keyLeft ? 1 : 0);
   239	    if (keyboard) p.targetX += keyboard * 430 * dt;
   240	    p.targetX = clamp(p.targetX, p.w / 2 + 8, W - p.w / 2 - 8);
   241	    const follow = p.stun > 0 ? 0.12 : 0.28;
   242	    p.x += (p.targetX - p.x) * Math.min(1, follow * 60 * dt);
   243	    if (state.boss) { state.boss.t += dt; state.boss.x = W / 2 + Math.sin(state.boss.t * 1.4) * (W * 0.33); }
   244	    for (const ball of [...state.balls]) updateBall(ball, dt);
   245	    updateDebris(dt); updatePowerups(dt); updateLasers(dt); updateParticles(dt);
   245	    updateDebris(dt); updatePowerups(dt); updateLasers(dt); updateParticles(dt);
   246	    if (state.phase === 'play' && state.boss && state.boss.hp <= 0) {
   247	      state.boss = null; addScore(500); burst(W / 2, 74, '#fff2a5', 35);
   248	      if (state.wallRemaining <= 0) completeWall();
   249	    }
   250	  }
   251	  function updateBall(ball, dt) {
   252	    if (ball.stuck || !ball.launched) { ball.x = state.paddle.x; ball.y = state.paddle.y - ball.r - 3; return; }
   253	    ball.trail.push({ x: ball.x, y: ball.y }); if (ball.trail.length > 6) ball.trail.shift();
   254	    ball.x += ball.vx * dt; ball.y += ball.vy * dt;
   255	    if (ball.x < ball.r) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); beep(120, 0.018); }
   256	    if (ball.x > W - ball.r) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); beep(120, 0.018); }
   257	    if (ball.y < 62 + ball.r) { ball.y = 62 + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); beep(120, 0.018); }
   258	    const p = state.paddle;
   259	    if (ball.vy > 0 && circleRectHit(ball, { x: p.x - p.w / 2, y: p.y, w: p.w, h: p.h })) {
   260	      ball.y = p.y - ball.r - 1;
   261	      const hit = clamp((ball.x - p.x) / (p.w / 2), -1, 1);
   262	      const speed = clamp(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.015, 260, ball.heavy ? 475 : 420);
   263	      ball.vx = hit * speed * 0.92; ball.vy = -Math.sqrt(Math.max(120, speed * speed - ball.vx * ball.vx));
   264	      if (p.sticky > 0 && !ball.stuck) { ball.stuck = true; ball.launched = false; state.armed = true; }
   265	      burst(ball.x, p.y, ball.heavy ? '#ffca66' : '#eaffff', 4); beep(245, 0.025);
   266	    }
   267	    for (const d of state.debris) {
   268	      if (!circleRectHit(ball, d)) continue;
   269	      if (ball.heavy) { d.life = 0; addScore(12); burst(ball.x, ball.y, d.color, 5); }
   270	      else { bounceFromRect(ball, d); d.life -= 1.5; }
   271	      state.shake = Math.min(8, state.shake + 1.2); break;
   272	    }
   273	    for (const b of state.bricks) {
   274	      if (!b.alive || !circleRectHit(ball, b)) continue;
   275	      const beforeY = ball.y;
   276	      b.hit = 0.12; b.hp -= ball.heavy ? 2 : 1;
   277	      if (b.hp <= 0) destroyBrick(b, 'ball'); else { addScore(4); burst(ball.x, ball.y, b.color, 3); beep(240, 0.022); }
   278	      if (!ball.heavy || b.hp > 0) bounceFromRect(ball, b); else {
   279	        ball.vy *= 1.015; ball.vx *= 1.015;
   280	        if (Math.abs(ball.y - beforeY) < 0.2) ball.vy *= -1;
   281	      }
   282	      break;
   283	    }
   284	    if (state.boss && circleRectHit(ball, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 })) {
   285	      state.boss.hp -= ball.heavy ? 2 : 1; bounceFromRect(ball, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 });
   286	      burst(state.boss.x, state.boss.y, '#fff19a', 6); addScore(12); state.shake = 4;
   287	    }
   288	    if (ball.y - ball.r > H + 20) loseBall(ball);
   289	  }
   290	  function bounceFromRect(ball, rect) {
   291	    const left = Math.abs(ball.x - rect.x), right = Math.abs(ball.x - (rect.x + rect.w));
   292	    const top = Math.abs(ball.y - rect.y), bottom = Math.abs(ball.y - (rect.y + rect.h));
   293	    if (Math.min(left, right) < Math.min(top, bottom)) ball.vx *= -1; else ball.vy *= -1;
   294	    const speed = clamp(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * 1.003, 230, ball.heavy ? 470 : 410);
   295	    const len = Math.max(1, Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy)); ball.vx = ball.vx / len * speed; ball.vy = ball.vy / len * speed;
   296	  }
   297	
   298	  function updateDebris(dt) {
   299	    for (const d of state.debris) {
   300	      d.vy += 370 * d.mass * dt; d.x += d.vx * dt; d.y += d.vy * dt; d.angle += d.spin * dt; d.life -= dt;
   301	      if (d.x < -40 || d.x > W + 40 || d.y > H + 60) d.life = 0;
   302	      const box = { x: d.x, y: d.y, w: d.w, h: d.h };
   303	      if (d.vy > 0 && rectsHit(box, { x: state.paddle.x - state.paddle.w / 2, y: state.paddle.y, w: state.paddle.w, h: state.paddle.h })) {
   304	        d.life = 0; state.paddle.stun = Math.max(state.paddle.stun, 0.8); state.shake = 9; burst(d.x + d.w / 2, state.paddle.y, '#ff718d', 10); beep(72, 0.08, 'sawtooth');
   305	      }
   306	      if (d.vy > 0) for (const b of state.bricks) {
   307	        if (b.alive && rectsHit(box, b)) { destroyBrick(b, 'crush'); d.life = 0; break; }
   308	      }
   309	    }
   310	    state.debris = state.debris.filter(d => d.life > 0);
   311	  }
   312	  function updatePowerups(dt) {
   313	    for (const p of state.powerups) {
   314	      p.y += p.vy * dt; p.t += dt * 4;
   315	      if (rectsHit({ x: p.x - p.w / 2, y: p.y - p.h / 2, w: p.w, h: p.h }, { x: state.paddle.x - state.paddle.w / 2, y: state.paddle.y - 5, w: state.paddle.w, h: state.paddle.h + 10 })) { p.y = H + 99; applyPowerup(p.type); }
   316	    }
   317	    state.powerups = state.powerups.filter(p => p.y < H + 30);
   318	  }
   319	  function updateLasers(dt) {
   320	    for (const l of state.lasers) {
   321	      l.y += l.vy * dt;
   322	      for (const b of state.bricks) if (b.alive && rectsHit(l, b)) { l.y = -100; destroyBrick(b, 'laser'); break; }
   323	      if (state.boss && rectsHit(l, { x: state.boss.x - state.boss.r, y: state.boss.y - state.boss.r, w: state.boss.r * 2, h: state.boss.r * 2 })) { state.boss.hp--; l.y = -100; burst(state.boss.x, state.boss.y, '#ff8bb5', 4); }
   324	    }
   325	    state.lasers = state.lasers.filter(l => l.y > -30);
   326	  }
   327	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   328	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) state.particles.push({ x, y, vx: rand(-125, 125), vy: rand(-145, 85), life: rand(0.3, 0.8), max: 0.8, size: rand(1.5, 4), color });
   329	  }
   330	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   331	    for (const q of state.particles) { q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vy += 210 * dt; q.life -= dt; }
   332	    state.particles = state.particles.filter(q => q.life > 0);
   333	  }
   334	
   335	  function draw() {
   336	    ctx.setTransform(pixelScale, 0, 0, pixelScale, 0, 0);
   337	    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H); g.addColorStop(0, '#0a1021'); g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0b1020'); g.addColorStop(1, '#121021');
   338	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   339	    ctx.save();
   340	    const sx = state.shake ? rand(-state.shake, state.shake) : 0, sy = state.shake ? rand(-state.shake, state.shake) : 0; ctx.translate(sx, sy);
   341	    drawStars(); drawHud(); drawArena();
   342	    for (const b of state.bricks) if (b.alive) drawBrick(b);
   343	    for (const d of state.debris) drawDebris(d);
   344	    if (state.boss) drawBoss();
   345	    for (const p of state.powerups) drawPowerup(p);
   346	    for (const l of state.lasers) { ctx.fillStyle = '#ff8bb5'; ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6b9b'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12; roundedRect(ctx, l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h, 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.shadowBlur = 0; }
   347	    drawPaddle(); for (const ball of state.balls) drawBall(ball); drawParticles();
   348	    ctx.restore();
   349	    if (state.flash) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${state.flash * 2})`; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); }
   350	    if (state.phase === 'over') drawEndCard();
   351	  }
   352	  function drawStars() {
   353	    ctx.fillStyle = '#d8e6ff'; for (const s of state.stars) { ctx.globalAlpha = s.a; ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r); } ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   354	  }
   355	  function drawHud() {
   356	    ctx.fillStyle = '#f3f7ff'; ctx.font = `700 14px ${FONT}`; ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
   357	    ctx.fillText('BREACH & BRICK', 14, 15);
   358	    ctx.fillStyle = '#8591b1'; ctx.font = `11px ${FONT}`; ctx.fillText(`WALL ${String(state.level).padStart(2, '0')}`, 14, 36);
   359	    ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillStyle = '#e8f0ff'; ctx.font = `700 14px ${FONT}`; ctx.fillText(String(state.score).padStart(5, '0'), W - 14, 15);
   360	    ctx.fillStyle = '#8591b1'; ctx.font = `11px ${FONT}`; ctx.fillText(`BEST ${String(state.best).padStart(5, '0')}`, W - 14, 36); ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   361	    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = i < state.lives ? '#ff719d' : '#2a2f42'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(18 + i * 18, 62, 5, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   362	    if (state.combo > 1 && state.comboTimer > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = '#ffc85b'; ctx.font = `700 11px ${FONT}`; ctx.fillText(`COMBO x${state.combo}`, 78, 57); }
   363	    if (state.paddle.sticky > 0 || state.paddle.laser > 0) {
   364	      ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.font = `10px ${FONT}`; ctx.fillStyle = state.paddle.laser > 0 ? '#ff8bb5' : '#d593ff';
   365	      ctx.fillText(`${state.paddle.laser > 0 ? 'LASER' : 'STICKY'} ${Math.ceil(Math.max(state.paddle.laser, state.paddle.sticky))}`, W - 14, 57); ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   366	    }
   367	  }
   368	  function drawArena() {
   369	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(105,133,190,0.2)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(8, 75); ctx.lineTo(W - 8, 75); ctx.stroke();
   370	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(90,120,190,0.05)'; ctx.fillRect(8, 78, W - 16, H - 160);
   371	    if (state.armed && state.phase === 'play') { ctx.fillStyle = '#8998ba'; ctx.font = `11px ${FONT}`; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('DRAG TO STEER  •  TAP TO LAUNCH', W / 2, H - 25); ctx.textAlign = 'left'; }
   372	  }
   373	  function drawBrick(b) {
   374	    const alpha = b.support ? 1 : 0.8; ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
   375	    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(b.x, b.y, b.x, b.y + b.h); grad.addColorStop(0, b.color); grad.addColorStop(1, shade(b.color, -0.42));
   376	    ctx.fillStyle = grad; roundedRect(ctx, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 5); ctx.fill();
   377	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.23)'; roundedRect(ctx, b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, 3, 2); ctx.fill();
   378	    if (b.maxHp > 1) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,8,18,0.45)'; ctx.fillRect(b.x + 7, b.y + b.h - 5, (b.w - 14) * (b.hp / b.maxHp), 2); }
   379	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   380	  }
   381	  function drawDebris(d) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2); ctx.rotate(d.angle); ctx.fillStyle = shade(d.color, -0.25); roundedRect(ctx, -d.w / 2, -d.h / 2, d.w, d.h, 4); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'; ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }
   382	  function drawBoss() {
   383	    const b = state.boss; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(b.x, b.y); ctx.rotate(b.t * 0.7); ctx.fillStyle = '#3a2849'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff719d'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r + 7, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
   384	    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcf69'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r * 0.62 + Math.sin(b.t * 6) * 2, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = '#fff5c4'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-4, -4, 4, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore();
   385	    ctx.fillStyle = '#27182e'; ctx.fillRect(W * 0.25, 80, W * 0.5, 4); ctx.fillStyle = '#ff719d'; ctx.fillRect(W * 0.25, 80, W * 0.5 * b.hp / b.maxHp, 4);

    55	  function reverseCandidates(state, w, h) {
    56	    const out = [];

    58	    for (const d of DIRS) {
    59	      const px = x + d.x;

    66	      const crate = getCrate(state.crates, x + d.x, y + d.y);

    70	        out.push({ kind: "push", dx: d.x, dy: d.y, crate });
    71	      }
    72	    }

    75	  function applyReverse(state, op) {
    76	    const old = clonePoint(state.worker);

   579	  }

   111	  var A = { ctx: null, master: null };
   112	  function ensureAudio() {
   113	    if (A.ctx) { if (A.ctx.state === 'suspended') A.ctx.resume(); return; }
   114	    var C = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   115	    if (!C) return;
   116	    try {
   117	      A.ctx = new C();
   118	      A.master = A.ctx.createGain();
   119	      A.master.gain.value = 0.22;
   120	      A.master.connect(A.ctx.destination);
   121	    } catch (err) { A.ctx = null; }
   122	  }
   123	  function tone(freq, dur, type, vol, slideTo) {
   124	    if (!A.ctx) return;
   125	    var t = A.ctx.currentTime;
   126	    var o = A.ctx.createOscillator(), g = A.ctx.createGain();
   127	    o.type = type || 'square';
   128	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
   129	    if (slideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, slideTo), t + dur);
   130	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
   131	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0002, vol || 0.2), t + 0.006);
   132	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   133	    o.connect(g); g.connect(A.master);
   134	    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
   135	  }
   136	  var noiseBuf = null;
   137	  function noise(dur, vol, freq) {
   138	    if (!A.ctx) return;
   139	    if (!noiseBuf) {
   140	      noiseBuf = A.ctx.createBuffer(1, A.ctx.sampleRate * 0.5, A.ctx.sampleRate);
   141	      var d = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
   142	      for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
   143	    }
   144	    var t = A.ctx.currentTime;
   145	    var s = A.ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = noiseBuf;
   146	    var f = A.ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'lowpass';
   147	    f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq || 1200, t);
   148	    f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(120, t + dur);
   149	    var g = A.ctx.createGain();
   150	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol || 0.25, t);
   151	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
   152	    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(A.master);
   153	    s.start(t); s.stop(t + dur);
   154	  }

   157	  var parts = [];
   158	  function spawnParts(x, y, n, color, speed, size, life) {
   159	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   160	      if (parts.length > 340) break;
   161	      var a = Math.random() * TAU, sp = speed * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.85);
   162	      parts.push({
   163	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
   164	        life: (life || 0.5) * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), max: life || 0.5,
   165	        s: size || 2.5, c: color
   166	      });
   167	    }
   168	  }
   169	  function updateParts(dt) {
   170	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   171	      var p = parts[i];
   172	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
   173	      p.vx *= 0.94; p.vy = p.vy * 0.94 + 26 * dt;
   174	      p.life -= dt;
   175	      if (p.life <= 0) parts.splice(i, 1);
   176	    }
   177	  }
   178	  function drawParts(c) {
   179	    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {

   183	      c.fillStyle = p.c;
   184	      var s = p.s * (0.4 + a * 0.8);
   185	      c.fillRect(p.x - s * 0.5, p.y - s * 0.5, s, s);
   186	    }
   187	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
   188	  }

   118	          rec.role = 'punch'; self.btn.punch = true; self.tap.punch = true;
   119	        } else if (dJump < L.jump.r * 1.35) {
   120	          rec.role = 'jump'; self.btn.jump = true; self.tap.jump = true;
   121	        } else if (p.x < L.w * 0.5 && self.stick.id < 0) {
   122	          rec.role = 'stick';
   123	          self.stick.active = true; self.stick.id = id;
   124	          self.stick.ox = p.x; self.stick.oy = p.y;
   125	          self.stick.x = p.x; self.stick.y = p.y;
   126	          self.stick.dx = 0; self.stick.dy = 0; self.stick.mag = 0;
   127	        } else {
   128	          rec.role = 'swipe';
   129	        }
   130	        self._ptr[id] = rec;
   131	      };
   132	
   133	      const move = (id, p) => {
   134	        const rec = self._ptr[id];

   138	          const L = self.layout();
   139	          let dx = p.x - self.stick.ox, dy = p.y - self.stick.oy;
   140	          const m = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   141	          const R = L.stickR;
   142	          if (m > R) { // drag origin along (floating stick)
   143	            self.stick.ox += dx * (1 - R / m);
   144	            self.stick.oy += dy * (1 - R / m);
   145	            dx *= R / m; dy *= R / m;
   146	          }
   147	          self.stick.x = p.x; self.stick.y = p.y;
   148	          self.stick.dx = dx / R; self.stick.dy = dy / R;
   149	          self.stick.mag = Math.min(1, m / R);
   150	        }
   151	      };
   152	
   153	      const up = (id) => {
   154	        const rec = self._ptr[id];
   155	        if (!rec) return;
   156	        delete self._ptr[id];

   167	        } else if (rec.role === 'jump') {

   169	        } else if (rec.role === 'swipe') {
   170	          if (dist > L.swipeMin && dt < 500) self.swipes.push({ dx: dx, dy: dy });
   171	        }

   100	  function buildStage(n) {
   101	    L = segLen();
   102	    const rng = makeRng(G.seed + n * 7919);
   103	    G.stage = n;
   104	    G.seg = 0; G.camX = 0; G.camLock = null; G.goT = 0;
   105	    G.foes = []; G.items = []; G.props = []; G.shots = []; G.pending = []; G.boss = null;
   106	    G.bossName = BOSS_NAMES[(n - 1) % BOSS_NAMES.length];
   107	    G.blockName = BLOCK_NAMES[(n - 1) % BLOCK_NAMES.length];
   108	    G.waves = [];
   109	    const diff = 1 + (n - 1) * 0.28;
   110	
   111	    for (let s = 0; s < SEGS; s++) {
   112	      const start = s * L;
   113	      // props & items
   114	      const nProps = rng.int(3, 6);
   115	      for (let i = 0; i < nProps; i++) {
   116	        G.props.push({
   117	          x: start + rng.range(W * 0.4, L - W * 0.3),
   118	          z: rng.pick(LANES) + rng.range(-0.06, 0.06),
   119	          kind: rng.pick(['bin', 'barrel', 'bin']),
   120	          hp: 2, hitT: 0
   121	        });
   122	      }
   123	      if (s < SEGS - 1 && rng() < 0.85) {
   124	        G.items.push(mkItem('pipe', start + rng.range(W * 0.5, L - W * 0.4), rng.pick(LANES)));
   125	      }
   126	      if (rng() < 0.7) {
   127	        G.items.push(mkItem('crate', start + rng.range(W * 0.5, L - W * 0.4), rng.pick(LANES)));
   128	      }
   129	      // waves
   130	      if (s < SEGS - 1) {
   131	        const wCount = s === 0 ? 2 : (rng() < 0.5 ? 2 : 3);
   132	        for (let w = 0; w < wCount; w++) {
   133	          const list = [];
   134	          const size = Math.min(6, 2 + Math.round(rng.range(0, 1.4) + s * 0.6 + diff * 0.7));
   135	          for (let k = 0; k < size; k++) {
   136	            let t = 'rusher';
   137	            const r = rng();
   138	            if (r < 0.30) t = 'rusher';
   139	            else if (r < 0.52) t = 'tosser';
   140	            else if (r < 0.72) t = 'acro';
   141	            else if (r < 0.88) t = 'rusher';
   142	            else t = 'heavy';
   143	            if (s === 0 && w === 0 && (t === 'heavy')) t = 'rusher';
   144	            list.push(t);
   145	            if (t === 'acro') list.push('acro'); // twins
   146	          }
   147	          G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: wCount === 2 ? (w === 0 ? 0.18 : 0.96) : (w * 0.42 + 0.14), list: list, done: false });
   148	        }
   149	      } else {
   150	        G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: 0.20, list: ['rusher', 'rusher', 'tosser'], done: false });
   151	        G.waves.push({ seg: s, f: 0.92, list: ['BOSS'], done: false });
   152	      }
   153	    }
   154	    buildSky();
   155	    banner('STAGE ' + n + ' — ' + G.blockName, 2.0);
   156	  }

   165	  function spawnFoe(type, side) {
   166	    const c = FOE[type === 'BOSS' ? 'boss' : type];
   167	    const isBoss = type === 'BOSS';
   168	    const diff = 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.22;
   169	    const x = side > 0 ? G.camX + W + 40 + Math.random() * 120 : G.camX - 40 - Math.random() * 120;
   170	    const f = {
   171	      kind: 'foe', type: isBoss ? 'boss' : type, x: x,
   172	      z: clamp(LANES[Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)] + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08, 0.05, 0.95),
   173	      y: 0, vx: 0, vz: 0, vy: 0, face: side > 0 ? -1 : 1,
   174	      maxhp: Math.round(c.hp * (isBoss ? 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.35 : diff)),
   175	      spd: c.spd, dmg: Math.round(c.dmg * (isBoss ? 1 + (G.stage - 1) * 0.16 : Math.min(2, diff))),
   176	      w: c.w, col: c.col, col2: c.col2, score: c.score,
   177	      state: 'idle', st: 0, inv: 0, hurtT: 0, downT: 0,
   178	      atk: null, atkT: 0, hasHit: false, think: Math.random() * 0.5,
   179	      cd: 0.6 + Math.random(), anim: Math.random() * 6, tx: 0, tz: 0,
   180	      armorFlash: 0, phase2: false, hitStack: 0, hitStackT: 0
   181	    };
   182	    f.hp = f.maxhp;
   183	    if (isBoss) { f.name = G.bossName; G.boss = f; }
   184	    G.foes.push(f);
   185	    return f;
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  function checkWaves() {
   189	    const segStart = G.seg * L;
   190	    const prog = (G.camX - segStart) / Math.max(1, L - W);
   191	    let pending = false;
   192	    for (const w of G.waves) {
   193	      if (w.done || w.seg !== G.seg) { if (!w.done && w.seg === G.seg) pending = true; continue; }
   194	      if (prog >= w.f - 0.001) {
   195	        w.done = true;
   196	        for (let i = 0; i < w.list.length; i++) G.pending.push(w.list[i]);
   197	        G.camLock = G.camX;
   198	      } else pending = true;
   199	    }
   200	    // trickle-spawn: never more than MAX_ACTIVE brawlers on screen at once
   201	    let side = G.spawnSide || 1;
   202	    while (G.pending.length && G.foes.length < MAX_ACTIVE) {
   203	      const t = G.pending.shift();
   204	      spawnFoe(t, side);
   205	      side = -side;
   206	      if (t === 'BOSS') { banner(G.bossName, 2.0); Audio.tone(90, 0.6, 'sawtooth', 0.25, 55); }
   207	    }
   208	    G.spawnSide = side;
   209	
   210	    const alive = G.foes.length > 0 || G.pending.length > 0;
   211	    if (alive) { if (G.camLock === null) G.camLock = G.camX; }
   212	    else if (!pending) { G.camLock = null; G.goT = 1; }
   213	    else if (!alive) { G.camLock = null; }
   214	  }

   134	    }
   135	    return {
   136	      kind: 'rain', dur: rng.range(3.0, 4.0), period: Math.max(0.06, 0.16 - s * 0.02 - tier * 0.02),
   137	      speed: 118 * spd, c: COL.rain, r: 3.6, seed: rng.int(1, 9999)
   138	    };
   139	  }
   140	
   141	  var BOSS_NAMES = ['KESTREL FRAME', 'VAULT CHOIR', 'SKYHAMMER PRIME'];
   142	
   143	  function makeBoss(s, rng) {
   144	    var kinds = ['ring', 'arms', 'aimed', 'wall', 'rain'];
   145	    var phases = [];
   146	    var baseHP = [250, 310, 380];
   147	    for (var p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
   148	      var pool = kinds.slice();
   149	      var moves = [];
   150	      var cnt = 2 + (p > 0 ? 1 : 0);
   151	      // grammar: each phase always contains one "aimed pressure" move plus 1-2 geometric moves
   152	      moves.push(makeMove(p === 0 ? 'aimed' : rng.pick(['aimed', 'rain']), s, rng, p));
   153	      for (var m = 0; m < cnt; m++) {
   154	        var k = rng.pick(pool);
   155	        pool.splice(pool.indexOf(k), 1);
   156	        if (!pool.length) pool = kinds.slice();
   157	        moves.push(makeMove(k, s, rng, p));
   158	      }
   159	      phases.push({
   160	        hp: Math.round(baseHP[p] * (1 + s * 0.3)),
   161	        pods: p < 2 ? 2 : 2,
   162	        podHP: Math.round(85 * (1 + s * 0.25)),
   163	        moves: moves
   164	      });
   165	    }
   166	    return { name: BOSS_NAMES[s], phases: phases };
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  function makeStage(s) {
   170	    var rng = SH.rngObj(90210 + s * 7919);
   171	    var waves = [];
   172	    var t = 1.6;
   173	    var nW = 8 + s;
   174	    var kinds = ['aimed', 'fan', 'spiral', 'wall'];
   175	    for (var i = 0; i < nW; i++) {
   176	      var kind = (i % 4 === 3) ? 'wall' : (i === 0 ? 'aimed' : rng.pick(kinds));
   177	      waves.push(makeWave(kind, s, rng, t));
   178	      t += Math.max(3.0, rng.range(4.3, 6.0) - s * 0.3);
   179	    }
   180	    return {
   181	      index: s, theme: STAGE_THEME[s], waves: waves,
   182	      bossAt: t + 2.0, boss: makeBoss(s, rng)
   183	    };
   184	  }
   185	
   186	  SH.makeStage = makeStage;
   187	  SH.COL = COL;
   188	})(SH);

     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var V = {};

     7	  /* ---------- math ---------- */
     8	  V.clamp = function (v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); };
     9	  V.lerp = function (a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; };
    10	  V.rand = function (a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); };
    11	  V.randi = function (a, b) { return Math.floor(a + Math.random() * (b - a)); };
    12	  V.pick = function (arr) { return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]; };
    13	  V.dist2 = function (a, b) { var dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y; return dx * dx + dy * dy; };
    14	  V.dist = function (a, b) { return Math.sqrt(V.dist2(a, b)); };
    15	  V.angTo = function (a, b) { return Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x); };
    16	  V.angDiff = function (a, b) {
    17	    var d = (a - b) % (Math.PI * 2);
    18	    if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
    19	    if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
    20	    return d;
    21	  };
    22	
    23	  /* ---------- particles ---------- */
    24	  var PMAX = 320;
    25	  V.parts = [];
    26	  V.burst = function (x, y, n, col, spd, life, size) {
    27	    spd = spd || 120; life = life || 0.45; size = size || 3;
    28	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    29	      if (V.parts.length >= PMAX) break;
    30	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
    31	      V.parts.push({
    32	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s,
    33	        life: life * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.7), max: life, col: col,
    34	        r: size * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8), ring: 0
    35	      });
    36	    }
    37	  };
    38	  V.ring = function (x, y, r, col, life) {
    39	    if (V.parts.length >= PMAX) return;
    40	    V.parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: 0, vy: 0, life: life || 0.35, max: life || 0.35, col: col, r: r, ring: 1 });
    41	  };
    42	  V.updateParts = function (dt) {
    43	    for (var i = V.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    44	      var p = V.parts[i];
    45	      p.life -= dt;
    46	      if (p.life <= 0) { V.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    47	      if (!p.ring) {
    48	        p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    49	        p.vx *= 0.90; p.vy *= 0.90;
    50	      }
    51	    }
    52	  };
    53	  V.drawParts = function (c) {
    54	    for (var i = 0; i < V.parts.length; i++) {
    55	      var p = V.parts[i], k = V.clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1);
    56	      c.globalAlpha = k;
    57	      if (p.ring) {
    58	        c.strokeStyle = p.col; c.lineWidth = 2 + 3 * k;
    59	        c.beginPath(); c.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (1.35 - 0.35 * k), 0, 6.2832); c.stroke();
    60	      } else {
    61	        c.fillStyle = p.col;
    62	        c.beginPath(); c.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * k, 0, 6.2832); c.fill();
    63	      }
    64	    }
    65	    c.globalAlpha = 1;
    66	  };

    73	  var actx = null, muted = false;
    74	  V.initAudio = function () {
    75	    if (actx) { if (actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume(); return; }
    76	    try {
    77	      var AC = root.AudioContext || root.webkitAudioContext;
    78	      if (AC) actx = new AC();
    79	    } catch (e) { actx = null; }
    80	  };
    81	  V.toggleMute = function () { muted = !muted; return muted; };
    82	  V.isMuted = function () { return muted; };
    83	  function tone(freq, freq2, dur, type, vol) {
    84	    if (!actx || muted) return;
    85	    var t = actx.currentTime;
    86	    var o = actx.createOscillator(), g = actx.createGain();
    87	    o.type = type || 'square';
    88	    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    89	    if (freq2) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, freq2), t + dur);
    90	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    91	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.12, t + 0.008);
    92	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    93	    o.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination);
    94	    o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
    95	  }
    96	  function noise(dur, vol, hp) {
    97	    if (!actx || muted) return;
    98	    var n = Math.floor(actx.sampleRate * dur);
    99	    var buf = actx.createBuffer(1, n, actx.sampleRate), d = buf.getChannelData(0);
   100	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
   101	    var s = actx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = buf;
   102	    var g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.14;
   103	    var f = actx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'highpass'; f.frequency.value = hp || 400;
   104	    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(actx.destination); s.start();
   105	  }
   106	  V.sfx = function (k) {
   107	    if (!actx || muted) return;
   108	    switch (k) {
   109	      case 'slash': tone(680, 300, 0.09, 'sawtooth', 0.08); break;
   110	      case 'heavy': tone(160, 60, 0.20, 'square', 0.14); noise(0.12, 0.10, 200); break;
   111	      case 'shot': tone(880, 620, 0.07, 'triangle', 0.07); break;
   112	      case 'zap': tone(1400, 500, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.07); break;
   113	      case 'hit': tone(240, 150, 0.06, 'square', 0.06); break;
   114	      case 'kill': tone(320, 90, 0.16, 'square', 0.10); noise(0.10, 0.08, 300); break;
   115	      case 'down': tone(220, 70, 0.45, 'sine', 0.14); break;
   116	      case 'revive': tone(420, 880, 0.28, 'triangle', 0.11); break;
   117	      case 'super': tone(180, 1200, 0.5, 'sawtooth', 0.13); noise(0.4, 0.09, 250); break;
   118	      case 'swap': tone(600, 900, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.08); break;
   119	      case 'clear': tone(520, 780, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.10); setTimeout(function () { tone(780, 1040, 0.22, 'triangle', 0.10); }, 110); break;
   120	      case 'over': tone(300, 60, 0.8, 'sawtooth', 0.14); break;
   121	      case 'boss': tone(90, 50, 0.9, 'square', 0.16); break;
   122	    }

   138	  function hitCircle(p, x, y) { var dx = x - p.x, dy = y - p.y; return dx * dx + dy * dy <= p.r * p.r; }
   139	
   140	  function onDown(id, x, y) {
   141	    V.initAudio();
   142	    IN.anyTap = true;
   143	    var L = V.layout;
   144	    if (hitCircle(L.strike, x, y)) { pointers[id] = 'strike'; IN.strike = true; return; }
   145	    if (hitCircle(L.sup, x, y)) { pointers[id] = 'super'; IN.superBtn = true; IN.superEdge = true; return; }
   146	    for (var i = 0; i < L.ports.length; i++) {
   147	      var p = L.ports[i];
   148	      if (x >= p.x - 6 && x <= p.x + p.w + 6 && y >= p.y - 6 && y <= p.y + p.h + 10) {
   149	        pointers[id] = 'ui'; IN.swapReq = i; return;
   150	      }
   151	    }
   152	    if (L.mute && x >= L.mute.x && x <= L.mute.x + L.mute.w && y >= L.mute.y && y <= L.mute.y + L.mute.h) {
   153	      pointers[id] = 'ui'; V.toggleMute(); return;
   154	    }
   155	    if (!IN.stick.on) {
   156	      pointers[id] = 'stick';
   157	      IN.stick.on = true; IN.stick.id = id;
   158	      IN.stick.ox = x; IN.stick.oy = y; IN.stick.x = x; IN.stick.y = y;
   159	      IN.stick.dx = 0; IN.stick.dy = 0; IN.stick.mag = 0;
   160	      return;
   161	    }
   162	    pointers[id] = 'ui';
   163	  }
   164	  function onMove(id, x, y) {
   165	    var r = pointers[id];
   166	    if (r === 'stick' && IN.stick.id === id) {
   167	      IN.stick.x = x; IN.stick.y = y;
   168	      var dx = x - IN.stick.ox, dy = y - IN.stick.oy;
   169	      var m = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), MAXR = 52;
   170	      if (m > MAXR) { // drag the base along
   171	        IN.stick.ox += dx * (1 - MAXR / m);
   172	        IN.stick.oy += dy * (1 - MAXR / m);
   173	        dx = x - IN.stick.ox; dy = y - IN.stick.oy; m = MAXR;
   174	      }
   175	      IN.stick.mag = V.clamp(m / MAXR, 0, 1);
   176	      if (m > 0.001) { IN.stick.dx = dx / (m || 1); IN.stick.dy = dy / (m || 1); }
   177	      if (m < 6) { IN.stick.mag = 0; }
   178	    }
   179	  }
   180	  function onUp(id) {
   181	    var r = pointers[id];
   182	    if (r === 'strike') IN.strike = false;
   183	    else if (r === 'super') IN.superBtn = false;
   184	    else if (r === 'stick') {
   185	      IN.stick.on = false; IN.stick.id = null; IN.stick.mag = 0; IN.stick.dx = 0; IN.stick.dy = 0;
   186	    }
   187	    delete pointers[id];
   188	  }
